math-e1-geo1.title: Aha ụdị na nkuku
math-e1-geo1.concept: **Triangle** nwere akụkụ 3, **okpukpu anọ** nwere akụkụ 4. **Okirikiri** gbara gburugburu ma enweghị nkuku.

math-e1-geo2.title: Ịmara ụdị nwere olu
math-e1-geo2.concept: Ụdị igbe bụ **cuboid**, ụdị ogidi gbara gburugburu bụ **cylinder**, ụdị bọọlụ bụ **sphere**.

math-e1-l1.title: Ịgụ ọnụọgụ
math-e1-l1.concept: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-agụ ihe otu otu ka ị na-atụ aka, ị ga-ama ole ha dị. Ọ bụrụ na ha karịrị 10, ọ dị mfe ịgụ ha n'otu ọnụ 5 ma ọ bụ 10.

math-e1-l2.title: Mgbakwunye na mwepụ
math-e1-l2.concept: **Mgbakwunye (+)** bụ ijikọta ọnụọgụ abụọ, **mwepụ (-)** bụ iwepụ ọnụọgụ pere mpe site na nke buru ibu.

math-e1-l3.title: Iji ọnụọgụ tụnyere ibe ha
math-e1-l3.concept: N'ime ọnụọgụ abụọ, nke buru ibu ka a na-egosi site na **>**, nke pere mpe site na **<**. Akara ahụ na-emeghe n'akụkụ ọnụọgụ buru ibu.

math-e1-l4.title: Ụdị dị iche iche
math-e1-l4.concept: **Triangle** nwere akụkụ 3, **okpukpu anọ** nwere akụkụ 4. **Okirikiri** gbara gburugburu ma enweghị nkuku.

math-e1-l5.title: Ogologo na elekere
math-e1-l5.concept: A na-atụ ogologo n'ime **cm**. Mkpịsị elekere mkpụmkpụ na-egosi 'awa', mkpịsị ogologo na-egosi 'nkeji'.
math-e1-l5.example: Mkpịsị mkpụmkpụ 4, mkpịsị ogologo 12 → elekere anọ

math-e2-dat1.title: Ịtọpụ n'ìgwè ma ịgosi ya na tebụl na eserese
math-e2-dat1.concept: Ọ bụrụ na ị kewaa data dị ka ụkpụrụ, gụọ ya, ma gosi ya na **tebụl** ma ọ bụ **eserese**, ị ga-atụnyere ha n'otu leba anya.
math-e2-dat1.example: A mmadụ 3, B mmadụ 5, C mmadụ 2 → mmadụ 10 niile

math-e2-geo1.title: Triangle na okpukpu anọ
math-e2-geo1.concept: **Triangle** nwere akụkụ kwụ ọtọ 3 na nkuku 3, **okpukpu anọ** nwere akụkụ kwụ ọtọ 4 na nkuku 4. Ọbụlagodi na ụdị dị iche, ọnụọgụ akụkụ na nkuku dị otu.

math-e2-geo2.title: Ogologo na oge
math-e2-geo2.concept: Ọ bụrụ na ị tinye 0 nke ụkpụrụ ahụ n'ọnụ, ọnụ nke ọzọ na-egosi ogologo. $1\text{ m}=100\text{ cm}$. Ọnụọgụ nke mkpịsị ogologo nke elekere na-egosi, mụbaa ya na 5 ọ bụ nkeji.

math-e2-l1.title: Uru ebe
math-e2-l1.concept: N'ọnụọgụ nwere ọnụọgụ abụọ, ọnụọgụ aka ekpe bụ **ebe iri**, ọnụọgụ aka nri bụ **ebe otu**. Ọ bụrụ na iri 10 gbakọtara, ọ bụ 100.

math-e2-l2.title: Mgbakwunye na mwepụ nke ọnụọgụ nwere ọnụọgụ abụọ
math-e2-l2.concept: Gbakọọ ebe otu na ibe ha, ebe iri na ibe ha. Ọ bụrụ na nchikota karịrị 10, bufee ya n'elu; ọ bụrụ na ịnweghị ike iwepụ, gbazite site n'ebe dị elu.

math-e2-l3.title: Izute ịmụba nke mbụ
math-e2-l3.concept: Ịgbakwunye otu ọnụọgụ ugboro ugboro nwere ike ide n'ụzọ dị mkpụmkpụ dị ka **ịmụba (×)**.

math-e2-l4.title: Ogologo na oge
math-e2-l4.concept: **1m = 100cm**. N'elekere, oge ọ bụla mkpịsị ogologo gafere otu ọnụọgụ, nkeji 5 agafeela.

math-e2-l5.title: Ịchọta usoro
math-e2-l5.concept: Ọ bụrụ na ị chọta **iwu** nke ka ọnụọgụ na-abawanye ma ọ bụ na-ebelata, ị ga-amata ọnụọgụ na-esote.

math-e3-ari1.title: Mgbakwunye na mwepụ nke ọnụọgụ nwere ọnụọgụ atọ
math-e3-ari1.concept: Gbakọọ n'usoro site n'ebe otu. Ọ bụrụ na nchikota karịrị 10, **bufee** ya n'ebe dị elu; ọ bụrụ na ịnweghị ike iwepụ, **gbazite** site n'ebe dị elu.

math-e3-geo1.title: Akụkụ na akụkụ ziri ezi
math-e3-geo1.concept: Ọdịdị nke ụzarị abụọ si n'otu ebe malite na-eme bụ **akụkụ**. Akụkụ $90^\circ$ bụ **akụkụ ziri ezi**, nke dị obere bụ **akụkụ ntakịrị**, nke buru ibu bụ **akụkụ sara mbara**.
math-e3-geo1.example: $30^\circ$ akụkụ ntakịrị · $90^\circ$ akụkụ ziri ezi · $120^\circ$ akụkụ sara mbara

math-e3-geo2.title: Radius na dayamita nke okirikiri
math-e3-geo2.concept: Ogologo site n'etiti okirikiri ruo otu ebe n'okirikiri bụ **radius**, akụkụ ahịrị na-agafe etiti bụ **dayamita**. Dayamita bụ okpukpu abụọ nke radius.

math-e3-l1.title: Ịmụba na nkesa
math-e3-l1.concept: Ịmụba bụ ịgbakwunye otu ọnụọgụgụ ugboro ugboro, **nkesa** bụkwa ikekọta n'ụzọ hà nhata. Ọ bụrụ na ị maara tebụl ịmụba, nkesa dịkwa mfe.

math-e3-l2.title: Ịmata ntakịrị
math-e3-l2.concept: A na-egosi akụkụ nke ihe a kewara n'ụzọ hà nhata dị ka **ntakịrị**. Ọnụọgụgụ dị n'ala bụ **ọnụọgụgụ ala**, nke dị n'elu bụ **ọnụọgụgụ elu**.

math-e3-l3.title: Ogologo · ọtụtụ mmiri · ibu
math-e3-l3.concept: **1km = 1000m**, **1L = 1000mL**, **1kg = 1000g**. Mgbe ị na-agbanwe nkeji, mụbaa site na 1000.

math-e3-l4.title: Okirikiri na akụkụ
math-e3-l4.concept: **Akụkụ ziri ezi** bụ 90°. N'okirikiri, **dayamita** bụ okpukpu abụọ nke **radius**.

math-e3-l5.title: Tebụl na eserese
math-e3-l5.concept: Ọ bụrụ na ị hazie nsonaazụ nyocha n'ime tebụl, ị nwere ike ịmata ngwa ngwa nke kacha ọtụtụ, nke kacha ole na ole na nchikota.

math-e4-dat1.title: Ịgụ eserese ahịrị gbagọrọ agbagọ
math-e4-dat1.concept: **Eserese ahịrị gbagọrọ agbagọ** na-egosi uru na-agbanwe n'oge site na ntụpọ na ahịrị. Ọ bụrụ na ahịrị arịgo, ọ bawanyela; ọ bụrụ na ọ daa, ọ belatala.

math-e4-geo1.title: Nha akụkụ nke ọdịdị
math-e4-geo1.concept: Nchikota akụkụ atọ nke triangle bụ $180^\circ$, nchikota akụkụ anọ nke akụkụ anọ bụ $360^\circ$.

math-e4-geo2.title: Akụkụ anọ na polygon
math-e4-geo2.concept: Ọ bụrụ na otu ụzọ akụkụ dị n'ihu ibe ha na-eso ibe ha n'ụzọ, ọ bụ **trapezoid**; ọ bụrụ na ụzọ abụọ niile na-eso ibe ha n'ụzọ, ọ bụ **parallelogram**; ọ bụrụ na akụkụ anọ niile hà nhata, ọ bụ **rhombus**. Akụkụ ahịrị na-ejikọta ntọala abụọ na-anọghị n'akụkụ ibe ha bụ **diagonal**.

math-e4-l1.title: Ọnụọgụgụ ukwu
math-e4-l1.concept: Gụọ ma dee ọnụọgụgụ ukwu site na nkeji puku iri (10000). Ọnụọgụgụ nke ọ bụla na-egosi nha nke **uru ebe**.

math-e4-l2.title: Ịmụba na nkesa nke ọnụọgụgụ ukwu
math-e4-l2.concept: Kesaa onye na-amụba, mụbaa, wee gbakwunye. N'ime nkesa, lelee site n'iche atụmatụ nke ihe e nwetara.

math-e4-l3.title: Ịgbakwunye na iwepụ ntakịrị na ọnụọgụgụ ntụpọ
math-e4-l3.concept: Ntakịrị nwere otu ọnụọgụgụ ala na-agbakwunye ma wepụ **ọnụọgụgụ elu naanị**. Maka ọnụọgụgụ ntụpọ, hazie ebe ntụpọ tupu ịgbakọ.

math-e4-l4.title: Nha akụkụ na ọdịdị
math-e4-l4.concept: Nchikota akụkụ atọ nke triangle bụ **180°**, nchikota akụkụ anọ nke akụkụ anọ bụ **360°**.

math-e4-l5.title: Eserese mgbidi na nkezi
math-e4-l5.concept: Gụọ data ma chọta nchikota na ọdịiche. **Nkezi** bụ uru nchikota niile kesara site na ọnụọgụgụ.

math-e5-dat1.title: Ịchọta nkezi
math-e5-dat1.concept: **Nkezi** bụ uru nchikota data niile kesara site na ọnụọgụgụ data.

math-e5-dat2.title: Ohere
math-e5-dat2.concept: A na-egosi **ohere** nke ihe ịme n'ọnụọgụgụ dị n'etiti 0 (enweghị ike) na 1 (doro anya). Ohere = (ọnụọgụgụ ihe chọrọ) ÷ (ọnụọgụgụ ihe niile).
math-e5-dat2.example: Bọọlụ A 3, bọọlụ B 2 → ohere nke A $\frac{3}{5}=0.6$

math-e5-geo1.title: Gburugburu na mpaghara
math-e5-geo1.concept: Okpukpu anọ nwere akụkụ aka nri: mpaghara=obosara×ogologo, triangle: ntọala×elu÷2, parallelogram: ntọala×elu, trapezoid: (elu+ala)×elu÷2, rhombus: diagonal×diagonal÷2.

math-e5-geo2.title: Ndakọrịta na ngbanwe ụdị
math-e5-geo2.concept: Ụdị abụọ nwere otu ụdị na nha ma nwee ike ikpuchi ibe ha bụ **ndị ha na ibe ha dakọrọ**. Ụdị nke kpuchiri onwe ya kpam kpam mgbe e gbagọrọ ya n'akụkụ otu ahịrị bụ **ụdị nwere ndakọrịta ahịrị**, ahịrị ahụ bụ **axis ndakọrịta**.

math-e5-l1.title: Ịgbakwunye na iwepu ntakịrị nwere ọnụọgụgụ ala dị iche
math-e5-l1.concept: Ọ bụrụ na ọnụọgụgụ ala dị iche, buru ụzọ mee **ọnụọgụgụ ala nkịtị**. Ọ dị mfe iji ihe kacha nta ha abụọ na-ekere òkè dị ka ọnụọgụgụ ala nkịtị.

math-e5-l2.title: Ịmụba ọnụọgụ decimal
math-e5-l2.concept: Wepụ ntụpọ decimal ma mụbaa dị ka ọnụọgụ zuru ezu, mgbe ahụ tinyegharịa ntụpọ decimal dị ka ọnụọgụ ebe decimal nke ihe e mụbara.

math-e5-l3.title: Ihe na-ekewa na ọtụtụ
math-e5-l3.concept: **Ihe na-ekewa** bụ ọnụọgụ na-eme ka ọnụọgụ ọzọ kewaa n'enweghị ihe fọdụrụ, **ọtụtụ** bụ ọnụọgụ ahụ ugboro 1, ugboro 2, ugboro 3...

math-e5-l4.title: Mpaghara na olu
math-e5-l4.concept: Okpukpu anọ nwere akụkụ aka nri bụ **ogologo × obosara**, triangle bụ **ntọala × elu ÷ 2**, olu nke cuboid bụ **ogologo × obosara × elu**.

math-e5-l5.title: Ratio na ọnụọgụ ratio
math-e5-l5.concept: **Ọnụọgụ ratio** bụ uru e nwetara site n'ikewa ọnụọgụ a na-atụnyere site na ọnụọgụ ntọala. Ọ bụrụ na ị mụbaa ọnụọgụ ratio na 100, ọ bụ **pasent (%)**.

math-e6-ari1.title: Mkpọsa jikọtara nke ọnụọgụ zuru ezu
math-e6-ari1.concept: Ọ bụrụ na mgbakwunye, mwepụ, ịmụba na nkewa jikọtara, gbakọọ **ihe dị n'ime akara nkọwa** buru ụzọ, mgbe ahụ **ịmụba na nkewa**, n'ikpeazụ **mgbakwunye na mwepụ** site n'aka ekpe.

math-e6-ari2.title: Ịgbago elu, ịgbago ala, ịgbago nso
math-e6-ari2.concept: **Ịgbago elu** na-ewelite ihe niile dị n'okpuru ebe a chọrọ, **ịgbago ala** na-atụfu ha niile. **Ịgbago nso** na-ebuli ma ọ bụrụ na ebe dị n'okpuru ya bụ 5 ma ọ bụ karịa, na-atụfu ma ọ bụrụ 4 ma ọ bụ ihe na-erughị.
math-e6-ari2.example: 3472 n'ime otu narị: ịgbago elu 3500, ịgbago ala 3400, ịgbago nso 3500

math-e6-dat1.title: Eserese eriri na eserese gburugburu
math-e6-dat1.concept: **Eserese eriri** na **eserese gburugburu** na-ewere ngụkọta dị ka 100% ma na-egosi ratio nke akụkụ ọ bụla. Ọnụọgụ akụkụ=ngụkọta×ratio.

math-e6-geo1.title: Gburugburu na mpaghara okirikiri
math-e6-geo1.concept: Gburugburu (ogologo okirikiri)=dayameta×pi, mpaghara okirikiri=radius×radius×pi. Pi bụ ihe dị ka $3.14$.

math-e6-geo2.title: Cuboid na cube
math-e6-geo2.concept: Olu=ogologo×obosara×elu, mpaghara elu=(nchikota mpaghara ihu atọ)×2. Cuboid nwere ihu 6, ọnụ 12, ọnụ nkọ 8.

math-e6-l1.title: Ịmụba na ikewa ntakịrị na decimal
math-e6-l1.concept: Ịmụba ntakịrị bụ ịmụba ọnụọgụgụ elu na ibe ha, na ọnụọgụgụ ala na ibe ha. Ikewa ntakịrị bụ ịmụba **ntụgharị**.

math-e6-l2.title: Akụkụ ratio na nkesa ratio
math-e6-l2.concept: N'akụkụ ratio, **ngwaahịa ọnụọgụ dị n'etiti = ngwaahịa ọnụọgụ dị n'èzí**. Ịkewa ngụkọta site na ratio bụ **nkesa ratio**.

math-e6-l3.title: Pasent
math-e6-l3.concept: **Pasent (%)** bụ ratio mgbe a na-ewere ọnụọgụ ntọala dị ka 100. Ọ bụrụ na ị mụbaa decimal na 100, ọ ga-abụ %.

math-e6-l4.title: Okirikiri na ụdị nwere ọtụtụ akụkụ
math-e6-l4.concept: Gburugburu okirikiri bụ **dayameta × 3.14**, mpaghara okirikiri bụ **radius × radius × 3.14**.

math-e6-l5.title: Nkezi na nhazi data
math-e6-l5.concept: **Nkezi** bụ nchikota ÷ ọnụọgụ, **etiti uru** bụ ọnụọgụ dị n'etiti, **mode** bụ ọnụọgụ pụtara ọtụtụ ugboro.

math-el-ai1.title: Data ederede na eserese
math-el-ai1.concept: A na-egosipụta akwụkwọ site na vector nke ugboro okwu, ma eserese site na matriks nke uru pixel. Ka dot product nke vector buru ibu, ka akwụkwọ ndị ahụ na-adịkwu ka ibe ha.

math-el-ai2.title: Amụma na ịhazi nke ọma
math-el-ai2.concept: Mkpọda nke ahịrị ọnọdụ, nkezi nke square nke njehie (loss), na gradient descent $x_{ọhụrụ}=x-\eta f'(x)$ na-eme ka amụma ka mma.

math-el-cul1.title: Mgbakọ na mwepụ n'ọgbọ na ndụ kwa ụbọchị
math-el-cul1.concept: Ruru ọla edo bụ ihe dị ka 1.618, ụda otu octave n'elu nwere frequency okpukpu abụọ, ọnụọgụ ụzọ nke ntụpọ Braille isii bụ $2^6-1=63$, ma nnukwu ọtụtụ bụ ọnụọgụ karịrị ọkara nke ngụkọta.

math-el-cul2.title: Mgbakọ na mwepụ n'ọha mmadụ na gburugburu ebe obibi
math-el-cul2.concept: A na-eji nkezi data na ruru mmụba nyochaa nsogbu ọha mmadụ na gburugburu ebe obibi site na mgbakọ na mwepụ. Ruru mmụba=(ọnụọgụ ọ bawanyere)÷(uru mbụ)×100.

math-el-econ1.title: Ọmụrụ, ọnụọgụ mgbanwe ego, na ụtụ isi
math-el-econ1.concept: Simple interest=ego isi×ọnụ ọgụgụ×oge, compound interest bụ ego isi×(1+ọnụ ọgụgụ)^oge. Ọnụọgụ mgbanwe ego bụ uru nke otu nkeji ego mba ọzọ, a na-ebuputakwa ụtụ isi site n'ịmụba ọnụahịa na ruru.
math-el-econ1.example: 10000 won, 10% kwa afọ compound, afọ 2 → 12100 won

math-el-econ2.title: Mkpa na nkwado na ịhazi nke ọma
math-el-econ2.concept: Ebe curve mkpa na nkwado zutere bụ nhazi. A na-eji ọrụ na derivative chọta uru kachasị elu nke ego ịbata R=pq na elasticity.

math-el-job1.title: Mgbanwe nkeji na ruru
math-el-job1.concept: 1 m=100 cm, 1 kg=1000 g, awa 1=nkeji 60. Ọnụahịa mwepụ=ọnụahịa×(1−ruru mwepụ), ma ọ bụrụ na agwakọta n'ruru a:b, A bụ $\frac{a}{a+b}$ nke ngụkọta.

math-el-job2.title: Mpaghara, ọnụọgụ ụzọ, na ruru mmụba
math-el-job2.concept: Jiri mpaghara chọta ọnụọgụ ihe achọrọ, jiri iwu ịmụba chọta ọnụọgụ ụzọ ndị a pụrụ ijikọta, ma jiri (ọnụọgụ ọ bawanyere)÷(uru mbụ)×100 chọta ruru mmụba.

math-el-res1.title: Usoro nyocha
math-el-res1.concept: A na-eme nyocha ọrụ mgbakọ na mwepụ site n'usoro dị ka nyocha akwụkwọ, nyocha ọmụmaatụ, nnwale mgbakọ na mwepụ, na nyocha mmepe.
math-el-res1.example: Ịtụba dice n'onwe gị iji chọta iwu → nnwale mgbakọ na mwepụ

math-el-res2.title: Usoro nyocha na ụkpụrụ omume nyocha
math-el-res2.concept: A na-eme nyocha n'usoro: ịhọrọ isiokwu → atụmatụ → ime → ịkọwa → ntụgharị uche. Ịkọwapụta isi mmalite na ịghara ịgbanwe nsonaazụ bụ ụkpụrụ omume nyocha.
math-el-res2.example: Mgbe ịhọrọchara isiokwu bụ atụmatụ nyocha

math-el-sta1.title: Nsogbu ihe omuma na nlele
math-el-sta1.concept: Standard deviation bụ mgbọrọgwụ square nke nkezi nke square nke ọdịiche (variance). A na-ahọrọ nlele site na random sampling, stratified sampling, cluster sampling, systematic sampling, wdg.

math-el-sta2.title: Atụmatụ na nnwale echiche
math-el-sta2.concept: Oke njehie nke oge ntụkwasị obi 95% bụ $1.96\times\frac{σ}{\sqrt{n} }$. Ọ bụrụ na uru zuru oke nke test statistic $z=\frac{\bar{x}-\mu}{σ/\sqrt{n} }$ karịrị 1.96, a na-ajụ null hypothesis n'ogo ihe ịrịba ama 5%.

math-h1-fnc1.title: Ọrụ jikọtara na ọrụ ntụgharị
math-h1-fnc1.concept: Gbakọọ ọrụ jikọtara $(g\circ f)(x)=g(f(x))$ site na ọrụ dị n'ime. Ọrụ ntụgharị bụ ọrụ nke $f^{-1}(y)=x$ mgbe $f(x)=y$.

math-h1-geo1.title: Ụdị n'elu nhazi
math-h1-geo1.concept: Ebe dị anya n'etiti isi abụọ bụ $\sqrt{(x_2-x_1)^2+(y_2-y_1)^2}$, etiti bụ nkezi nke nhazi, mkpọda bụ $\frac{y_2-y_1}{x_2-x_1}$.

math-h1-geo2.title: Akụkụ gburugburu
math-h1-geo2.concept: Akụkụ gburugburu nke etiti ya bụ $(a, b)$ ma radius bụ $r$ bụ $(x-a)^2+(y-b)^2=r^2$. Anya dị n'etiti ebe $(x_0,y_0)$ na ahịrị $ax+by+c=0$ bụ $\frac{|ax_0+by_0+c|}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2} }$.

math-h1-l1.title: Ikewa polynomial na usoro ihe fọdụrụ
math-h1-l1.concept: Ihe fọdụrụ mgbe e kewara $P(x)$ site na $x-a$ bụ $P(a)$, ma ọ bụrụ na $P(a)=0$, $x-a$ bụ ihe na-ekewa.
math-h1-l1.example: Ihe fọdụrụ mgbe e kewara $x^2+3x+2$ site na $x-1$ $=P(1)=6$

math-h1-l2.title: Ọnụọgụgụ complex na nchọpụta akụkụ quadratic
math-h1-l2.concept: $i^2=-1$, ma ọ bụrụ na discriminant $D=b^2-4ac<0$, ọ nwere mgbọrọgwụ imaginary. Mgbọrọgwụ imaginary nke akụkụ quadratic nwere coefficients n'ezie na-apụta n'ụzọ abụọ dị ka ọnụọgụgụ complex conjugate.

math-h1-l3.title: Enweghị nha quadratic
math-h1-l3.concept: Gụọ azịza site na ọnọdụ eserese ọrụ quadratic ma gbasara axis $x$. $(x-a)(x-b)<0$ bụ n'etiti mgbọrọgwụ abụọ, $>0$ bụ n'èzí mgbọrọgwụ abụọ.

math-h1-l4.title: Permutations na combinations
math-h1-l4.concept: Ọ bụrụ na i na-atụle usoro, ọ bụ permutation $_nP_r$; ọ bụrụ na ị naghị atụle ya, ọ bụ combination $_nC_r$. Maka 'opekata mpe otu', wepụ ihe omume nke ọzọ site na ngụkọta.

math-h1-l5.title: Akụkụ ahịrị na gburugburu
math-h1-l5.concept: Anya dị n'etiti ebe na ahịrị $\frac{|ax_0+by_0+c|}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2} }$, gburugburu $(x-a)^2+(y-b)^2=r^2$, ahịrị metụrụ gburugburu kwụ ọtọ na radius.
math-h1-l5.example: Ntụzi ọnọdụ nke ahịrị metụrụ gburugburu $x^2+y^2=25$ n'ebe $(3,\ 4)$ $=-\frac34$

math-h1-mat1.title: Ihe matrix pụtara na ọrụ ya
math-h1-mat1.concept: **Matrix** bụ nhazi ọnụọgụgụ n'ụdị akụkụ anọ. Mgbakwunye, mwepụ na ịmụba site na ọnụọgụgụ n'ezie na-agbakọ akụkụ ndị dị n'otu ọnọdụ, ma akụkụ (i, j) nke ngwaahịa $AB$ bụ ngụkọta nke ịmụba akụkụ nke ahịrị i nke $A$ na kọlọm j nke $B$ n'usoro.

math-h1-pol1.title: Factoring na akụkụ cubic na quartic
math-h1-pol1.concept: Maka akụkụ cubic na quartic, jiri synthetic division ma ọ bụ nnọchi mee **factoring**, wee chọta uru nke na-eme ka ihe ọ bụla bụrụ 0 ka ị dozie ya. Maka ihe quadratic, jiri discriminant lelee ma ọ nwere mgbọrọgwụ n'ezie.

math-h1-set1.title: Set na nkwupụta
math-h1-set1.concept: $n(A\cup B)=n(A)+n(B)-n(A\cap B)$, ma set nwere akụkụ n nwere subsets $2^n$. Contrapositive nke nkwupụta 'ọ bụrụ p mgbe ahụ q' nwere otu eziokwu ma ọ bụ ụgha dị ka nkwupụta mbụ, mana converse nwere ike ọ gaghị.

math-h2-geo1.title: Triangle na ọrụ trigonometric
math-h2-geo1.concept: Iwu sine $\frac{a}{\sin A}=2R$, iwu cosine $c^2=a^2+b^2-2ab\cos C$, mpaghara triangle $\frac12ab\sin C$.

math-h2-geo2.title: Usoro radian na sector
math-h2-geo2.concept: $180^\circ=\pi$ radian. Maka sector nwere radius $r$ na akụkụ etiti $\theta$ (radian), ogologo akụkụ gbara gburugburu bụ $r\theta$, mpaghara bụ $\frac12r^2\theta$.

math-h2-l1.title: Ntụle na logarithms
math-h2-l1.concept: $\log_a b=x \iff a^x=b$. Ngụkọta logarithm bụ ngwaahịa nke ihe a na-agbakọ, ọdịiche bụ nkewa. A na-egosi mmụba exponential dị ka $a\cdot r^t$.

math-h2-l2.title: Ọrụ trigonometric
math-h2-l2.concept: $\pi$ radian $=180^\circ$. Ihe ịrịba ama nke $\sin,\ \cos,\ \tan$ dị iche n'akụkụ anọ ọ bụla. $y=a\sin bx+c$ nwere uru kacha ukwuu $|a|+c$ ma oge ya bụ $\frac{2\pi}{|b|}$.

math-h2-l4.title: Oke na nrube isi nke ọrụ
math-h2-l4.concept: Maka ụdị $\frac00$, kewaa ya n'ihe ndị mejupụtara ya ma wepụ ha; maka $x\to\infty$, kee ya site na okwu nke ogo kachasị elu. Ọ bụrụ na ọrụ ahụ na-aga n'ihu, oke aka ekpe, oke aka nri na uru ọrụ niile hara.

math-h2-l5.title: Derivative na ojiji ya
math-h2-l5.concept: $(x^n)'=nx^{n-1}$. $f'(a)$ bụ ọsọ nke tangent, ma ihe ịrịba ama nke $f'$ na-egosi mmụba, mbelata na uru kacha ukwuu ma ọ bụ kacha pere mpe. Ọsọ bụ derivative nke ọnọdụ.

math-h2-seq1.title: Nchikọta usoro na ∑
math-h2-seq1.concept: $\sum_{k=1}^{n} a_k$ pụtara $a_1+a_2+\cdots+a_n$. $\sum k=\frac{n(n+1)}{2}$, $\sum c=cn$, $\sum(a_k+b_k)=\sum a_k+\sum b_k$.

math-h3-cal1.title: Derivative nke ọrụ dị iche iche
math-h3-cal1.concept: Maka ọrụ jikọtara ọnụ, were (derivative nke ọrụ n'èzí)×(derivative nke ọrụ n'ime), ma maka nkesa, $\left(\frac{u}{v}\right)'=\frac{u'v-uv'}{v^2}$. $(e^x)'=e^x$, $(\ln x)'=\frac{1}{x}$, $(\sin x)'=\cos x$, $(\cos x)'=-\sin x$.

math-h3-cnt1.title: Permutation nwere ugboro ugboro, combination nwere ugboro ugboro na iwu binomial
math-h3-cnt1.concept: Ọnụọgụ **permutation nwere ugboro ugboro**, nke a na-ahazi n'ahịrị otu ma na-ekwe ka ugboro ugboro dị, bụ (ọnụọgụ nhọrọ) ka a na-amụba ya ugboro (ọnụọgụ ebe). Maka permutation nwere ihe yiri onwe ha, kee factorial nke ọnụọgụ niile site na factorial nke ihe yiri onwe ha, ma **combination nwere ugboro ugboro** bụ $_nH_r={}_{n+r-1}C_r$. N'ime $(x+1)^n$, coefficient nke $x^k$ bụ $_nC_k$.
math-h3-cnt1.example: Ụzọ e si ahazi aabbc bụ $5!\div(2!\times2!)=30$

math-h3-geo1.title: Curve nke ogo abụọ
math-h3-geo1.concept: Isi ntụpụ nke parabola $y^2=4px$ bụ $(p,0)$, n'ellipse $\frac{x^2}{a^2}+\frac{y^2}{b^2}=1$, $c^2=a^2-b^2$, ma n'hyperbola, $c^2=a^2+b^2$.

math-h3-geo2.title: Vector n'ihe nkesa
math-h3-geo2.concept: Ogologo nke vector $(x,y)$ bụ $\sqrt{x^2+y^2}$, dot product bụ $x_1x_2+y_1y_2$, ma ọ bụrụ na vector abụọ kwụ ọtọ n'ibe ibe ha, dot product bụ 0.

math-h3-l1.title: Indefinite integral na definite integral
math-h3-l1.concept: $\int x^n dx=\frac{x^{n+1} }{n+1}+C$, $\int_a^b f(x)dx=F(b)-F(a)$. Ịgbanwe oke elu na ala na-agbanwe ihe ịrịba ama, ma a pụrụ ikewa oke.

math-h3-l2.title: Ojiji nke definite integral
math-h3-l2.concept: Maka mpaghara, jikọta $|f(x)|$. Kewaa akụkụ ebe eserese dị n'okpuru axis $x$, ma n'etiti curve abụọ, jikọta (nke dị n'elu)−(nke dị n'okpuru). Integral nke ọsọ bụ ebe dị anya e gara.

math-h3-l3.title: Usoro geometric na-enweghị ngwụcha
math-h3-l3.concept: Ọ bụrụ na $|r|<1$, $\sum ar^{n-1}=\frac{a}{1-r}$ na-agbakọta; ọ bụrụ na $|r|\ge 1$, ọ na-agbasa. A na-eji ya maka ntụpọ na-emegharị onwe ya na mmegharị na-eme ugboro ugboro.

math-h3-l4.title: Puru omume nwere ọnọdụ na nnwere onwe
math-h3-l4.concept: $P(B\mid A)=\frac{P(A\cap B)}{P(A)}$. Ọ bụrụ na ha nwere onwe ha, $P(A\cap B)=P(A)P(B)$, ma nnwale nwere onwe ha bụ $_nC_k\,p^k(1-p)^{n-k}$.

math-h3-l5.title: Nkesa binomial na nkesa nkịtị
math-h3-l5.concept: Nkezi nke $B(n,p)$ bụ $np$, variance bụ $np(1-p)$. A na-eme nkesa nkịtị ka ọ bụrụ nke ọkọlọtọ site na $Z=\frac{X-m}{\sigma}$, ma ọ dị n'otu n'akụkụ abụọ gbasara nkezi.
math-h3-l5.example: Ọ bụrụ na $X\sim N(50,10^2)$ mgbe ahụ $P(X\ge 60)=P(Z\ge 1)$

math-h3-pro1.title: Iwu mgbakwunye nke puru omume na ihe omume nke ọzọ
math-h3-pro1.concept: $P(A\cup B)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A\cap B)$. Puru omume ihe omume nke ọzọ bụ $P(A^c)=1-P(A)$.

math-l1.title: Ịchọta uru okwu mgbako
math-l1.concept: Itinye ọnụọgụgụ n'ọnọdụ mkpụrụedemede ka a na-akpọ **nnọchi**. Nsonaazụ nke gbakọrọ mgbe nnọchi gasịrị bụ **uru okwu mgbako**. Mgbe i na-etinye ọnụọgụgụ na-adịghị mma, jiri brackets belata njehie.

math-l2.title: Njirimara nhata
math-l2.concept: Nhata dị ka **ihe nlere ịdị arọ**. Ọ bụrụ na i tinye ma ọ bụ wepụ otu ọnụọgụgụ n'akụkụ abụọ, mụbaa ma ọ bụ kewaa ya (site na ọnụọgụgụ abụghị 0), ihe nlere ịdị arọ ahụ ka na-edebe nguzozi.
math-l2.example: Ọ bụrụ na i wepụ $5$ n'akụkụ abụọ nke $x+5=9$, $x=4$.

math-l3.title: Idozi akụkụ nke mbụ
math-l3.concept: Wepụta okwu ndị nwere $x$ n'otu akụkụ na ọnụọgụgụ n'akụkụ nke ọzọ, wee kpọkọta ha. Mgbe i wepụrụ ha, akara na-agbanwe. N'ikpeazụ, kewaa site na ọnụọgụgụ dị n'ihu $x$, ma ọ gwụla!

math-l4.title: Idozi nsogbu site n'akụkụ
math-l4.concept: Nsogbu okwu a na-edozi n'usoro a: **were ihe a chọrọ dị ka $x$** → tụgharịa ahịrịokwu ahụ ka ọ bụrụ akụkụ → dozie ya → lelee ma azịza ahụ kwekọrọ n'ọnọdụ ahụ.
math-l4.example: Tinye $2$ n'ọnụọgụgụ ụfọdụ okpukpu $3$ ya bụ $14$ → $3x+2=14$ → $x=4$

math-m1-crd1.title: Ụgbọelu nhazi
math-m1-crd1.concept: A na-egosi ọnọdụ ebe site na (x-nhazi, y-nhazi). Akara na-ekpebi quadrant nke 1 ruo 4, ma mgbe a na-egosi n'axis x, akara nke y-nhazi na-agbanwe.

math-m1-fac1.title: Factoring prime na onye na-ekekọrịta kachasị ukwuu na nke kachasị nta nke ọtụtụ
math-m1-fac1.concept: Ide ọnụọgụgụ okike dị ka ngwaahịa nke ọnụọgụgụ prime bụ **factoring prime**. Nke kachasị ukwuu n'ime ihe na-ekewa ọnụ bụ **onye na-ekekọrịta kachasị ukwuu**, ma nke kacha nta n'ime ọtụtụ ọnụ bụ **nke kachasị nta nke ọtụtụ**.

math-m1-geo1.title: Njirimara akụkụ na polygons
math-m1-geo1.concept: Akụkụ ndị na-emegide onwe ha hà nhata, ma n'ahịrị ndị yiri onwe ha, akụkụ kwekọrọ na akụkụ ndị ọzọ hà nhata. Ngụkọta akụkụ dị n'ime polygon nwere akụkụ $n$ bụ $180^\circ\times(n-2)$.

math-m1-geo2.title: Sector na nha ihe ndị nwere ọtụtụ akụkụ
math-m1-geo2.concept: Ogologo akụkụ gbara gburugburu $=2\pi r\times\frac{a}{360}$, mpaghara sector $=\pi r^2\times\frac{a}{360}$, olu sphere $=\frac43\pi r^3$, olu cone $=\frac13\pi r^2h$.

math-m1-neg1.title: Mgbakọ nke ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu na ọnụọgụgụ nkeji
math-m1-neg1.concept: Mgbe i na-agbakwunye ọnụọgụgụ abụọ nwere otu akara, gbakwunye uru zuru oke ha; ọ bụrụ na akara dị iche, wepụ uru zuru oke ma tinye akara nke nke ka ukwuu. Maka ịmụba na ịkewa, ọ bụrụ na akara hà nhata ọ bụ +, ọ bụrụ na ha dị iche ọ bụ −.

math-m1-prp1.title: Nha nha na nha nke ọzọ
math-m1-prp1.concept: **Nha nha** bụ ụdị y=ax, **nha nke ọzọ** bụ ụdị $y=\frac{a}{x}$. N'ime nha nha, y÷x adịgide, n'ime nha nke ọzọ, x×y adịgide.
math-m1-prp1.example: Nha nha nke y=6 mgbe x=2: y=3x

math-m1-sta1.title: Uru etiti na ugboro ndị metụtara
math-m1-sta1.concept: **Etiti** bụ uru dị n'etiti mgbe a hazịrị ha site na nha, **ọtụtụ** bụ uru pụtara ugboro ugboro kachasị. **Ugboro metụtara**=(ugboro)÷(ugboro niile).

math-m2-geo1.title: Njirimara triangles na quadrilaterals
math-m2-geo1.concept: Akụkụ abụọ dị n'ala nke triangle nwere akụkụ abụọ hà nhata bụ otu. N'ime parallelogram, ngụkọta akụkụ abụọ dị n'akụkụ bụ $180^\circ$, ma akụkụ ahịrị jikọtara etiti akụkụ abụọ nke triangle bụ $\frac12$ nke akụkụ fọdụrụnụ.

math-m2-geo2.title: Myirịta na iwu Pythagoras
math-m2-geo2.concept: Ụdị ndị yiri onwe ha nwere ruru nke akụkụ ndị kwekọrọ hà nhata, ma ruru nke mpaghara bụ square nke ruru myirịta. N'ime triangle nwere akụkụ ziri ezi, $a^2+b^2=c^2$.

math-m2-l1.title: Iwu ndị ntụle na polynomials
math-m2-l1.concept: Mgbe a na-amụba otu ntọala, tinye ntụle ndị ahụ; mgbe ntụle dị n'ọkpụkpụ ntụle, mụbaa ntụle ndị ahụ. Maka polynomials, kpọkọta okwu ndị nwere otu mkpụrụedemede ahụ ma gụọ.

math-m2-l2.title: Usoro akụkụ nke mbụ
math-m2-l2.concept: Wepụ otu mkpụrụedemede n'akụkụ abụọ ahụ ka ị chọta azịza. Họrọ usoro mgbakwunye-mwepụ ma ọ bụ usoro nnọchi dị ka ọnọdụ si dị.

math-m2-l3.title: Enweghị nha nke mbụ
math-m2-l3.concept: Jiri usoro yiri njirimara nhata dozie ya, mana mgbe i na-amụba ma ọ bụ na-ekewa site na ọnụọgụgụ na-adịghị mma, ntụzi akara enweghị nha na-agbanwe.

math-m2-l4.title: Ọrụ nke mbụ na eserese ya
math-m2-l4.concept: N'ime $y=ax+b$, $a$ bụ ntụzi ọnọdụ, $b$ bụ $y$-intercept. Ahịrị ndị yiri onwe ha nwere otu ntụzi ọnọdụ.
math-m2-l4.example: Ntụzi ọnọdụ $=\dfrac{\text{mmụba nke y} }{\text{mmụba nke x} }$

math-m2-l5.title: Ọnụọgụgụ ọnọdụ na puru omume
math-m2-l5.concept: Puru omume bụ (ọnụọgụgụ ọnọdụ na-eme)÷(ọnụọgụgụ ọnọdụ niile). Maka ihe omume nnwere onwe na-eme n'otu oge, mụbaa ha; maka 'opekata mpe', jiri ihe omume nke ọzọ.

math-m2-lfn1.title: Ọrụ nke mbụ na akụkụ nke mbụ
math-m2-lfn1.concept: N'ime ọrụ nke mbụ y=ax+b, a bụ ntụzi ọnọdụ, b bụ y-intercept. Ebe eserese abụọ na-ezute bụ azịza nke usoro akụkụ abụọ ahụ.

math-m2-rec1.title: Ntụpọ na-agbagharị
math-m2-rec1.concept: Ọnụọgụgụ ntụpọ nke otu ọnụọgụgụ na-aga n'ihu na-eme ugboro ugboro n'okpuru ntụpọ ahụ na-akpọ **ntụpọ na-agbagharị**, ma akụkụ na-eme ugboro ugboro na-akpọ **akụkụ na-agbagharị**. Ọ bụrụ na denominator nke nkeji enweghị ike ibelata bụ naanị 2 ma ọ bụ 5, ọ bụ ntụpọ nwere njedebe.

math-m3-geo1.title: Ruru trigonometric
math-m3-geo1.concept: N'ime triangle nwere akụkụ ziri ezi, $\sin A$ bụ (ịdị elu)÷(akụkụ ogologo kachasị), $\cos A$ bụ (isi)÷(akụkụ ogologo kachasị), $\tan A$ bụ (ịdị elu)÷(isi).

math-m3-geo2.title: Njirimara gburugburu
math-m3-geo2.concept: Akụkụ ọnụ gburugburu nke otu akụkụ gbara gburugburu bụ $\frac12$ nke akụkụ etiti. Ahịrị metụrụ gburugburu dị n'akụkụ ziri ezi na radius, ma ngụkọta akụkụ ndị na-emegide onwe ha nke quadrilateral dị n'ime gburugburu bụ $180^\circ$.

math-m3-l1.title: Mgbọrọgwụ square na ọnụọgụgụ n'ezie
math-m3-l1.concept: $\sqrt{a}$ bụ ọnụọgụgụ na-adịghị mma nke square ya bụ $a$. Wepụ square zuru oke dị n'okpuru akara mgbọrọgwụ, ma mee ka denominator nwere mgbọrọgwụ bụrụ ntụle.

math-m3-l2.title: Usoro ịmụba na factoring
math-m3-l2.concept: $(a+b)^2=a^2+2ab+b^2$, $(a+b)(a-b)=a^2-b^2$. Factoring bụ iji usoro ịmụba n'ụzọ ntụgharị.

math-m3-l3.title: Akụkụ quadratic
math-m3-l3.concept: Jiri factoring mee ka ọ bụrụ ụdị $AB=0$ ka ị dozie ya. Discriminant $D=b^2-4ac$ na-egosi ọnụọgụgụ mgbọrọgwụ, ma ị nwekwara ike iji mmekọrịta mgbọrọgwụ na coefficients.

math-m3-l4.title: Ọrụ quadratic na eserese ya
math-m3-l4.concept: Vertex nke $y=a(x-p)^2+q$ bụ $(p,\ q)$, ma akara nke $a$ na-ekpebi ntụzi ọnụ ọnụ. Gbanwee ya ka ọ bụrụ square zuru oke ka ịchọta vertex.

math-m3-l5.title: Ọnụọgụgụ mpịakọta atọ
math-m3-l5.concept: N'ihe atọ nwere akụkụ ziri ezi, $\sin A=\frac{\text{akụkụ megidere} }{\text{hypotenuse} }$, $\cos A=\frac{\text{akụkụ dị nso} }{\text{hypotenuse} }$, $\tan A=\frac{\text{akụkụ megidere} }{\text{akụkụ dị nso} }$.

math-m3-sta1.title: Nkesa na gbagọrọ agbagọ ọkọlọtọ
math-m3-sta1.concept: **Gbagọrọ agbagọ**=(uru)−(nkezi). **Nkesa** bụ nkezi nke ọnụọgụ abụọ nke gbagọrọ agbagọ, **gbagọrọ agbagọ ọkọlọtọ** bụkwa mgbọrọgwụ n'ọnụọgụ abụọ dị mma nke nkesa. Ka uru ahụ buru ibu, otú ahụ ka data na-agbasa n'ebe dị anya site na nkezi.

m-m2-ineq-v3.prompt: Otu akpa achịcha na-efu 500 won, otu karama ihe ọṅụṅụ na-efu 1500 won. Ọ bụrụ na a zụrụ karama ihe ọṅụṅụ 2 ma were 6000 won ma ọ bụ ihe pere mpe, ole akpa achịcha kacha ọtụtụ ka a ga-azụta? (dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)

m-m2-ineq-v4.prompt: Ole integer $x$ niile na-eju inequality $-2 < 3x+1 \le 13$ anya? (dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)

m-m2-lfn1-1.prompt: Gịnị bụ slope nke linear function $y=2x-3$?

m-m2-rec1-v2.prompt: Mgbe e dere ntakịrị $\frac{5}{12}$ ka decimal, ọ̀ bụ terminating decimal?

m-m2-sys-1.prompt: N'ime system of equations $\begin{cases} y=2x+1 \\ x+y=7 \end{cases}$, gịnị bụ uru $x$? (dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)

m-m2-sys-2.prompt: Ego iwu ịbanye maka okenye bụ 3000 won, nke nwa bụ 2000 won. Mmadụ 10 niile banyere wee kwụọ 24000 won. Ole okenye ka ha bụ? (dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)

m-m2-sys-3.prompt: Kedu system of equations nke ya na $(x,\,y)=(4,\,1)$ bụ azịza?
m-m2-sys-3.explanation: System of equations nke $4+1=5$ na $4-1=3$ abụọ dị irè bụ azịza.
hints: Tinye uru x na y n'system ọ bụla wee lelee ma nhatanha abụọ dị irè.
Ọ bụrụ na naanị otu nhatanha dị irè, ọ bụghị azịza.

m-m2-sys-4.prompt: Ka $(x,\,y)$ bụrụ azịza nke system of equations $\begin{cases} 2x+y=8 \\ x-y=1 \end{cases}$. Gịnị bụ uru $x$? (dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
m-m2-sys-4.explanation: Mgbe e dozichara nhatanha abụọ ahụ, $x=3$, $y=2$.
hints: Gbakọta ma ọ bụ wepụ nhatanha abụọ ka otu mkpụrụedemede pụọ (elimination).
Ọ bụrụ na ọ dị mkpa, kpọọ otu nhatanha site na ọnụọgụgụ ka coefficient hà nhata.

m-m2-sys-5.prompt: Nna dị afọ 28 karịa nwa ya nwoke, ma ngụkọta afọ ha abụọ bụ 52. Afọ ole ka nna ahụ dị? (dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
m-m2-sys-5.explanation: Mgbe e gbakọtara nhatanha abụọ ahụ, $2x=80$, $x=40$, ya mere nna ahụ dị afọ 40.

m-m2-sys-d1.prompt: Ka $(x,\,y)$ bụrụ azịza nke system of equations $\begin{cases} x+y=4 \\ 2x-y=-1 \end{cases}$. Gịnị bụ uru $x$? (dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)

Ọ bụrụ na ọ dị mkpa, kpọọ otu nhatanha site na ọnụọgụgụ ka coefficient hà nhata.

m-m2-sys-d2.prompt: System of equations $\begin{cases} 2x+4y=6 \\ x+2y=5 \end{cases}$ nwere azịza enweghị njedebe.
m-m2-sys-d2.explanation: Mgbe a kpọrọ nhatanha nke abụọ site na 2, ọ bụ $2x+4y=10$, nke na-emegide nke mbụ. Ọ nweghị azịza.
hints: Kpọọ otu nhatanha site na ọnụọgụgụ kwesịrị ekwesị wee tụnyere ya na nke ọzọ.
Ọ bụrụ na coefficient nke x na y hà nhata ma constant term hà nhata, e nwere azịza enweghị njedebe.

m-m2-sys-v1.prompt: N'usoro nhata $\begin{cases} y=3x+2 \\ x+y=10 \end{cases}$, kedu uru nke $x$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Tinye y nke nhata mbụ n'ime nhata nke abụọ (usoro nnọchi).

m-m2-sys-v2.prompt: Ụgwọ ntinye nke okenye bụ 5000 won, nke ụmụaka bụ 3000 won. Ọ bụrụ na mmadụ 8 niile banyere ma kwụọ 30000 won, okenye ole ka ha bụ? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
m-m2-sys-v2.explanation: Ịdozi usoro nhata na-enye $x=3$, $y=5$, ya mere okenye bụ mmadụ 3.
hints: Were okenye dị ka x, ụmụaka dị ka y, wee dee nhata abụọ site na ọnụọgụ mmadụ na ego.

m-m2-sys-v3.prompt: Kedu usoro nhata nke ngwọta ya bụ $(x,\,y)=(5,\,2)$?

m-m2-sys-v4.prompt: Mgbe ngwọta nke usoro nhata $\begin{cases} x+2y=4 \\ 3x-y=5 \end{cases}$ bụ $(x,\,y)$, kedu uru nke $x$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)

m-m3-fact-1.prompt: Mgbe $(x+2)(x+3) = x^2+px+q$, kedu uru nke $p+q$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)

m-m3-fact-2.prompt: Kedu ka e si kewaa $x^2+7x+10$ n'ihe mụbara?
m-m3-fact-2.explanation: Ọnụọgụ abụọ nke ngụkọta ha bụ 7 na ngwaahịa ha bụ 10 bụ 2, 5, ya mere $(x+2)(x+5)$.

ai_gradMse.prompt: A na-eji ụdị $\hat{y}=wx$ buo amụma maka isi {pts}. Ọrụ mfu bụ $L(w)=\dfrac{1}{n}\sum(wx_i-y_i)^2$ ($n$ bụ ọnụọgụ isi). Site na $w_0={w0}$, jiri ọnụọgụ mmụta $\eta={eta}$, kedu uru nke $w_1=w_0-\eta L'(w_0)$ mgbe e tinyere gradient descent otu ugboro? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: $L'(w)=\dfrac{2}{n}\sum x_i(wx_i-y_i)$.
Tinye $w=w_0$ ka ịchọta ntụgharị $L'(w_0)$ buru ụzọ.

ai_gradStep.prompt: Mgbe ọrụ mfu bụ $L(w)={lw}$, a na-achọ ibelata uru a site na gradient descent. Mgbe $w_{n+1}=w_n-\eta L'(w_n)$, ọnụọgụ mmụta $\eta={eta}$, uru mbụ $w_0={w0}$, kedu uru nke $w_{{t}}$ mgbe e mere mmelite {t} ugboro? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Buru ụzọ chọta $L'(w)$.
Gbakọọ $w_1$, $w_2$, ... n'usoro site na $w_0$.

ai_jaccard.prompt: E nyere okwu dị n'akwụkwọ okwu nọmba site na $1$ ruo $12$. Set nke nọmba okwu ndị pụtara na akwụkwọ A bụ $A=\{{sa}\}$, nke akwụkwọ B bụ $B=\{{sb}\}$. Gịnị bụ uru nke Jaccard similarity $\dfrac{n(A\cap B)}{n(A\cup B)}$ nke akwụkwọ abụọ ahụ? (Dee ya dị ka ntakịrị nke enweghị ike ibelata ọzọ. Ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu, dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụ zuru ezu. Ọmụmaatụ: 3/4)
hints: $A\cap B$ bụ set nke nọmba okwu ndị pụtara n'akwụkwọ abụọ ahụ.
$n(A\cup B)=n(A)+n(B)-n(A\cap B)$.
ai_jaccard.explanation: $n(A\cap B)={ni}$, $n(A\cup B)={nu}$, ya mere $\frac{{ni}}{{nu}}$, ma mgbe e gosipụtara ntakịrị a n'ụdị enweghị ike ibelata ọzọ, ọ bụ ${fr}$.

ai_jaccardRev.prompt: Okwu dị iche ${na}$ pụtara n'akwụkwọ A, ${nb}$ pụtakwara n'akwụkwọ B. Ka set okwu nke akwụkwọ abụọ ahụ bụrụ $A$, $B$, ma Jaccard similarity $\dfrac{n(A\cap B)}{n(A\cup B)}$ bụ $\dfrac{{jp}}{{jq}}$. Ole okwu dị iche ka pụtara n'akwụkwọ abụọ ahụ? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: Ọ bụrụ na ọnụọgụ okwu nkịtị bụ $x$, $n(A\cup B)=n(A)+n(B)-x$.
Dozie $\dfrac{x}{{na}+{nb}-x}=\dfrac{{jp}}{{jq}}$ dị ka nha anya nke $x$.
ai_jaccardRev.explanation: Ebe $n(A\cup B)={na}+{nb}-x$, $\frac{x}{{na}+{nb}-x}=\frac{{jp}}{{jq}}$, ma ịdozi ya na-enye $x={ans}$.

ai_mseLoss.prompt: Maka isi {pts}, gịnị bụ uru nke mean squared error (MSE) $\dfrac{1}{n}\sum(y_i-\hat{y}_i)^2$ nke ụdị ahịrị $\hat{y}={model}$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)

Tụọ square nke njehie ndị ahụ, gbakwunye ha niile, wee kewaa site na ọnụọgụ isi $n={np}$.
ai_mseLoss.explanation: Njehie bụ ${res}$ ma nchikota nke square bụ ${sq}$, ya mere MSE bụ $\frac{{tot}}{{np}}={ans}$.

ai_pixelBright.prompt: E gosipụtara ìhè nke pixel (0~255) nke eserese ojii na ọcha site na matriks $A={mat}$. Iji mee ka eserese ahụ dị ìhè, a na-agbanwe ìhè $p$ nke pixel niile ka ọ bụrụ $\min(255,\ {a}p+{b})$. (Uru karịrị 255 na-aghọ 255.) Gịnị bụ nchikota nke akụkụ niile nke matriks eserese gbanwere? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: Maka akụkụ $p$ ọ bụla, buru ụzọ gbakọọ ${a}p+{b}$, ma ọ bụrụ na ọ karịrị 255, gbanwee ya ka ọ bụrụ 255.
Dee matriks ọhụrụ ahụ niile wee gbakwunye akụkụ niile.
ai_pixelBright.explanation: Matriks ọhụrụ bụ $B={res}$, ma nchikota nke akụkụ niile bụ ${ans}$.

hints: Chọta nkezi $\bar{x}$ nke $x$ na nkezi $\bar{y}$ nke $y$. Ahịrị ọnọdụ na-agafe isi $(\bar{x},\bar{y})$.
Mkpọda bụ $a=\dfrac{\sum(x_i-\bar{x})(y_i-\bar{y})}{\sum(x_i-\bar{x})^2}$.

alg_arithFirstExceeds.prompt: Ka $S_n$ bụrụ nchikota site na okwu mbụ ruo okwu nke $n$ nke usoro arithmetic nke okwu mbụ ya bụ ${a}$ ma ọdịiche nkịtị bụ ${d}$. Mgbe $S_n>{N}$, gịnị bụ uru kacha nta nke ọnụọgụ eke $n$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: Dee $S_n=\frac{n(2a+(n-1)d)}{2}$ dị ka okwu quadratic nke $n$.
Dozie enweghị nha anya quadratic ma ọ bụ tinye $n=1,2,3,\dots$ n'usoro ka ị chọta ebe mbụ ọ na-agafe.
alg_arithFirstExceeds.explanation: $S_n=\frac{n(2\times{ab}+(n-1)\times{d})}{2}$, ma mgbe $n=1,2,\dots,{m1}$, $S_n$ niile bụ ${N}$ ma ọ bụ pere mpe (uru kachasị ukwuu bụ ${s1}$), ebe $S_{{ans}}={s2}>{N}$, ya mere $n$ achọrọ bụ ${ans}$.

alg_arithGeoMix.prompt: Ọnụọgụ atọ $x$, $y$, $z$ n'usoro a na-etolite usoro arithmetic nwere ọdịiche dị mma, ma $x+y+z={S}$. Mgbe ahụ ọnụọgụ atọ $x$, $y$, $z+{k}$ n'usoro a na-etolite usoro geometric. Kedu ọdịiche nke usoro arithmetic ahụ? (Dee naanị nọmba)
hints: Ọ bụrụ na ọdịiche bụ $d$, mgbe ahụ $x=y-d$, $z=y+d$, ma $3y=S$.
Tinye ya n'ọnọdụ nke usoro geometric $y^{2}=x(z+k)$ ka ị nweta nhatanha quadratic maka $d$.
alg_arithGeoMix.explanation: $y=\frac{{S}}{3}={y}$, ma $x={y}-d$, $z={y}+d$, ya mere ${y}^{2}=({y}-d)({y}+d+{k})$, ya bụ $d^{2}+{k}d-{yk}=0$. Ebe ọ bụ na ọdịiche dị mma, $d={ans}$.

alg_arithSumMax.prompt: N'usoro arithmetic $\{a_n\}$, mgbe $a_{{p}}={u}$, $a_{{q}}={v}$, kedu uru kacha ukwuu nke nchikọta $S_n$ site n'okwu mbụ ruo okwu nke $n$? ($n$ bụ ọnụọgụ eke) (Dee naanị nọmba)
hints: Lelee ihe ịrịba ama nke ọdịiche: nchikọta na-abawanye naanị mgbe okwu ndị a na-agbakwunye dị mma.
Chọta okwu mbụ na ọdịiche, mgbe ahụ chọta nchikọta ruo n'ihu okwu mbụ nke bụ $0$ ma ọ bụ nke pere mpe.
alg_arithSumMax.explanation: Okwu mbụ bụ ${a1}$, ọdịiche bụ ${d}$, ya mere $a_n>0$ mgbe $n\le{nm}$, ma $a_{{nm1}}\le0$. Ya mere uru kacha ukwuu bụ $S_{{nm}}=\frac{{nm}(2\times{a1}+({nm}-1)\times({d}))}{2}={ans}$.

alg_arithTwoTerms.prompt: N'usoro arithmetic $\{a_n\}$, mgbe $a_{{p}}={u}$, $a_{{q}}={v}$, kedu uru nke $a_{{r}}$? (Dee naanị nọmba)

alg_arithTwoTermsQ.prompt: N'usoro arithmetic $\{a_n\}$, mgbe $a_{{p}}={u}$, $a_{{q}}={v}$, kedu uru nke $a_{{r}}$? (Ị nwere ike dee ya dị ka ntụpọ ma ọ bụ dị ka akụkụ ọnụọgụ dịka 3/4)
hints: Chọta ọdịiche $d$ site na $a_q-a_p=(q-p)d$.

alg_circumradius.prompt: N'triangle ABC, mgbe $\overline{B C}={side}$ ma ${cond}$, kedu radius nke gburugburu na-agbaso triangle ABC? (Dee ya dị ka akụkụ ọnụọgụ ntakịrị kacha pere mpe. Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu, dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụ zuru ezu. Ọmụmaatụ: 3/4)

alg_collatz.prompt: Ka usoro $\{a_n\}$ bụrụ nke a kọwara dị ka $a_1={s}$, $a_{n+1}=\frac{a_{n}}{2}$ ma ọ bụrụ na $a_n$ bụ ọnụọgụ ụzọ abụọ, ma $a_{n+1}={odd}$ ma ọ bụrụ na $a_n$ bụ ọnụọgụ ọdịmma. Kedu uru kacha pere mpe nke ọnụọgụ eke $n$ nke na-eme ka $a_n=1$? (Dee naanị nọmba)

alg_cosLawSide.prompt: N'triangle ABC, mgbe $\overline{B C}={a}$, $\overline{C A}={b}$ ma ${cond}$, kedu ogologo nke $\overline{A B}$? (Dee naanị nọmba)

hints: (Okwu nke na-esote)÷(okwu nke gara aga) bụ ike nke ratio nkịtị $r$ n'ogo ọdịiche nke nọmba okwu.

alg_growthYears.prompt: A na-edebe ego n'ụlọ akụ na compound interest nke ọnụego kwa afọ ${rate}\%$, ebe a na-agbakwunye ọmụrụ nwa n'isi ego kwa afọ.
