hints: Ike nke $i$ na-emeghari $i,\ -1,\ -i,\ 1$ n'usoro a. Ọ bụrụ na $z$ siri ike, buru ụzọ mee ka ọ dị mfe n'ụdị $a+bi$.
N'ihi na $z^4=1$, ike nke $z$ na-emeghari otu uru n'ime $4$ ọ bụla. Lee naanị ihe fọdụrụ mgbe e kewara ike ahụ site na $4$.
cm1_iPower.explanation: Buru ụzọ mee ka ọ dị mfe: $z={zs}$ ma $z^4=1$. Mgbe e gbanwere ike ahụ n'ihe fọdụrụ mgbe e kewara ya site na $4$, ${work}$. Ya mere nchikota akụkụ ezigbo ọnụọgụgụ na akụkụ e chere bụ ${ans}$.

cm1_iPowerSum.prompt: Ọ bụrụ na $z={z}$, kedu nchikota akụkụ ezigbo ọnụọgụgụ na akụkụ e chere nke ${expr}$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Buru ụzọ mee ka $z$ dị mfe n'ụdị $a+bi$, wee lee ma $z^4=1$. Mgbe ahụ ị ga-amata uru nchikota ike anọ na-esochi ibe ha $z+z^2+z^3+z^4$.
Mgbe e kekọtara okwu anọ anọ, nchikota nke otu ọ bụla hà nhata. Okwu fọdụrụ na njedebe bụ ọnụọgụgụ ihe fọdụrụ mgbe e kewara ọnụọgụgụ okwu site na $4$.
cm1_iPowerSum.explanation: Buru ụzọ mee ka ọ dị mfe: $z={zs}$, ya mere $z^4=1$ ma $z+z^2+z^3+z^4=0$. Mgbe e kekọtara okwu anọ anọ, nchikota nke otu ọ bụla bụ $0$, ma ${n}={q4}\times4+{rm}$, ya mere okwu fọdụrụ bụ naanị ${rm}$ mbụ, ya mere ${work}$. Ya mere nchikota akụkụ ezigbo ọnụọgụgụ na akụkụ e chere bụ ${ans}$.

cm1_identity.prompt: N'ihe nhata ọgbọrọ (identity) n'ihe $x$ ${lhs}={rhs}$, maka ọnụọgụgụ adịghị agbanwe ${consts}$, kedu uru ${ask}$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Identity bụ ọkwa na-emezu maka uru ọ bụla nke $x$. Ị nwere ike gbasaa akụkụ aka ekpe ma tụnyere coefficient nke otu ogo.
Mgbe $x={p}$, ọkwa dị n'ime mkpuchi ghọrọ $0$. Ịtinye uru a na-enye uru nke okwu na-agbanwe agbanwe ozugbo.
cm1_identity.explanation: Site n'ịtụnyere coefficient ma ọ bụ itinye uru kwesịrị ekwesị maka $x$, ${sol}$. Ya mere ${ask}={ans}$.

cm1_linIneqCount.prompt: N'ime ọgbọrọ nke usoro ahaghị nhata ${i1}$, ${i2}$, ole ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu $x$ dị? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Dozie ahaghị nhata ọ bụla n'otu n'otu iji chọta oke $x$, wee chọta akụkụ nkịtị. Mgbe ị na-amụba ma ọ bụ kewaa akụkụ abụọ site n'ọnụọgụgụ adịghị mma, akara ahaghị nhata na-agbanwe ntụzịaka.
Seere oke abụọ ahụ n'ahịrị ọnụọgụgụ ma gụọ ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu dị n'akụkụ ha na-agbakọta. Lezie anya ma e nwere akara hà nhata.
cm1_linIneqCount.explanation: Ọgbọrọ nke ọkwa nke mbụ bụ ${s1}$, nke ọkwa nke abụọ bụ ${s2}$, ya mere oke nkịtị bụ ${s}$. Ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu $x$ na-emezu nke a bụ ${ints}$, ha niile bụ ${ans}$.

cm1_linIneqParam.prompt: N'ime ihe ngwọta nke enweghị nhata ${i1}$, ${i2}$, ọ bụrụ na ọnụọgụ zuru ezu $x$ bụ ${n}$ kpọmkwem, kedu ngụkọta uru niile nke ọnụọgụ zuru ezu $k$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Buru ụzọ dozie enweghị nhata na-enweghị $k$ ka ịchọta oke $x$, wee kọwaa oke $x$ nke enweghị nhata nke ọzọ site na $k$.
Tụlee n'etiti ọnụọgụ zuru ezu ndị ọ bụla njedebe ahụ kwesịrị ịdị ka ọnụọgụ zuru ezu ${n}$ kpọmkwem nọrọ n'etiti oke abụọ ahụ.
cm1_linIneqParam.explanation: Ngwọta nke nke mbụ bụ ${s1}$, nke nke abụọ bụ ${s2}$. Ka ọnụọgụ zuru ezu $x$ bụrụ ${n}$ kpọmkwem, ${kr}$ ga-adị, ya mere ọnụọgụ zuru ezu $k$ bụ ${ks}$, ma ngụkọta ya bụ ${ans}$.

cm1_matCayley.prompt: Maka matrix $A={A}$, $E={Emat}$, e nwere ọnụọgụ n'ezie $p$, $q$ na-eme ka $A^{{n}}=pA+qE$ ziri ezi. Kedu uru nke ${ask}$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Gbakọọ $A^{{n}}$ n'ụzọ ozugbo site na mmụba matrix ka ịchọta ihe ndị ahụ.
Kọwaa ihe nke $pA+qE$ site na $p$, $q$ wee tụnyere ha na ihe nke $A^{{n}}$; ị ga-enweta usoro ọnụọgụ maka $p$, $q$.
cm1_matCayley.explanation: $A^{{n}}={Apow}$, ma ọ bụrụ na e tụnyere ya na ihe nke $pA+qE$, $p={p}$, $q={q}$. Ya mere ${ask}={ans}$.

cm1_matWord.prompt: N'ụlọ ahịa abụọ A, B, a na-ere ihe ${ni}$ ụdị. Ihe (i, j) nke matrix $P={mp}$ bụ ọnụ ahịa (won) nke otu ihe nke j n'ụlọ ahịa i (ahịrị 1: ụlọ ahịa A, ahịrị 2: ụlọ ahịa B), ma ihe (j, l) nke matrix $Q={mq}$ bụ ọnụọgụ ihe nke j nke onye nke l n'etiti Gap (ogidi 1) na Eul (ogidi 2) chọrọ ịzụta. Gap na Eul nke ọ bụla na-azụta ihe niile ha chọrọ n'otu ụlọ ahịa, ma ha abụọ na-ahọrọ ụlọ ahịa ọnụ ahịa dị ọnụ ala, kedu ngụkọta ego ha abụọ ga-akwụ n'ime won? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Ego onye l ga-akwụ n'ụlọ ahịa i bụ ngụkọta nke ịmụba ihe nke ahịrị i nke $P$ na nke ogidi l nke $Q$ n'usoro.
Uru ndị ahụ bụ ihe nke matrix $PQ$. Chọta $PQ$ wee họrọ uru dị ala n'ogidi ọ bụla wee tinye ha.
cm1_matWord.explanation: $PQ={pq}$. Ego Gap ga-akwụ bụ ${pq11}$ won n'ụlọ ahịa A, ${pq21}$ won n'ụlọ ahịa B, ya mere nke dị ọnụ ala bụ ${m1}$ won; Eul ga-akwụ ${pq12}$ won n'ụlọ ahịa A, ${pq22}$ won n'ụlọ ahịa B, ya mere nke dị ọnụ ala bụ ${m2}$ won. Ya mere ngụkọta bụ ${ans}$ won.

cm1_omega.prompt: Ọ bụrụ na otu mgbọrọgwụ dị mgbagwoju anya nke akụkụ abụọ ${eq}$ bụ $\omega$, kedu uru nke ${expr}$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Ọ bụrụ na ị mụbaa akụkụ abụọ nke akụkụ abụọ ahụ site na $x-1$ ma ọ bụ $x+1$, ị ga-amata uru $\omega^3$.
Ọ bụrụ na $\omega^3=\pm1$, $\omega^6=1$. Lekwasị anya naanị n'ihe fọdụrụ mgbe e kewara ngosi site na oge.
cm1_omega.explanation: Ebe $\omega$ bụ mgbọrọgwụ nke ${eq}$, ${rel}$. Ya mere ike na-alọghachi n'otu uru n'ime ${per}$ ọ bụla, ma ọ bụrụ na e tụlee naanị ihe fọdụrụ mgbe e kewara ngosi site na ${per}$, ${step}$. Ya mere uru a chọrọ bụ ${ans}$.

cm1_parabolaLine.prompt: Mgbe parabola na ahịrị ndị a metụrụ ibe ha, kedu uru nke oge $k$? (parabola $y={f}$, ahịrị $y={g}$) (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Imetụ pụtara na akụkụ abụọ e nwetara site na ijikọ ha abụọ nwere otu mgbọrọgwụ okpukpu abụọ.
Mee ka discriminant nke akụkụ abụọ e nwetara mgbe e wepụrụ $y$ n'ime ha abụọ bụrụ $0$.
cm1_parabolaLine.explanation: Site na ${f}={g}$, ${eq2}=0$, ma ebe ha na-emetụ, discriminant $D=({bm})^2-4\cdot({a})\cdot({c}-k)=0$. Ịdozi ya na-enye $k={ans}$.

cm1_parabolaLineCount.prompt: N'ime ${lo}\le k\le {hi}$, ọnụọgụ zuru ezu $k$ ole na-eme ka parabola na ahịrị ndị a ghara izute? (parabola $y={f}$, ahịrị $y={g}$) (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Ịghara izute pụtara na akụkụ abụọ e nwetara site na ijikọ ha abụọ enweghị mgbọrọgwụ n'ezie.
Chọta oke $k$ nke discriminant $D<0$ nke akụkụ abụọ e nwetara mgbe e wepụrụ $y$ n'ime ha abụọ, wee gụọ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu dị n'ime ya.
cm1_parabolaLineCount.explanation: Site na ${f}={g}$, ${eq2}=0$, ma ka ha ghara izute, discriminant $D<0$ ga-adị. Site na $D=({bm})^2-4\cdot({a})\cdot({c}-k)={dk}<0$, ${kr}$, ya mere ọnụọgụ zuru ezu n'ime ${lo}\le k\le {hi}$ bụ ${ks}$, ma ngụkọta bụ ${ans}$.

cm1_parabolaXaxis.prompt: Ọ bụrụ na eserese nke ọrụ quadratic $y={f}$ zutere axis $x$ n'ebe abụọ dị iche, ma ebe dị n'etiti ebe abụọ ahụ bụ ${d}$, kedu uru nkịtị $k$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: Nhazi $x$ nke ebe abụọ a na-ezute bụ mgbọrọgwụ abụọ nke akụkụ ${f}=0$.
Ọ bụrụ na mgbọrọgwụ abụọ bụ $\alpha$, $\beta$, ebe dị n'etiti ebe abụọ bụ $|\alpha-\beta|$, ma $(\alpha-\beta)^2=(\alpha+\beta)^2-4\alpha\beta$.
cm1_parabolaXaxis.explanation: Nhazi $x$ nke ebe a na-ezute $\alpha$, $\beta$ bụ mgbọrọgwụ abụọ nke ${f}=0$, ya mere $\alpha+\beta={sm}$. Site na $(\alpha-\beta)^2=({sm})^2-4\alpha\beta={d}^2$, $\alpha\beta={ab}$, ma site n'njikọ mgbọrọgwụ na ọnụọgụ, $\alpha\beta=\frac{k}{{p}}$, ya mere $k={ans}$.

cm1_permArrange.prompt: Mgbe e doro ụmụ nwoke ${m}$ na ụmụ nwaanyị ${w}$ n'ahịrị, kedu ọnụọgụ ụzọ e si edozi ha ka ụmụ nwaanyị abụọ ọ bụla ghara ịbụ ndị agbata obi? (Ụmụ akwụkwọ niile dị iche.) (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: Ọ dị mfe itinye ndị na-agaghị abụ ndị agbata obi (ụmụ nwaanyị) n'ikpeazụ. Buru ụzọ doo ụmụ nwoke n'ahịrị.
E nwere ebe ụmụ nwaanyị ga-anọ n'etiti ụmụ nwoke na n'ọnụ abụọ. Họrọ ebe dị iche n'ime ha doo ụmụ nwaanyị.
cm1_permArrange.explanation: Ụzọ e si buru ụzọ doo ụmụ nwoke ${m}$ bụ ${m}!={mf}$. Ụzọ e si họrọ ebe ${w}$ dị iche n'ime ebe ${m1}$ dị n'etiti ụmụ nwoke na n'ọnụ abụọ doo ụmụ nwaanyị bụ ${}_{{m1}}\mathrm{P}_{{w}}={pv}$. Ya mere ${mf}\times{pv}={ans}$ ụzọ.

cm1_permNumbers.prompt: E nwere kaadị ${nc}$ nke nwere ọnụọgụ dị iche n'otu n'otu, ọnụọgụ edere bụ ${digs}$. Mgbe a họrọ kaadị ${r}$ n'ime ha doo ha n'ahịrị mee ọnụọgụ nwere ọnụọgụ ${r}$, ole ka ọnụọgụ ndị bụ ọtụtụ nke ${m}$ dị? ($0$ enweghị ike ịbụ ọnụọgụ mbụ.) (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: Ọnụọgụ nke ${m}$ bụ ọtụtụ ya na-adabere na ọnụọgụ ikpeazụ. Buru ụzọ chọpụta ọnụọgụ nwere ike ịbụ ikpeazụ.
Mgbe ị họọrọ ọnụọgụ ikpeazụ, họrọ ọnụọgụ mbụ n'ime ndị abụghị $0$, ma jiri kaadị fọdụrụ juo ebe ndị ọzọ (iwu ngwaahịa).
cm1_permNumbers.explanation: Ọnụọgụ nwere ike ịbụ ikpeazụ bụ ${Lstr}$. Maka nke ọ bụla, chọta (ọnụọgụ ụzọ e si họrọ ọnụọgụ mbụ)$\times$(ọnụọgụ ụzọ e si ju ebe ndị ọzọ), mgbe ahụ gbakwunye, ọ bụ ${work}={ans}$.

cm1_polyDivQR.prompt: Maka polynomial $P(x)={pp}$, ọ bụrụ na ihe e nwetara mgbe e kewara $P(x)\div({dv})$ bụ $Q(x)$ ma ihe fọdụrụ bụ $R(x)$, kedu uru $Q({t})+R({t})$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: Kewaa okwu ndị kacha elu ka ịchọpụta okwu mbụ nke ihe e nwetara, mụbaa ya na onye na-akewa ma wepụ, mee ya ugboro ugboro.
Okwu mbụ nke ihe e nwetara bụ ${qlead}$, ma ogo ihe fọdụrụ dị ala karịa ogo onye na-akewa.
cm1_polyDivQR.explanation: Mgbe e kewara ya, $P(x)=({dv})({qq})+({rr})$, ya mere $Q(x)={qq}$, $R(x)={rr}$. Ya mere $Q({t})+R({t})={ans}$.

cm1_polyProdCoef.prompt: Maka polynomial abụọ $A={pa}$, $B={pb}$, kedu ọnụọgụ nke $x^{{k}}$ mgbe e gbasara $AB$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: Ị chọghị ịgbasa $AB$ niile. Chọta naanị ụzọ okwu ndị ngwaahịa ha bụ $x^{{k}}$.
Maka ụzọ ọ bụla nke okwu $A$ na okwu $B$ nke ogo ha gbakwunyere bụ ${k}$, mụbaa ọnụọgụ ha ma gbakwunye uru ndị a niile.
cm1_polyProdCoef.explanation: Mgbe e gbakwunyere ngwaahịa ọnụọgụ nke okwu ndị ngwaahịa ha bụ $x^{{k}}$, ọ bụ ${terms}={ans}$. (Mgbe e gbasara ya n'ezie, $AB={prod}$.)

cm1_quadFence.prompt: Site na waya ogologo ${L}$ m, a chọrọ ime ogige nwere ọdịdị rectangle nke otu akụkụ ya na-esi n'ahụ mgbidi, wee guzo ${j}$ nkewa nke na-eguzo ọtọ n'ahụ mgbidi iji kewaa oghere ahụ. Ọ bụrụ na a naghị eji waya n'akụkụ mgbidi, ma e ji otu waya ahụ mee nkewa ndị ahụ, gịnị bụ uru kacha ukwuu nke mpaghara ogige niile n'ime $\mathrm{m}^2$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Ka ogologo akụkụ na-eguzo ọtọ n'ahụ mgbidi bụrụ $x$ m, wee gụọ ole akụkụ ndị dị otú ahụ dị n'ozuzu ha.
Gosi ogologo akụkụ na-agbanye mgbidi site na $x$, mee ka mpaghara bụrụ quadratic nke $x$, wee chọta vertex.
cm1_quadFence.explanation: Akụkụ ndị na-eguzo ọtọ n'ahụ mgbidi bụ 2 n'ọnụ abụọ na ${j}$ nkewa, ya mere ${k}$ n'ozuzu, ma ogologo akụkụ na-agbanye mgbidi bụ $({L}-{k}x)$ m. Mpaghara $S(x)=x({L}-{k}x)$ bụ kacha ukwuu na $x={u}$, ma uru kacha ukwuu bụ ${ans}$ $\mathrm{m}^2$.

cm1_quadIneqAlways.prompt: Ole integer $k$ ka na-eme ka azịza inequality ${ineq}$ bụrụ real number niile? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Ebe coefficient nke $x^2$ bụ $k$, kewaa ya n'ọnọdụ $k=0$ na nke ọzọ. Ọ bụrụ na $k\ne0$, ọ ga-abụ concave up ma discriminant ga-abụ $D<0$ (ma ọ bụ $D\le0$).
Dee discriminant $D$ dị ka expression nke $k$, wee dozie inequality. Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ concave down ($k<0$), ọ nweghị ike ịdị irè maka real number niile.
cm1_quadIneqAlways.explanation: Ọ bụrụ na $k=0$, akụkụ aka ekpe bụ naanị constant ${n}$ ma uru a karịrị $0$, ya mere inequality na-adị irè mgbe niile. Ọ bụrụ na $k\ne0$, ọ ga-abụ concave up, ya mere $k>0$ ma $\frac{D}{4}={d4}{rel}0$ ga-adị, nke ndozi ya bụ ${kr}$. Ya mere, tinyere $k=0$, integer $k$ bụ ${ks}$, ya mere ha bụ ${ans}$ n'ozuzu.

cm1_quadIneqSol.prompt: Ọ bụrụ na azịza quadratic inequality ${mx2}+ax+b{op}0$ bụ ${sol}$, gịnị bụ uru ${ask}$ maka constant $a$ na $b$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Uru abụọ n'ọnụ azịza inequality bụ mgbọrọgwụ abụọ nke quadratic equation ${mx2}+ax+b=0$.
Dee quadratic dị ka (coefficient nke $x^2$)$\times(x-\alpha)(x-\beta)$ wee tụnyere ya na ụdị e gbasaara.
cm1_quadIneqSol.explanation: Ebe azịza bụ ${sol}$, mgbọrọgwụ abụọ bụ ${lo}$ na ${hi}$, ma ebe coefficient nke $x^2$ bụ ${m}$, ${mx2}+ax+b={fac}={full}$. Ya mere $a={a}$, $b={b}$ ma ${ask}={ans}$.

cm1_quadRange.prompt: Gịnị bụ ngụkọta nke uru kacha ukwuu na uru kacha nta nke function $y={f}$ mgbe ${m}\le x\le {n}$? (Lekwa: $x$ bụ real number.) (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Maka quadratic function, buru ụzọ lelee ma $x$-coordinate nke vertex dị n'interval e nyere.
Ọ bụrụ na vertex dị n'interval, tụnyere uru function na vertex na ọnụ abụọ; ọ bụrụ na ọ nọ n'èzí, tụnyere uru na ọnụ abụọ.
cm1_quadRange.explanation: Vertex nke function a bụ $({h},{kv})$, ma uru $y$ n'ọnụ abụọ nke interval bụ ${fm}$ mgbe $x={m}$ na ${fn}$ mgbe $x={n}$. Lelee ma $x$-coordinate nke vertex dị n'interval ${m}\le x\le {n}$, wee chọta uru kacha ukwuu na kacha nta; ngụkọta ha bụ ${ans}$.

cm1_quadRevenue.prompt: Ngwaahịa nke ọnụ ahịa mbụ ya bụ ${w}$ won, ọ bụrụ na e rere ya ${a}$ won n'otu, a na-ere ${b}$ kwa ụbọchị. Oge ọ bụla e welitere ahịa ire ${s}$ won, ọnụọgụgụ ire kwa ụbọchị na-ebelata ${c}$. Ọ bụrụ na enwere ike ịbawanye ahịa ire ${s}$ won ugboro integer ọ bụla (gụnyere ugboro $0$), gịnị bụ uru kacha ukwuu kwa ụbọchị na won? (A na-agbakọ uru dị ka (ahịa ire $-$ ọnụ ahịa mbụ)$\times$(ọnụọgụgụ e rere).) (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Ka ugboro a welitere ahịa bụrụ $t$ wee gosi ahịa ire na ọnụọgụgụ ire site na $t$.
(Uru n'otu ngwaahịa)$\times$(ọnụọgụgụ e rere) bụ quadratic nke $t$. Lelee ma $t$ nke vertex bụ integer.
cm1_quadRevenue.explanation: Ọ bụrụ na ugboro a welitere ahịa bụ $t$, uru n'otu ngwaahịa bụ $({e1}+{s}t)$ won, ọnụọgụgụ e rere bụ $({b}-{c}t)$, ya mere uru bụ $({e1}+{s}t)({b}-{c}t)$ won. Quadratic a bụ kacha ukwuu na $t={tstar}$, ma uru n'oge ahụ bụ ${ans}$ won.

cm1_remQuadDiv.prompt: Maka polynomial $P(x)$, ihe fọdụrụ nke $P(x)\div({dv1})$ bụ ${r1}$ ma ihe fọdụrụ nke $P(x)\div({dv2})$ bụ ${r2}$. Ka ihe fọdụrụ nke $P(x)\div\left(({dv1})({dv2})\right)$ bụrụ $R(x)$, kedu uru $R({c})$? (Dee naanị nọmba)
hints: Ihe fọdụrụ nke nkesa site na ọkwa ọkwa abụọ bụ ọkwa nke ogo mbụ ma ọ bụ ala. Tinye $R(x)=px+q$.
Na $P(x)=({dv1})({dv2})Q(x)+R(x)$, dochie uru abụọ na-eme ka ihe nkesa bụrụ $0$.
cm1_remQuadDiv.explanation: Ka $R(x)=px+q$, mgbe ahụ $R({a})=P({a})={r1}$, $R({b})=P({b})={r2}$. Mgbe edozichara ọkwa abụọ ahụ ọnụ, $p={p}$, $q={q}$, ya mere $R(x)={Rx}$ ma $R({c})={ans}$.

cm1_remUnknown.prompt: Maka polynomial $P(x)={pp}$, ihe fọdụrụ nke $P(x)\div({dv})$ bụ ${R}$. Kedu uru ihe kwụsiri ike $k$? (Dee naanị nọmba)
hints: Iwu ihe fọdụrụ: ihe fọdụrụ mgbe ekewara polynomial $P(x)$ site na $x-a$ hà $P(a)$.
Uru $x$ na-eme ka ihe nkesa bụrụ $0$ bụ: $x={t}$. Mgbe edochiri uru a n'ime $P(x)$, ọ ghọrọ ọkwa ọkwa mbụ nke $k$.
cm1_remUnknown.explanation: Site n'iwu ihe fọdụrụ, $P({t})={R}$ ga-abụrịrị. Ebe $P({t})={lhs}$, site na ${lhs}={R}$, $k={ans}$.

cm1_rootSignCond.prompt: Na ọkwa ọkwa abụọ ${eq}=0$, kedu ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu kacha nta $k$ nke na-eme ka mgbọrọgwụ ezigbo abụọ dị iche buru ibu karịa ${t}$? (Dee naanị nọmba)
hints: Ka akụkụ aka ekpe bụrụ $f(x)$; okwu a bụ mgbe eserese $y=f(x)$ na-ezute axis $x$ n'ebe abụọ dị iche ma ebe abụọ ahụ niile dị n'aka nri nke $x={t}$.
Lelee ọnọdụ atọ niile: onye na-ekpebi $D>0$, ọnọdụ axis (axis $x>{t}$), na $f({t})>0$.
cm1_rootSignCond.explanation: Na $f(x)={eq}$, ka mgbọrọgwụ abụọ niile buru ibu karịa ${t}$, ọnọdụ atọ ga-ejuru: (i) $\frac{D}{4}={d4}>0$, (ii) axis $x=k$ nwere $k>{t}$, (iii) $f({t})={ft}>0$. Ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu kacha nta $k$ na-eju ha bụ ${ans}$.

cm1_symmetricEval.prompt: Maka ezigbo ọnụọgụgụ $x$, $y$, mgbe ${cond}$, kedu uru ${expr}$? (Dee naanị nọmba)
hints: Gosiputa ọkwa ịchọrọ site na nchikota $x+y$ na ngwaahịa $xy$. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, $x^2+y^2=(x+y)^2-2xy$.
Maka okpukpu atọ, jiri $x^3+y^3=(x+y)^3-3xy(x+y)$; maka okpukpu anọ, buru ụzọ chọta $x^2+y^2$ wee jiri $x^4+y^4=(x^2+y^2)^2-2(xy)^2$.
cm1_symmetricEval.explanation: Mgbe agbanwere usoro ịmụba, ${expr}={work}$. (N'ebe a, $(x-y)^2=(x+y)^2-4xy={dd}\ge0$, ya mere ezigbo ọnụọgụgụ $x$, $y$ na-eju ọnọdụ ahụ dị.) Ya mere uru ịchọrọ bụ ${ans}$.

cm1_symmetricInv.prompt: Maka ezigbo ọnụọgụgụ $x$, mgbe $x+\frac{1}{x}={k}$, kedu uru ${expr}$? (Dee naanị nọmba)
hints: Ngwaahịa $x$ na $\frac{1}{x}$ bụ $1$. Ya mere ọ bụrụ na ị maara uru nchikota $x+\frac{1}{x}$, ị nwere ike ịchọta nchikota ike.
$x^2+\frac{1}{x^2}=\left(x+\frac{1}{x}\right)^2-2$, $x^3+\frac{1}{x^3}=\left(x+\frac{1}{x}\right)^3-3\left(x+\frac{1}{x}\right)$, ma maka okpukpu anọ, mee square $x^2+\frac{1}{x^2}$ otu ugboro ọzọ.
cm1_symmetricInv.explanation: Mgbe agbanwere usoro ịmụba, ${expr}={work}$. (Maka ezigbo ọnụọgụgụ $x$, $\left|x+\frac{1}{x}\right|\ge2$, ya mere ezigbo ọnụọgụgụ na-eju ọnọdụ a dị.) Ya mere uru ịchọrọ bụ ${ans}$.

cm1_sysReal.prompt: N'ime $-{M}\le k\le {M}$, ole ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu $k$ ka na-eme ka usoro ọkwa ${e1}$, ${e2}$ nwee ezigbo ọgbọrọ $(x, y)$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Jiri otu ọkwa wepụ $y$, ọ ga-aghọ ọkwa quadratic n'ihe $x$.
Ka ọ nwee ezigbo ọgbọrọ, discriminant nke ọkwa quadratic ahụ ga-abụ $0$ ma ọ bụ karịa.
cm1_sysReal.explanation: Mgbe e jiri otu ọkwa wepụ $y$, ọ ghọrọ ọkwa quadratic n'ihe $x$, ma ka o nwee ezigbo ọgbọrọ, ${dcond}$ ga-adị. Ya bụ ${kr}$, ya mere ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu n'ime $-{M}\le k\le {M}$ bụ ${ans}$ n'ozuru ha.

cm1_sysTwo.prompt: Ọ bụrụ na ezigbo ọnụọgụgụ $x$, $y$ bụ ọgbọrọ nke usoro ọkwa ${e1}$, ${e2}$, kedu uru kasị ukwuu nke $x$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Kee otu ọkwa n'ihe mgbaji, ma ọ bụ kwuo otu mkpụrụedemede site na nke ọzọ iji belata ọnụọgụgụ mkpụrụedemede.
Chọta ezigbo ọgbọrọ $(x, y)$ niile enwere ike, wee họrọ uru kasị ukwuu nke $x$.
cm1_sysTwo.explanation: Mgbe e dozie usoro ọkwa ahụ, $(x,\ y)={sols}$. N'ime ha, uru kasị ukwuu nke $x$ bụ ${ans}$.

cm1_vietaExpr.prompt: Ka $\alpha$, $\beta$ bụrụ mgbọrọgwụ abụọ nke ọkwa quadratic ${eq}=0$. Kedu uru ${expr}$? (Dee ya dị ka ntakịrị kacha nta. Ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu, dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu. Ọmụmaatụ: 3/4)
hints: Maka ọkwa quadratic $ax^2+bx+c=0$, nchikota mgbọrọgwụ abụọ bụ $-\frac{b}{a}$, ngwaahịa ha bụ $\frac{c}{a}$.
Kwuo ọkwa a na-achọ site na $\alpha+\beta$ na $\alpha\beta$, wee tinye uru.
cm1_vietaExpr.explanation: Site na mmekọrịta n'etiti mgbọrọgwụ na coefficient, $\alpha+\beta={sf}$, $\alpha\beta={pf}$. Ya mere ${expr}={work}={res}$.

cm1_vietaUnknown.prompt: Ka $\alpha$, $\beta$ bụrụ mgbọrọgwụ abụọ nke ọkwa quadratic $x^2-kx{cs}=0$. Ọ bụrụ na ${cond}$, kedu uru $k$ dị mma? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Site na mmekọrịta n'etiti mgbọrọgwụ na coefficient, nchikota mgbọrọgwụ abụọ bụ $k$, ngwaahịa ha bụ ${c}$.
Kwuo ọnọdụ e nyere site na $\alpha+\beta$, $\alpha\beta$, ma ọ bụ setịpụ otu mgbọrọgwụ dị ka mkpụrụedemede ma kwuo nke ọzọ site na ya iji chọta $k$.
cm1_vietaUnknown.explanation: Site na mmekọrịta n'etiti mgbọrọgwụ na coefficient, $\alpha+\beta=k$, $\alpha\beta={c}$. ${work}$ Ya mere $k={ans}$.

cm2_amgmMin.prompt: Mgbe ${dom}$, kedu uru kasị nta nke ${ex}$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Maka ọnụọgụgụ dị mma abụọ $A$, $B$, $A+B\ge 2\sqrt{A\,B}$ (hà nhata mgbe $A=B$).
Jikọọ ha ka ngwaahịa ha bụrụ ọnụọgụgụ adịghị agbanwe wee jiri mmekọrịta n'etiti nkezi arithmetic na geometric, ma lee ma uru $x$ nke na-eme ka hà nhata mezuo nọ n'ime oke ọnọdụ ${dom}$.
cm2_amgmMin.explanation: ${work}$, hà nhata na-emezu mgbe $x={xe}$, uru a nọkwa n'ime oke ọnọdụ ${dom}$. Ya mere uru kasị nta bụ ${ans}$.

cm2_chordLength.prompt: Gburugburu $C$: ${circ}$, ahịrị $l$: ${line}$. Kedu ogologo chord nke $l$ bepụrụ n'ime $C$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Ahịrị kwụ ọtọ si n'etiti gburugburu gaa ahịrị na-ekewa chord ọkara abụọ hà nhata. Buru ụzọ chọta anya n'etiti etiti na ahịrị.
Ọ bụrụ na radius bụ $r$ na anya n'etiti etiti na ahịrị bụ $d$, ogologo chord bụ $2\sqrt{r^2-d^2}$.
cm2_chordLength.explanation: Etiti gburugburu bụ $({cx}, {cy})$, radius bụ ${rad}$. Anya n'etiti etiti na ahịrị bụ $d=\frac{|{la}\times({cx})+({lb})\times({cy})+({lc})|}{\sqrt{({la})^2+({lb})^2}}=\frac{{dh}}{{h}}={d}$, ya mere ogologo chord bụ $2\sqrt{{rad}^2-{d}^2}=2\times{half}={ans}$.

cm2_circleGeneral.prompt: Ọkwa ${eq}$ na-anọchi anya gburugburu. Ọ bụrụ na coordinate nke etiti gburugburu ahụ bụ $(a, b)$ na ogologo radius bụ $r$, kedu uru $a+b+r$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Gbanwee ya ka ọ bụrụ ụdị perfect square $(x-a)^2+(y-b)^2=r^2$ n'ihe $x$ na $y$.
Kewaa akụkụ abụọ site na coefficient nke $x^2$, $y^2$, wee kekọta $x$ ọnụ na $y$ ọnụ iji mee perfect square.
cm2_circleGeneral.explanation: N'ihi na coefficient nke $x^2$ bụ ${kk}$, kewaa akụkụ abụọ site na coefficient a ma gbanwee ya ka ọ bụrụ perfect square, ọ bụ ${std}$. Etiti bụ $({cx}, {cy})$, radius bụ ${rad}$, ya mere $a+b+r={cx}+({cy})+{rad}={ans}$.

cm2_circleTangentAxes.prompt: N'ime gburugburu ndị etiti ha dị na quadrant nke 1 ma metụ axis $x$ na axis $y$ n'otu oge, e nwere gburugburu abụọ ọnụ na-agafe ebe $P({p}, {q})$. Gịnị bụ radius nke gburugburu nwere radius ka ukwuu n'ime abụọ ahụ? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Etiti gburugburu na-metụ axis abụọ na quadrant nke 1 bụ $(r, r)$ ma radius bụ $r$.
Tinye nhazi ebe ahụ n'ime gburugburu $(x-r)^2+(y-r)^2=r^2$ ma dozie akụkụ quadratic nke $r$.
cm2_circleTangentAxes.explanation: Akụkụ gburugburu bụ $(x-r)^2+(y-r)^2=r^2$ ($r>0$) ma ọ na-agafe ebe $P$, ya mere $({p}-r)^2+({q}-r)^2=r^2$, ya bụ $r^2-{u}r+{t}=0$. Mgbe i dozie ya, $r={rs}$ ma ọ bụ $r={rl}$, ya mere radius ka ukwuu bụ ${ans}$.

cm2_compFindG.prompt: Maka ọrụ abụọ $f$, $g$, $f(x)={f}$ ma ọrụ jikọtara $(f\circ g)(x)={comp}$. Gịnị bụ uru $g({t})$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Ebe $(f\circ g)(x)=f(g(x))$, tinye $g(x)$ n'ọnọdụ $x$ n'ime akụkụ $f$.
Site na $f(g(x))={comp}$, dozie akụkụ nke $g(x)$ ka ịchọta $g(x)$, wee tinye $x={t}$.

cm2_compTable.prompt: Ọrụ abụọ $f$, $g$ site na set $X=\{{xset}\}$ gaa $X$ dị ka ndị a. $f$: ${ft}$, $g$: ${gt}$. Ole akụkụ $x$ nke $X$ na-emezu $(f\circ g)(x)=(g\circ f)(x)$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: $(f\circ g)(x)=f(g(x))$, $(g\circ f)(x)=g(f(x))$. Chọta uru abụọ ahụ ọ bụla maka $x$ nke ọ bụla.
Maka $x=1, 2, \dots$, mee tebụl nke $f(g(x))$ na $g(f(x))$ n'usoro wee tụnyere ha.
cm2_compTable.explanation: Mgbe i chọtara $f(g(x))$, $g(f(x))$ maka $x$ nke ọ bụla, ${work}$. Ọnụọgụgụ $x$ nke uru abụọ hà nhata bụ ${ans}$.

cm2_divPoint.prompt: Maka ebe abụọ $A({x1}, {y1})$, $B({x2}, {y2})$, e nwere ebe $P$ nke na-ekewa akụkụ $AB$ n'ime. Mgbe $\overline{A P}:\overline{P B}={m}:{n}$, gịnị bụ ngụkọta nke $x$-nhazi na $y$-nhazi nke ebe $P$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Nhazi nke ebe na-ekewa akụkụ $AB$ n'ime n'ọnụ ọgụgụ $m:n$ bụ $\left(\frac{mx_2+nx_1}{m+n},\ \frac{my_2+ny_1}{m+n}\right)$.
Chọta $x$-nhazi na $y$-nhazi n'otu n'otu wee tinye ha. $x$-nhazi bụ $\frac{{m}\times({x2})+{n}\times({x1})}{{m}+{n}}$.
cm2_divPoint.explanation: $P\left(\frac{{m}\times({x2})+{n}\times({x1})}{{m}+{n}},\ \frac{{m}\times({y2})+{n}\times({y1})}{{m}+{n}}\right)=({px}, {py})$, ya mere ngụkọta nhazi abụọ bụ ${px}+({py})={ans}$.

cm2_divRatioFind.prompt: N'ime ebe atọ $A({x1}, {y1})$, $B({x2}, {y2})$, $P({px}, {py})$, ebe $P$ dị n'akụkụ $AB$ ma $\overline{A P}:\overline{P B}=m:n$. Ọ bụrụ na $m$, $n$ bụ ọnụọgụgụ okike dị n'etiti onwe ha, gịnị bụ uru $m+n$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Ọ bụrụ na $P$ na-ekewa $AB$ n'ime n'ọnụ ọgụgụ $m:n$, $x$-nhazi bụ $\frac{mx_2+nx_1}{m+n}$. Site na nhazi $P$, chọta ọnụ ọgụgụ ahụ n'ụzọ ntụgharị.
Site na ọdịiche nke $x$-nhazi, chọta $\overline{A P}:\overline{P B}=|p_x-x_1|:|x_2-p_x|$ wee belata ya.
cm2_divRatioFind.explanation: Mgbe i tụnyere $x$-nhazi, $|{px}-({x1})|={u}$, $|({x2})-({px})|={w}$, ya mere $\overline{A P}:\overline{P B}={u}:{w}$, ma mgbe i dere ya dị ka ọnụ ọgụgụ zuru ezu dị n'etiti onwe ha, ọ bụ ${m}:{n}$. ($y$-nhazi na-enye otu ọnụ ọgụgụ.) Ya mere $m+n={ans}$.

cm2_existsInterval.prompt: $U$ bụ set nke ọnụọgụ zuru ezu niile site na ${p}$ ma ọ bụ karịa ruo ${q}$ ma ọ bụ pere mpe. Gịnị bụ uru kachasị ukwuu nke ọnụọgụ zuru ezu $k$ nke na-eme ka nkwupụta 'e nwere ihe $x$ n'ime $U$ nke ${form}$' bụrụ eziokwu? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: 'E nwere $x$' bụ eziokwu ma ọ bụrụ na ọ dịkarịa ala otu $x$ na-emezu ọnọdụ ahụ.
Gbanwee enweghị nha anya ka ọ bụrụ ụdị $k<g(x)$, wee chọta uru kachasị ukwuu nke $g(x)$ n'ime ihe nke $U$.
cm2_existsInterval.explanation: Enwere ike ịgbanwe ${form}$ ka ọ bụrụ ụdị $k<{gx}$. N'ime ihe nke $U$, ${gx}$ bụ ${gm}$ kachasị ukwuu mgbe $x={xm}$, ma ọ bụrụ na $k<{gm}$, ọ bụ eziokwu na $x$ a. Ya mere uru kachasị ukwuu nke ọnụọgụ zuru ezu $k$ bụ ${ans}$.

cm2_funcInjective.prompt: N'ime ọrụ otu-na-otu $f$ sitere na set $X=\{{xset}\}$ gaa set $Y=\{{yset}\}$, ole ka nwere $f(1)\le {t}$ na $f(2)\ge {u}$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: Ọrụ otu-na-otu na-ejikọta ihe dị iche nke $X$ na uru dị iche. Buru ụzọ kpebie $f(1)$, $f(2)$.
Gụọ ọnụọgụ ụzọ nke $(f(1), f(2))$ nke $f(1)\ne f(2)$, wee mụbaa ya na ọnụọgụ ụzọ ịkpebi uru nke ihe fọdụrụ.
cm2_funcInjective.explanation: $f(1)$ nwere ụzọ ${t}$, $f(2)$ nwere ụzọ ${n}-{u}+1$, ma e nwere ụzọ ${ov}$ nke $f(1)=f(2)$, ya mere $(f(1), f(2))$ nwere ụzọ ${pairs}$. Ihe ${mr}$ fọdụrụ na-ejikọta otu-na-otu na uru ${nr}$ fọdụrụ, ya mere ụzọ ${rest}$, ma ọnụọgụ achọrọ bụ ${pairs}\times{rest}={ans}$.

cm2_funcMonotone.prompt: N'ime ọrụ $f$ sitere na set $X=\{{xset}\}$ gaa set $Y=\{{yset}\}$, ole ka nwere ${chain}$ na $f(1)\ge {u}$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: Ọ bụrụ na $f(1)<f(2)<\cdots$, uru niile dị iche, ma ozugbo e kpebiri uru, a na-ekpebi njikọ n'otu ụzọ site n'usoro nha.
Ọnụọgụ nwere ike ịbụ uru bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu site na ${u}$ ma ọ bụ karịa ruo ${w}$ ma ọ bụ pere mpe, ma ọ bụ ọnụọgụ ụzọ ịhọrọ ${m}$ dị iche n'ime ha.
cm2_funcMonotone.explanation: Ị ga-ahọrọ ${m}$ dị iche n'ime ọnụọgụ zuru ezu ${k}$ site na ${u}$ ma ọ bụ karịa ruo ${w}$ ma ọ bụ pere mpe. Ọ bụrụ na ejikọta uru ndị ahọrọrọ n'usoro site na obere uru gaa $f(1), f(2), \dots$, a na-ekpebi ya n'otu ụzọ, ya mere ọnụọgụ bụ $_{{k}}\mathrm{C}_{{m}}={ans}$.

cm2_inclusionParam.prompt: Maka set abụọ $A=\{x\mid {Ac}\}$, $C=\{x\mid {Cc}\}$ ($x$ bụ ọnụọgụ n'ezie), ole set $B=\{x\mid a\le x\le b\}$ ($a$, $b$ bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu) na-emezu $A\subset B\subset C$? (Mara: $\subset$ gụnyere ọnọdụ mgbe set abụọ hara nhata.) (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: Buru ụzọ gosipụta $A$ na $C$ dị ka oge nke ụdị $\alpha\le x\le\beta$.

Ọ bụrụ na $A\subset B$, $a$ dị ala ma ọ bụ hara nhata na ọnụ aka ekpe nke $A$, $b$ dịkwa elu ma ọ bụ hara nhata na ọnụ aka nri nke $A$, ma ọ bụrụ na $B\subset C$, $a$ na $b$ aghaghị ịnọ n'ime oge nke $C$. Gụọ uru nwere ike ịbụ nke $a$ na $b$ n'otu n'otu.
cm2_inclusionParam.explanation: $A=\{x\mid {al}\le x\le {ar}\}$, $C=\{x\mid {cl}\le x\le {cr}\}$. Ka $A\subset B\subset C$ bụrụ eziokwu, ${cl}\le a\le {al}$, ${ar}\le b\le {cr}$ aghaghị ịbụ eziokwu, ya mere $a$ nwere ${na}$, $b$ nwekwara ${nb}$, ma ọnụọgụ $B$ bụ ${na}\times{nb}={ans}$.

cm2_inverseQuadDom.prompt: Ka $g$ bụrụ ọrụ ntụgharị nke ọrụ $f(x)={fx}$ (${dom}$). Gịnị bụ uru nke $g({t})$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: Site na ịmachi domain (${dom}$), $f$ bụ njikọ otu-na-otu ma nwee ọrụ ntụgharị.
Ọ bụrụ na $g({t})=x$, mgbe ahụ $f(x)={t}$. Chọta azịza nke nha anya quadratic $f(x)={t}$ wee họrọ nke dabara na domain.
cm2_inverseQuadDom.explanation: Enwere ike ịgbanwe ya ka ọ bụrụ ụdị $f(x)={vf}$, ma site na $f(x)={t}$, ${sq}={s2}$, ya mere ${xp}=\pm{s}$. Ebe domain bụ ${dom}$, ${xp}={rt}$, ya mere $g({t})={ans}$.

cm2_inverseRational.prompt: Ka ọrụ ntụgharị nke ọrụ $f(x)=\frac{{num}}{{den}}$ bụrụ $g$, kedu uru $g({k})$? (Ebe ngalaba nke $f$ bụ ezigbo ọnụọgụgụ niile nke ọnụọgụgụ ala ha na-abụghị $0$.) (Dee naanị nọmba)
hints: Ọ bụrụ $g({k})=x$, mgbe ahụ $f(x)={k}$.
Mụbaa akụkụ abụọ nke $\frac{{num}}{{den}}={k}$ site na ọnụọgụgụ ala ma dozie ya dị ka ọkwa ọkwa mbụ nke $x$.
cm2_inverseRational.explanation: Ka $g({k})=x$, mgbe ahụ $f(x)={k}$, ya mere ${num}={k}\times({den})$. Mgbe ahazigharịrị maka $x$, $({coef})x={rhs}$, ya mere $x={ans}$, ya bụ $g({k})={ans}$.

cm2_irrLineCount.prompt: Chọta ọnụọgụgụ ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu $k$ nke na-eme ka akụkụ $y=\sqrt{{fr}}$ na ahịrị $y=x+k$ nwee ebe ntụgharị abụọ. (Dee naanị nọmba)
hints: Kọwaa mkpụrụedemede ọhụrụ $t$ dị ka $t=\sqrt{{fr}}$ ($t\ge 0$). Mgbe ahụ ị nwere ike igosiputa $x$ site na $t$. Ọnụọgụgụ ebe ntụgharị hà ọnụọgụgụ mgbọrọgwụ ezigbo abụọ dị iche na-abụghị ndị na-adịghị mma nke ọkwa ọkwa abụọ nke $t$.
Ọnọdụ ka ọkwa ọkwa abụọ nke $t$ nwee mgbọrọgwụ ezigbo abụọ dị iche na-abụghị ndị na-adịghị mma bụ $D>0$, (nchikota mgbọrọgwụ abụọ)$\ge 0$, (ngwaahịa mgbọrọgwụ abụọ)$\ge 0$.
cm2_irrLineCount.explanation: Ọ bụrụ na akọwapụtara mkpụrụedemede ọhụrụ $t$ dị ka $t=\sqrt{{fr}}\ (t\ge 0)$, $x=\frac{t^2-({b})}{{a}}$ ma site na $t=x+k$, $t^2-{a}t+({a}k-({b}))=0$. Ka ọ nwee mgbọrọgwụ ezigbo abụọ dị iche na-abụghị ndị na-adịghị mma, $D={a}^2-4({a}k-({b}))>0$ ma ngwaahịa ${a}k-({b})\ge 0$ (nchikota ${a}>0$), ya mere ${lt}\le k<{ht}$. Ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu $k$ na-eju nke a bụ site na ${lo}$ ruo ${hi}$, ya bụ ${ans}$.

cm2_irrationalMinMax.prompt: Kedu uru kacha ukwuu nke ọrụ $f(x)={fx}$ na ${lo}\le x\le {hi}$? (Dee naanị nọmba)
hints: Ebe ọkwa dị n'ime akara mgbọrọgwụ bụ ọkwa ọkwa mbụ, mgbe $x$ na-abawanye, $f(x)$ na-agbanwe n'otu ụzọ naanị. Ya mere tụnyere uru na njedebe abụọ nke oke.
Chọta uru ọrụ mgbe $x={lo}$ na mgbe $x={hi}$, wee họrọ nke buru ibu.
cm2_irrationalMinMax.explanation: $f({lo})=\sqrt{{rl}}+({c})={flo}$, $f({hi})=\sqrt{{rh}}+({c})={fhi}$. N'oke a, $f$ na-abawanye ma ọ bụ na-ebelata naanị, ya mere uru buru ibu n'ime abụọ ahụ bụ uru kacha ukwuu, nke bụ ${ans}$.

cm2_irrationalPass.prompt: Otu ebe dị n'eserese nke ọrụ mgbọrọgwụ $y=\sqrt{a({xp})}{qs}$ ($a$ bụ ihe kwụsiri ike na-abụghị $0$) bụ $P({x0}, {y0})$. Kedu uru $a$? (Dee naanị nọmba)
hints: Dochie koodinetị ebe ahụ n'ọkwa. Lezie anya na mgbọrọgwụ square abụghị nke na-erughị $0$.
Hapụ naanị akara mgbọrọgwụ, mee square akụkụ abụọ, wee dozie dị ka ọkwa ọkwa mbụ nke $a$.
cm2_irrationalPass.explanation: Mgbe edochiri ebe $P$, ${y0}=\sqrt{a({x0}-({p}))}+({q})$, ya mere $\sqrt{a\times({d})}={s}$. Mgbe emere square akụkụ abụọ, $a\times({d})={s2}$, ya mere $a={ans}$.

cm2_lineCircleCount.prompt: Okirikiri $C$: ${circ}$, ahịrị $l$: ${line}$. Ole ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu dị mma $k$ na-eme ka $C$ na $l$ zute n'ebe abụọ dị iche? (Dee naanị nọmba)
hints: Ọ bụrụ na ebe dị anya n'etiti etiti okirikiri na ahịrị erughị radius, ha na-ezute n'ebe abụọ dị iche.
Hazie enweghị nha anya $\frac{|{u}\times({cx})+({w})\times({cy})-k|}{\sqrt{({u})^2+({w})^2}}<{rad}$ dị ka enweghị nha anya nke $k$.
cm2_lineCircleCount.explanation: Ebe dị anya site na etiti $({cx}, {cy})$ ruo ahịrị ga-erughị radius ${rad}$, ya mere $|{K0}-k|<{rad}\sqrt{({u})^2+({w})^2}=\sqrt{{R2}}$. Ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu na-eju nke a bụ ${lo}\le k\le {hi}$, ma n'ime ha, ọnụọgụgụ ndị dị mma bụ ${ans}$.

cm2_lineThroughPerp.prompt: Site na ebe $P({px}, {py})$ dosie ahịrị kwụ ọtọ na ahịrị $l$: ${line}$ (ahịrị na-agafe ebe $P$ ma kwụ ọtọ na $l$). Kedu $y$-koodinetị nke ebe ahịrị ahụ na-ezute axis $y$? (Dee naanị nọmba)
hints: Ọ bụrụ na ahịrị abụọ kwụ ọtọ ibe ha, ngwaja mkpọda ha bụ $-1$.
Buru ụzọ chọta mkpọda nke $l$, jiri mkpọda nke ahịrị kwụ ọtọ ahụ tinye ya na ụdị ebe-mkpọda, ma dochie $x=0$.
cm2_lineThroughPerp.explanation: Mkpọda nke ahịrị $l$ bụ ${ms}$, ya mere mkpọda nke ahịrị kwụ ọtọ ahụ bụ ${mp}$. Ebe ọ na-agafe ebe $P$, anyị nwere $y-({py})={mp}\left(x-({px})\right)$, ma dochie $x=0$ nye $y={ans}$.

cm2_necessaryDiv.prompt: Maka ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu $x$, were ọnọdụ abụọ a: $p$: $x$ bụ ọtụtụ nke $m$. $q$: $x$ bụ ọtụtụ nke ${n}$. Kedu ole ọnụọgụgụ ọnụọgụ $m$ dị ka $p$ bụrụ ọnọdụ dị mkpa maka $q$ mana ọ bụghị ọnọdụ zuru oke? (Dee naanị nọmba)
hints: Ọ bụrụ na $p$ bụ ọnọdụ dị mkpa maka $q$, mgbe ahụ $q\Rightarrow p$. Na usoro ngwugwu eziokwu, ọ bụ $Q\subset P$.
Ka ọtụtụ niile nke ${n}$ bụrụ ọtụtụ nke $m$, $m$ ga-abụrịrị onye nkesa nke ${n}$. Ka ọ ghara ịbụ ọnọdụ zuru oke, $p\Rightarrow q$ agaghị adị.
cm2_necessaryDiv.explanation: Ebe ọ bụ ọnọdụ dị mkpa, $q\Rightarrow p$, nke pụtara na ọtụtụ niile nke ${n}$ ga-abụrịrị ọtụtụ nke $m$, nke a na-eme mgbe $m$ bụ onye nkesa nke ${n}$. Ka ọ ghara ịbụ ọnọdụ zuru oke, $p\Rightarrow q$ ga-abụrịrị ụgha, mana mgbe $m$ bụ onye nkesa nke ${n}$, $p\Rightarrow q$ na-adị naanị mgbe $m={n}$. ${n}$ nwere ${nd}$ ndị nkesa, ya mere ọnụọgụgụ $m$ chọrọ bụ ${nd}-1={ans}$.

cm2_perpParam.prompt: Maka ahịrị abụọ $l_1: {l1}$ na $l_2: {l2}$, chọta nchikota nke ụkpụrụ niile nke ọnụọgụgụ ezigbo $k$ nke na-eme ka ahịrị abụọ ahụ ma ọ bụ bụrụ ndị kwụ ọtọ ma ọ bụ bụrụ ndị yiri ibe ha n'ụzọ. (Ọ bụrụ na ahịrị abụọ ahụ dakwasị onwe ha, anaghị ele ha anya dị ka ndị na-eso ibe ha n'ụzọ.) (Dee naanị nọmba)
hints: Maka ahịrị abụọ $ax+by+c=0$ na $a'x+b'y+c'=0$, ha na-eso ibe ha n'ụzọ (ma ọ bụ dakwasị onwe ha) mgbe $ab'-a'b=0$, ha kwụkwa ọtọ mgbe $aa'+bb'=0$.
Ọnọdụ ịbụ ndị na-eso ibe ha n'ụzọ bụ nha anya ọkwa abụọ nke $k$, ebe ọnọdụ ịkwụ ọtọ bụ nha anya ọkwa mbụ. Dozie nke ọ bụla ma chịkọta ụkpụrụ niile.
cm2_perpParam.explanation: Ọnụọgụgụ $x$ na $y$ nke $l_1$ bụ ${p}$ na $k$, nke $l_2$ bụkwa $k{qs}$ na ${rr}$. Ọnọdụ ịbụ ndị na-eso ibe ha n'ụzọ: ${p}\times({rr})=k(k{qs})$, ya bụ ${eqPar}=0$, nke na-enye $k={k1}$ ma ọ bụ $k={k2}$, ma n'okwu abụọ ahụ ahịrị ndị ahụ adakwasịghị onwe ha. Ọnọdụ ịkwụ ọtọ: ${p}(k{qs})+({rr})k=0$ na-enye $k={k3}$. Ya mere nchikota bụ ${k1}+({k2})+({k3})={ans}$.

cm2_pointLineDist.prompt: Kedu ebe dị anya site na ebe $P({x0}, {y0})$ ruo ahịrị ${line}$? (Ị nwere ike dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụgụ ntụpọ ma ọ bụ dị ka ntakịrị dị ka 3/4)
hints: Ebe dị anya n'etiti ebe $(x_0,y_0)$ na ahịrị $ax+by+c=0$ bụ $\frac{|ax_0+by_0+c|}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2}}$.
Gbakọọ ọnụọgụgụ elu dị ka $|{a}\times({x0})+({b})\times({y0})+({c})|$, ọnụọgụgụ ala bụkwa $\sqrt{({a})^2+({b})^2}$.
cm2_pointLineDist.explanation: Na $\frac{|{a}\times({x0})+({b})\times({y0})+({c})|}{\sqrt{({a})^2+({b})^2}}$, ọnụọgụgụ elu bụ ${N}$ ma $\sqrt{({a})^2+({b})^2}={h}$, ya mere ebe dị anya bụ $\frac{{N}}{{h}}={ans}$.

cm2_rationalAsym.prompt: Ọ bụrụ na akara abụọ na-adịghị emetụ nke eserese ọrụ ntakịrị $y=\frac{{num}}{{den}}$ bụ ahịrị $x=p$ na $y=q$, kedu uru $p+q$? (Ị nwere ike dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụgụ ntụpọ ma ọ bụ dị ka ntakịrị dị ka 3/4)
hints: Uru $x$ nke na-eme ka ọnụọgụgụ ala bụrụ $0$ bụ akara na-adịghị emetụ kwụ ọtọ.
Uru $y$ na-abịaru nso mgbe uru zuru ezu nke $x$ buru ibu nke ukwuu bụ akara na-adịghị emetụ dị larịị. Ọ bụ ruru nke ọnụọgụgụ $x$ nke ọnụọgụgụ elu na ọnụọgụgụ ala.
cm2_rationalAsym.explanation: Akara na-adịghị emetụ kwụ ọtọ bụ uru $x$ na-eme ka ọnụọgụgụ ala bụrụ $0$, ya bụ ahịrị $x={px}$. Mgbe $x\to\infty$, $y\to\frac{{a}}{{c}}={qy}$, ya mere akara na-adịghị emetụ dị larịị bụ $y={qy}$. Ya mere $p+q=({px})+({qy})={ans}$.

cm2_rationalIntersectCount.prompt: Ọnụọgụgụ ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu $n$ nke $-{N}\le n\le {N}$ nke na-eme ka eserese nke ọrụ $y={fr}$ na ahịrị ${line}$ zute n'ebe 2 bụ ole? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Jikọọ ọkwa abụọ ahụ ka ịmepụta ọkwa quadratic n'ihe $x$, ma chee ọnọdụ maka ịnwe mgbọrọgwụ abụọ dị iche (discriminant).
N'ihi na i mụbaara ọkwa ahụ site na okwu nke $x$ iji wepụ ọnụọgụgụ ala, lee ma mgbọrọgwụ ọkwa quadratic anaghị eme ka ọnụọgụgụ ala bụrụ $0$.
cm2_rationalIntersectCount.explanation: Mgbe ejikọrọ ha, site na $\frac{{k}}{{den}}{qs}={mx}+n$ ka e wepụrụ ọnụọgụgụ ala ma hazie, discriminant nke ọkwa quadratic ahụ bụ $D=({nstr})^2{ds}$. (Mgbọrọgwụ anaghị eme ka ọnụọgụgụ ala bụrụ $0$.) Ọ ga-abụ $D>0$, ya mere wepụ ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu $n$ na-adịghị emezu nke a: n'ime ${tot}$ dị n'oke ahụ, a wepụrụ ${bad}$, ya mere ọ bụ ${ans}$.

cm2_rationalParam.prompt: A na-akpụgharị eserese nke ọrụ $y=\frac{k}{x}$ ($k$ bụ ọnụọgụgụ adịghị agbanwe nke na-abụghị $0$) site na ${p}$ n'ụzọ $x$-axis na ${q}$ n'ụzọ $y$-axis. Otu ntụpọ n'eserese ahụ bụ $P({x0}, {y0})$. Kedu $x$-coordinate nke ebe eserese a na-ezute $x$-axis? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Mgbe a na-akpụgharị, n'ọkwa ahụ $x$ ghọrọ $x-({p})$ na $y$ ghọrọ $y-({q})$.
Tinye coordinate nke ntụpọ ahụ iji chọta $k$, wee tinye $y=0$.
cm2_rationalParam.explanation: Eserese a kpụgharịrị bụ $y=\frac{k}{{xsh}}{ysh}$. N'ihi na ntụpọ $P$ nọ n'eserese ahụ, site na ${y0}=\frac{k}{{dx}}{ysh}$, $k={kk}$. Ọ bụrụ $y=0$, $\frac{{kk}}{{xsh}}={nq}$, ya mere $x={ans}$.

cm2_reflectChainOrder.prompt: Ntụpọ $P(a, b)$ ka a kpụgharịrị site na ${m}$ n'ụzọ $x$-axis na ${n}$ n'ụzọ $y$-axis, nsonaazụ bụ ntụpọ $Q$; ntụpọ $Q$ ka e gosipụtara n'ihe gbasara isi ọnụ (origin), nsonaazụ bụ $R$; ntụpọ $R$ ka e gosipụtara n'ihe gbasara $x$-axis, nsonaazụ bụ $S$. Ọ bụrụ na coordinate nke $S$ bụ $({sx}, {sy})$, kedu uru $a+b$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Ngosipụta n'ihe gbasara isi ọnụ bụ $(x,y)\to(-x,-y)$, ngosipụta n'ihe gbasara $x$-axis bụ $(x,y)\to(x,-y)$.
N'ihi na a na-ebu ụzọ akpụgharị wee gosipụta, ọnụọgụgụ e kpụgharịrị na-agbanwekwa ihe ịrịba ama. Laghachi azụ otu nzọụkwụ n'otu site na $S$, ma ọ bụ kwuo ya site na $a$, $b$.
cm2_reflectChainOrder.explanation: Mgbe e kwuru ya site na $a$, $b$: $Q(a+({m}), b+({n}))$, $R(-a-({m}), -b-({n}))$, $S(-a-({m}), b+({n}))$. Site na $-a-({m})={sx}$, $a={pa}$; site na $b+({n})={sy}$, $b={pb}$, ya mere $a+b={ans}$.

cm2_reflectCurve.prompt: E gosipụtara eserese nke ọrụ $y={orig}$ n'ihe gbasara isi ọnụ, wee kpụgharịa ya site na ${m}$ n'ụzọ $x$-axis na ${n}$ n'ụzọ $y$-axis. Ọ bụrụ na coordinate nke elu parabola nsonaazụ bụ $(s, t)$, kedu uru $s+t$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Ngosipụta n'ihe gbasara isi ọnụ bụ $(x,y)\to(-x,-y)$, ya mere gbanwee $x$ ka ọ bụrụ $-x$ na $y$ ka ọ bụrụ $-y$ n'ọkwa ahụ.
Ị nwere ike chọta elu parabola mbụ wee tinye mmegharị abụọ ahụ n'usoro, ma ọ bụ dee ọkwa e gbanwere ozugbo.
cm2_reflectCurve.explanation: Elu parabola mbụ bụ $({h}, {k})$. Mgbe e gosipụtara ya n'ihe gbasara isi ọnụ, ọ ghọrọ parabola nke ụdị $y=-({orig2})$, elu ya bụ $({nh}, {nk})$. Mgbe e kpụgharịrị ya site na ${m}$ n'ụzọ $x$-axis na ${n}$ n'ụzọ $y$-axis, $(s, t)=({s}, {t})$, ya mere $s+t={ans}$.

cm2_reflectPointChain.prompt: Ntụpọ $P(a, b)$ ka e gosipụtara n'ihe gbasara ahịrị $y=x$, nsonaazụ bụ $Q$; ntụpọ $Q$ ka e gosipụtara n'ihe gbasara $y$-axis, nsonaazụ bụ $R$; ntụpọ $R$ ka a kpụgharịrị site na ${m}$ n'ụzọ $x$-axis na ${n}$ n'ụzọ $y$-axis, nsonaazụ bụ $S$. Ọ bụrụ na coordinate nke $S$ bụ $({sx}, {sy})$, kedu uru $a+b$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Ngosipụta n'ihe gbasara ahịrị $y=x$ bụ $(x,y)\to(y,x)$, ngosipụta n'ihe gbasara $y$-axis bụ $(x,y)\to(-x,y)$.
Laghachi azụ otu nzọụkwụ n'otu site na $S$, ma ọ bụ kwuo coordinate site na $P(a,b)$ ruo $S$ site na $a$, $b$.
cm2_reflectPointChain.explanation: Mgbe e kwuru ya site na $a$, $b$: $Q(b, a)$, $R(-b, a)$, $S(-b+({m}), a+({n}))$. Site na $-b+({m})={sx}$, $b={pb}$; site na $a+({n})={sy}$, $a={pa}$, ya mere $a+b={ans}$.

cm2_reflectShortest.prompt: Maka isi $A({a1}, {a2})$, isi $B({b1}, {b2})$ na isi $P$ nke na-agagharị n'ahịrị $x$ n'ụgbọ elu nhazi, kedu ntụpọ kachasị nta nke $\overline{A P}+\overline{P B}$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Ebe isi abụọ ahụ nọ n'otu akụkụ nke ahịrị $x$, ị nwere ike ịgbanwe $\overline{A P}+\overline{P B}$ ka ọ bụrụ ogologo otu akụkụ ahịrị site n'ịtụgharị otu isi n'ahịrị $x$.
Ọ bụrụ na ị were isi $B'$ nke bụ nchoputa nke $B$ n'ahịrị $x$, $\overline{P B}=\overline{PB'}$ ma $\overline{A P}+\overline{PB'}\ge\overline{AB'}$.
cm2_reflectShortest.explanation: Ọ bụrụ na isi nchoputa nke $B$ n'ahịrị $x$ bụ $B'({b1}, {nb2})$, $\overline{P B}=\overline{PB'}$, ya mere $\overline{A P}+\overline{P B}\ge\overline{AB'}$, ma ebe $A$ na $B'$ nọ n'akụkụ ọzọ nke ahịrị $x$, akụkụ ahịrị $AB'$ na-zute ahịrị $x$, ya mere nha ahụ dị. $\overline{AB'}=\sqrt{({b1}-({a1}))^2+({a2}-({nb2}))^2}=\sqrt{{dx}^2+{ss}^2}={ans}$.

cm2_setOpSum.prompt: $U$ bụ otu nke ọnụọgụ eke niile site na 1 ruo ${N}$, $A$ bụ otu nke ihe niile n'ime $U$ bụ ihe kewara ${da}$, $B$ bụ otu nke ihe niile n'ime $U$ bụ ọtụtụ nke ${mb}$. Kedu ngụkọta nke ihe niile nke otu ${ex}$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Buru ụzọ dee $A$ na $B$ site n'ime ihe ndị ahụ.
Otu nkwado $X^c$ bụ ihe fọdụrụ mgbe e wepụrụ ihe nke $X$ n'ime $U$. Gbakọọ n'usoro site n'ime nkebi.
cm2_setOpSum.explanation: $A=\{{As}\}$, $B=\{{Bs}\}$, ya mere ${ex}=\{{Rs}\}$ ma ngụkọta ihe ya bụ ${ans}$.

cm2_setSumCount.prompt: Maka otu abụọ $A=\{{sa}\}$, $B=\{{sb}\}$, kedu ngụkọta nke ihe niile nke otu $C=\{x+y\mid x\in A,\ y\in B\}$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Họrọ otu ihe site na $A$ na otu ihe site na $B$, tinye ha, wee mepụta uru niile.
Ọbụlagodi na otu uru pụtara ọtụtụ ugboro, gụọ ihe nke otu naanị otu ugboro.
cm2_setSumCount.explanation: Mgbe ị chọtara ngụkọta niile enwere ike, uru dị iche iche bụ ${sc}$. Ebe otu na-ede otu ihe naanị otu ugboro, ngụkọta ihe ya bụ ${ans}$.

cm2_sufficientQuad.prompt: E nwere ọnọdụ abụọ maka ọnụọgụ n'ezie $x$: $p$: $x>a$, $q$: ${quad}>0$. Kedu uru kachasị nta nke ọnụọgụ zuru ezu $a$ nke na-eme ka $p$ bụrụ ọnọdụ zuru ezu maka $q$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Ọ bụrụ na $p$ bụ ọnọdụ zuru ezu maka $q$, $p\Rightarrow q$, ya bụ otu eziokwu nke $p$ dị n'ime otu eziokwu nke $q$.
Buru ụzọ dozie enweghị nhata akụkụ abụọ ${quad}>0$ ka ịchọta otu eziokwu nke $q$.
cm2_sufficientQuad.explanation: Ngwọta nke ${quad}>0$ bụ $x<{Rs}$ ma ọ bụ $x>{Rl}$. Ka otu eziokwu nke $p$, $\{x\mid x>a\}$, dị n'ime otu a, $a\ge {Rl}$ ga-adị. Ya mere uru kachasị nta nke ọnụọgụ zuru ezu $a$ bụ ${ans}$.

cm2_tangentAtPoint.prompt: Otu isi n'ahịrị metụrụ okirikiri ${circ}$ n'isi $({x1}, {y1})$ bụ $Q({t}, k)$. Kedu uru nke $k$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Ahịrị na-emetụ okirikiri n'otu isi dị n'okirikiri na-ewere n'akụkụ ziri ezi na radius jikọtara isi ahụ na etiti.
Buru ụzọ dee nhata nke ahịrị na-emetụ wee tinye nhazi nke isi $Q$.
cm2_tangentAtPoint.explanation: Nhata nke ahịrị na-emetụ bụ ${tang}$. Ebe isi $Q$ dị n'ahịrị ahụ, tinye $x={t}$, $y=k$, ma $k={ans}$.

cm2_translateCurve.prompt: Mgbe e mere ka eserese nke ọrụ $y={orig}$ gaa n'ụzọ nke ahịrị $x$ site na $m$ na n'ụzọ nke ahịrị $y$ site na $n$, ọ dabara n'eserese nke ọrụ $y={img}$. Kedu uru nke $m+n$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Mgbe e meghari n'ụzọ nke ahịrị $x$ site na $m$ na nke ahịrị $y$ site na $n$, tinye $x-m$ n'ọnọdụ $x$ na $y-n$ n'ọnọdụ $y$.
Gbasaa $y-n=f(x-m)$ wee buru ụzọ tụnyere ọnụọgụ nke $x$ ka ịmata $m$.
cm2_translateCurve.explanation: Nhata e meghariri bụ $y-n={shift}$. Ịgbasa ya na ịtụnyere ọnụọgụ nke $x$ na-enye ${b}-({tw})m={b2}$, ya mere $m={m}$, ma ịtụnyere okwu na-adịghị agbanwe na-enye $n={n}$. Ya mere $m+n={ans}$.

cm2_truthRange.prompt: Maka ọnọdụ abụọ $p$: ${quad}\le 0$, $q$: $|{cx}|\le a$ banyere ọnụọgụ n'ezie $x$, ka $\alpha$ bụrụ uru kacha nta nke ọnụọgụ eke $a$ nke na-eme ka contrapositive nke nkwupụta $p\to q$ bụrụ eziokwu, ka $\beta$ bụrụkwa uru kachasị ukwuu nke ọnụọgụ eke $a$ nke na-eme ka converse nke nkwupụta $p\to q$ bụrụ eziokwu. Gịnị bụ uru nke $\alpha\beta$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: Nkwupụta na contrapositive ya nwere otu eziokwu mgbe niile. A ga-atụle converse $q\to p$ iche site na nkwupụta mbụ. Ọ bụrụ na truth set bụ $P$, $Q$, mgbe $p\to q$ bụ eziokwu, $P\subset Q$.
Buru ụzọ gosipụta $P$ dị ka oge, ma gosipụta $Q$ site n'ịdozi $|{cx}|\le a$ n'okwu nke $a$. Chọta oke nke $a$ nke na-eme ka $P\subset Q$ maka contrapositive na $Q\subset P$ maka converse.
cm2_truthRange.explanation: $P=\{x\mid {m}\le x\le {n}\}$ ma $|{cx}|\le a$ bụ $-a\le {cx}\le a$. Contrapositive nwere otu eziokwu na nkwupụta mbụ, ya mere $P\subset Q$ aghaghị ịbụ eziokwu, ma ebe uru nke ${cx}$ na ọnụ abụọ nke $P$, $x={m}$, $x={n}$, bụ ${u}$, ${w}$, $a\ge {d1}$, $a\ge {d2}$. Ya mere $\alpha={al}$. Converse chọrọ $Q\subset P$, ma $Q$ bụ ${lowS}\le {kx}\le {highS}$, ya mere ${lowS}\ge {km}$, ${highS}\le {kn}$, ya bụ $a\le {d1}$, $a\le {d2}$. Ya mere $\beta={be}$ ma $\alpha\beta={al}\times{be}={ans}$.

cm2_vennReverse.prompt: Maka subset abụọ $A$, $B$ nke set zuru oke $U$, $n(U)={nu}$, $n(A)={na}$, $n(B)={nb}$, $n((A\cup B)^c)={nc}$. Gịnị bụ uru nke $n(A^c\cup B)$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: Buru ụzọ chọta ọnụọgụ ihe nke union site na $n(A\cup B)=n(U)-n((A\cup B)^c)$.
Jiri eziokwu na $A^c\cup B=(A-B)^c$, mgbe ahụ $n(A^c\cup B)=n(U)-n(A-B)$.
cm2_vennReverse.explanation: $n(A\cup B)={nu}-{nc}={un}$ ma $n(A\cap B)=n(A)+n(B)-n(A\cup B)={na}+{nb}-{un}={ab}$. Ebe $A^c\cup B=(A-B)^c$ ma $n(A-B)={na}-{ab}$, $n(A^c\cup B)={nu}-({na}-{ab})={ans}$.

cul_bordaMax.prompt: Nke a bụ ntuli aka Borda iji họrọ otu onye n'etiti ndị nwere olileanya A, B, C. A na-enye $2$ isi maka ọkwa nke mbụ, $1$ isi maka ọkwa nke abụọ, $0$ isi maka ọkwa nke atọ. Ọ bụrụ na tebụl ọkwa '{b1}' bụ ${n1}$ mmadụ, '{b2}' bụ ${n2}$ mmadụ, '{b3}' bụ ${n3}$ mmadụ, gịnị bụ ngụkọta isi kachasị elu n'etiti ndị atọ ahụ? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: Chọta ọkwa onye nwere olileanya ọ bụla n'ime tebụl ọkwa ọ bụla wee kpebie isi.
Chọta ngụkọta isi nke ndị atọ ahụ niile, wee họrọ nke kachasị ukwuu.
cul_bordaMax.explanation: Ngụkọta isi nke A bụ ${eA}$, nke B bụ ${eB}$, nke C bụ ${eC}$. Ngụkọta isi kachasị elu bụ ${ans}$.

cul_bordaTotal.prompt: Nke a bụ ntuli aka Borda iji họrọ otu onye n'etiti ndị nwere olileanya A, B, C. A na-enye $2$ isi maka ọkwa nke mbụ, $1$ isi maka ọkwa nke abụọ, $0$ isi maka ọkwa nke atọ. Ọ bụrụ na tebụl ọkwa 'A>B>C' bụ ${n1}$ mmadụ, 'B>C>A' bụ ${n2}$ mmadụ, 'C>A>B' bụ ${n3}$ mmadụ, gịnị bụ ngụkọta isi nke A? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: Buru ụzọ chọta ọkwa A n'ime tebụl ọkwa ọ bụla.
Gbakwunye (ọnụọgụ mmadụ)×(isi ọkwa) niile.
cul_bordaTotal.explanation: A bụ nke mbụ (isi 2) n'ime tebụl ọkwa nke mbụ, nke atọ (isi 0) n'nke abụọ, nke abụọ (isi 1) n'nke atọ, ya mere ${n1}\times2+{n2}\times0+{n3}\times1={ans}$.

cul_brailleAtMost.prompt: Otu mkpụrụ Braille nwere ebe ${d}$ ebe ntụpọ nwere ike ịnọ, ma ebe ọ bụla na-ebili elu ma ọ bụ naghị ebili. Ole ụdị dị iche nke otu mkpụrụ nwere ntụpọ 1 ma ọ bụ karịa ruo ${k}$ ma ọ bụ pere mpe na-ebili elu? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: Ọnụọgụ ụdị nwere ntụpọ $j$ kpọmkwem na-ebili elu bụ ọnụọgụ ụzọ ịhọrọ $j$ n'ime ebe ${d}$.
Chọta ya maka $j=1$ ruo $j={k}$ n'otu n'otu wee gbakwunye ha.
cul_brailleAtMost.explanation: Ụdị nwere ntụpọ $j$ na-ebili elu bụ $_{{d}}\mathrm{C}_{j}$, ya mere ${terms}={ans}$.

cul_pitchFifth.prompt: Ugboro ụda bụ isi ụda bụ ${f}$ Hz. Site n'ụda a bulie octave ${k}$ elu, kedu ugboro ụda nke ụda dị elu n'ọkwa nke ise zuru oke (nha ugboro $3:2$) ọzọ n'elu ya n'ime Hz? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Ụda dị elu n'octave nwere ugboro ụda okpukpu abụọ.
Maka nke ise zuru oke n'elu, jiri $\frac{3}{2}$ mụta ugboro ụda.
cul_pitchFifth.explanation: Octave ${k}$ n'elu: ${f}\times 2^{{k}}={mid}$ Hz, nke ise zuru oke n'elu: ${mid}\times\frac{3}{2}={ans}$ Hz.

cul_stringLength.prompt: Eriri ngwa egwú eriri na-enwe ugboro ụda dị elu ka ọ na-adị mkpụmkpụ, ma ọ bụrụ na oke na nrụgide eriri bụ otu, ugboro ụda na ogologo eriri na-agbanwe n'ụzọ ọzọ. Mgbe eriri ogologo ${L}$ cm na-ewepụta ụda ${f}$ Hz, ọ bụrụ na e kpochie eriri ahụ ka akụkụ na-ama jijiji bụrụ ${L2}$ cm, kedu ugboro ụda nke ụda ahụ n'ime Hz? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Uru (ugboro ụda)×(ogologo) adịghị agbanwe.
Kewaa uru ${f}\times{L}$ site na ogologo ọhụrụ ${L2}$ cm.
cul_stringLength.explanation: Ebe (ugboro ụda)×(ogologo) bụ ihe edoziri, ${f}\times{L}=x\times{L2}$. Ya mere $x=\frac{{f}\times{L}}{{L2}}={ans}$ Hz.

cul_voteGuarantee.prompt: Ndị na-ekwu aha A, B, C na-asọ mpi n'ntuli aka nke onye nwetara votu kacha ọtụtụ na-emeri. Nsonaazụ etiti ọgụgụ bụ A ${a}$ votu, B ${b}$ votu, C ${c}$ votu, ma votu ${m}$ ka fọdụrụ ịgụ. Ka C bụrụ onye mbụ naanị ya n'agbanyeghị otú votu fọdụrụ ga-esi kewaa A na B, opekempe votu ole ka C kwesịrị inweta n'ime votu ${m}$ fọdụrụ? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Ọ bụrụ na C nweta $x$ votu n'ime fọdụrụ, votu ${m}$−$x$ ndị ọzọ na-aga n'ndị ọzọ. Ọnọdụ kachasị njọ bụ ma votu ndị ahụ niile na-aga n'onye na-eduga ugbu a.
Votu C ga-adị ọtụtụ karịa nke onye na-eduga (ọ bụghị nhata). Dee enweghị nhata wee chọta onye nọmba zuru oke kacha nta $x$.
cul_voteGuarantee.explanation: Votu kachasị ugbu a bụ ${M}$. Ọ bụrụ na C nweta $x$ votu n'ime fọdụrụ ma votu ${m}-x$ ndị ọzọ niile gaa n'onye nwere ${M}$ votu, ${c}+x>{M}+({m}-x)$ ga-abụ eziokwu. Ịhazi ya, $x>{half}$, ya mere onye nọmba zuru oke kacha nta bụ ${ans}$.

econ_annuityPV.prompt: E nwere ụgwọ afọ nke na-enye ${A}$ won n'ọgwụgwụ afọ ọ bụla n'ime afọ ${n}$ (ịkwụ ụgwọ mbụ bụ afọ 1 ka e mesịrị, nke ikpeazụ bụ afọ ${n}$ ka e mesịrị). Ọ bụrụ na ọnụ ọgụgụ ọmụrụ afọ bụ ${r}$% n'afọ ọ bụla, ma a gụọ ya n'ụzọ ọmụrụ n'elu ọmụrụ n'afọ ọ bụla, kedu uru ugbu a nke ụgwọ afọ a n'ime won? (Hapụ ihe na-erughị otu won. Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Nọgide na-ebelata ịkwụ ụgwọ ọ bụla dịka oge ịkwụ ya si dị ka ọ bụrụ uru ugbu a, wee tinye ha niile.
Mgbe ọnụ ọgụgụ ọmụrụ bụ $i=\frac{{r}}{100}$, uru ugbu a bụ $A\times\frac{1-(1+i)^{-{n}}}{i}$.
econ_annuityPV.explanation: Ebe $i={r}/100$, uru ugbu a bụ ${A}\times\frac{1-(1+i)^{-{n}}}{i}\approx{ex}$ won, ma mgbe e hapụrụ ihe na-erughị otu won, ọ bụ ${ans}$ won.

econ_compoundFV.prompt: Ị na-edobe ${P}$ won n'akaụntụ nchekwa nke na-agbakwunye ọmụrụ n'isi ego ugboro ${m}$ n'afọ, na ọnụ ọgụgụ ọmụrụ afọ ${r}$%, ruo afọ ${n}$. Ọnụ ọgụgụ ọmụrụ n'otu mgbe a na-agbakọ bụ (ọnụ ọgụgụ ọmụrụ afọ)$\\div{m}$, ma a naghị ewepụ ego n'etiti. Kedu ngụkọta isi ego na ọmụrụ mgbe afọ ${n}$ gasịrị n'ime won? (Hapụ ihe na-erughị otu won. Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Ọnụ ọgụgụ oge a na-agbakọ ọmụrụ bụ (ugboro n'afọ)×(ọnụ ọgụgụ afọ).
Jiri ọnụ ọgụgụ ọmụrụ n'otu mgbe ${rp}$%, ngụkọta isi ego na ọmụrụ bụ isi ego mụbara site na $(1+\frac{{rp}}{100})$ ugboro oge a na-agbakọ.
econ_compoundFV.explanation: Ọnụọgụ oge a na-agbakọ bụ ${m}\times{n}={k}$, ọnụ ọgụgụ ọmụrụ n'otu mgbe bụ ${rp}$%, ya mere ngụkọta bụ ${P}\times(1+\frac{{rp}}{100})^{{k}}\approx{ex}$ won, ma mgbe e hapụrụ ihe na-erughị otu won, ọ bụ ${ans}$ won.

econ_elasticityPoint.prompt: Ọrụ ọchọ bụ $q={D}$ ($p$ bụ ọnụ ahịa, $q$ bụ ọnụọgụ ọchọ). Mgbe ọnụ ahịa bụ $p={p0}$, kedu uru nke ịdị nro ọnụ ahịa nke ọchọ $e=\left|q'(p)\times\frac{p}{q}\right|$? (Dee ya dị ka òkè e nwere ike ichikọta. Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu, dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụ zuru ezu. Ọmụmaatụ: 3/4)
hints: Buru ụzọ chọta $q'(p)$, wee chọta uru ya mgbe $p={p0}$.
Chọtakwa ọnụọgụ ọchọ $q$ mgbe $p={p0}$ wee tinye ya n'ọrụ $e$.
econ_elasticityPoint.explanation: Uru $q'(p)$ mgbe $p={p0}$ bụ ${dqv}$, ọnụọgụ ọchọ bụ $q={qv}$, ya mere $e=\frac{{adq}\times{p0}}{{qv}}={fr}$.

econ_elasticityUnit.prompt: N'ọrụ ọchịchọ $q={D}$, kedu ọnụahịa $p$ nke na-eme ka price elasticity $e=\left|q'(p)\times\frac{p}{q}\right|$ bụrụ 1? (Tụlee n'oke ebe $p>0$ na ọnụọgụgụ achọrọ $q>0$.) (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Mgbe ị chọtara $q'(p)$, dee $\left|q'(p)\times\frac{p}{q}\right|=1$ dị ka ọkwa n'ihe $p$.
N'oke ebe $q>0$, $q'(p)<0$, ya mere mgbe ị wepụrụ uru zuru ezu, $-q'(p)\times p=q$.
econ_elasticityUnit.explanation: $q'(p)={dq}$, ya mere site na $-q'(p)\times p=q$, ${eqn}$, ma ọgbọrọ nke $p>0$ bụ $p={ans}$.

econ_equilibriumTable.prompt: Maka otu ngwaahịa, ọnụọgụgụ achọrọ bụ ${qd1}$ mgbe ọnụahịa bụ ${p1}$ won, ${qd2}$ mgbe ọnụahịa bụ ${p2}$ won, ma ọnụọgụgụ e nyere bụ ${qs1}$ mgbe ọnụahịa bụ ${p3}$ won, ${qs2}$ mgbe ọnụahịa bụ ${p4}$ won. Ọ bụrụ na ma ọnụọgụgụ achọrọ ma ọnụọgụgụ e nyere bụ ọrụ linia nke ọnụahịa, ole won ka ọnụahịa nhatanha ebe ọnụọgụgụ achọrọ na nke e nyere hà nhata bụ? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Jiri mkpọda nke ahịrị na-agafe ntụpọ abụọ chọta ka ọnụọgụgụ achọrọ na nke e nyere si agbanwe na ọnụahịa.
Ka $Q_d$ bụrụ ọnụọgụgụ achọrọ na $Q_s$ bụrụ nke e nyere, chọta ọnụahịa nke $Q_d=Q_s$.
econ_equilibriumTable.explanation: Ọnụego mgbanwe nke ọnụọgụgụ achọrọ bụ $\frac{{qd2}-{qd1}}{{p2}-{p1}}={md}$, ya mere $Q_d={qd1}{md}(p-{p1})$, ọnụego mgbanwe nke ọnụọgụgụ e nyere bụ ${ns}$, ya mere $Q_s={qs1}+{ns}(p-{p3})$. Mgbe e dozie $Q_d=Q_s$, $p={ans}$ won.

econ_exchangeCross.prompt: Ọnụego mgbanwe ego bụ dollar 1 $={d}$ won, euro 1 $={e}$ won. Ọ bụrụ na e gbanwere euro ${n}$ ka ọ bụrụ dollar n'enweghị ụgwọ ọrụ, ole dollar ka ọ bụ? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Buru ụzọ chọta ole won ka euro ${n}$ bụ.
Kewaa ọnụọgụgụ won ahụ site na uru dollar 1, ${d}$ won.

econ_inverseEntry.prompt: Kedu akụkụ $({i}, {j})$ nke inverse matrix $A^{-1}$ nke matrix $A={M}$? (Akụkụ $(i, j)$ bụ akụkụ dị n'ahịrị $i$ ogidi $j$.) (Dee ya dị ka ntakịrị kacha nta. Ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu, dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu. Ọmụmaatụ: 3/4)
hints: Determinant nke matrix ${G}$ bụ $ad-bc$. Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụghị 0, inverse dị.
Inverse bụ ${H}$.
econ_inverseEntry.explanation: Determinant bụ ${ap}\times{dp}-{bp}\times{cp}={det}$, ma akụkụ $({i}, {j})$ nke $A^{-1}$ bụ $\frac{{num}}{{det}}$, ya bụ ${fr}$.

econ_leontief.prompt: Input coefficient matrix nke ụlọ ọrụ abụọ 1, 2 bụ $A={M}$ (akụkụ $(i, j)$ nke $A$ bụ ọnụọgụgụ ngwaahịa nke ụlọ ọrụ $i$ achọrọ mgbe ụlọ ọrụ $j$ na-emepụta otu nkeji). Ka ngụkọta mmepụta nke ụlọ ọrụ abụọ bụrụ $x_1$, $x_2$ (nkeji: narị nde won), ma ọchịchọ ikpeazụ bụ $d_1={d1}$, $d_2={d2}$, mgbe ahụ ${XV}=A{XV}+{DV}$ na-emezu. Kedu $x_1$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Gbanwee ọkwa ahụ ka ọ bụrụ $(I-A){XV}={DV}$.
Chọta inverse nke $I-A$ ma mụba ya na ${DV}$. Inverse nke matrix $2\times2$ bụ $\frac{1}{ad-bc}$ nke e mụbara na matrix e hazigharịrị akụkụ.
econ_leontief.explanation: $(I-A)\mathbf{x}=\mathbf{d}$, ya mere $\mathbf{x}=(I-A)^{-1}\mathbf{d}$. Determinant nke $I-A$ bụ ${D}$, ya mere $x_1=\frac{{c22}\times{d1}+{a12}\times{d2}}{{D}}={ans}$.

econ_marginalRevenue.prompt: Curve ọchịchọ nke otu ngwaahịa bụ $p={a}-{b}q$ ($p$ bụ ọnụahịa (won), $q$ bụ ọnụọgụgụ a rere (ihe)). Ngụkọta ego e nwetara bụ $R(q)=pq$, ma marginal revenue bụ $R'(q)$, derivative nke $R(q)$ n'ihe $q$. Ole ihe ka ọnụọgụgụ a rere $q$ bụ mgbe marginal revenue bụ ${m}$ won? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Tinye $p={a}-{b}q$ n'ime $R(q)=pq$ ka ị gosi $R(q)$ dị ka ọkwa nke $q$.
Chọta $q$ mgbe uru nke derivative nke $R(q)$ bụ ${m}$ won.

econ_presentValue.prompt: A na-agbakọ ya na ọmụrụ afọ kwa afọ nke ${r}$% n'ụzọ compound kwa afọ. Gịnị bụ present value nke ${F}$ won a ga-anata mgbe ${n}$ afọ gasịrị? (Hapụ ihe dị n'okpuru otu won. Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Present value $P$ bụ uru nke ga-abụ ${F}$ won mgbe e jiri compound mụbaa $P$ ruo ${n}$ afọ.
Gbakọọ $P=F\div(1+\frac{{r}}{100})^{{n}}$.
econ_presentValue.explanation: $P={F}\div(1+\frac{{r}}{100})^{{n}}\approx{ex}$ won, ma mgbe a hapụrụ ihe dị n'okpuru otu won, ọ bụ ${ans}$ won.

econ_profitCubic.prompt: Ngụkọta ọnụ ahịa nke imepụta $q$ nke ngwaahịa bụ $C(q)=q^3-{b}q^2+{c}q+{f}$ (won), ma ahịa ire bụ ${p}$ won n'otu ngwaahịa n'enweghị mgbanwe. Ọ bụrụ na e rere ngwaahịa niile e mepụtara, gịnị bụ uru kacha ukwuu nke uru (ego a nwetara wepụ ngụkọta ọnụ ahịa) na won? ($q$ bụ real number 0 ma ọ bụ karịa.) (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Uru bụ $\pi(q)={p}q-C(q)$. Chọta $q$ nke $\pi'(q)=0$ site na ịmepụta derivative.
Ihe ngosi nke $\pi'(q)$ na-agbanwe site na + gaa - n'ebe mgbọrọgwụ dị mma nke $\pi'(q)=-3q^2+{twob}q+{pc}=0$.
econ_profitCubic.explanation: Ebe $\pi(q)={p}q-C(q)$, $\pi'(q)=-3q^2+{twob}q+{pc}=-3(q-{q0})(q+{s})$. Mgbe $q\ge0$, $\pi'$ dị mma tupu $q={q0}$ ma adịghị mma n'azụ ya, ya mere kacha ukwuu na $q={q0}$, ma $\pi({q0})={ans}$ won.

econ_regionLP.prompt: E nwere ụlọ ọrụ na-emepụta $x$ nke ngwaahịa A na $y$ nke ngwaahịa B ($x$, $y$ bụ integer 0 ma ọ bụ karịa). Maka otu ngwaahịa, ihe na oge ọrụ achọrọ bụ ${a1}$ kg na ${t1}$ awa maka ngwaahịa A, ma ${b1}$ kg na ${t2}$ awa maka ngwaahịa B. Ihe enwere ike iji kwa ụbọchị bụ ${M}$ kg ma ọ bụ ihe pere mpe, ngụkọta oge ọrụ nke ndị ọrụ niile bụ ${T}$ awa ma ọ bụ ihe pere mpe, ma uru bụ ${pa}$ man won (otu man bụ 10,000 won) n'otu ngwaahịa A na ${pb}$ man won n'otu ngwaahịa B. Gịnị bụ uru kacha ukwuu kwa ụbọchị na man won? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Dee ọnọdụ ndị ahụ dị ka inequality wee gosi ha dị ka mpaghara n'ụgbọ coordinate ya na $x\ge0$, $y\ge0$.
Uru ${pa}x+{pb}y$ na-abụ kacha ukwuu n'otu n'ime vertex nke mpaghara ahụ. Buru ụzọ lelee ebe ahịrị abụọ nke ókè na-ezute.
econ_regionLP.explanation: Inequality ndị ahụ bụ ${a1}x+{b1}y\le{M}$, ${t1}x+{t2}y\le{T}$, $x\ge0$, $y\ge0$. Vertex nke uru kacha ukwuu bụ ebe ahịrị abụọ nke ókè na-ezute $({x0}, {y0})$, ma ebe a bụ integer point, ya mere uru kacha ukwuu bụ ${pa}\times{x0}+{pb}\times{y0}={ans}$ man won.

econ_taxBracket.prompt: N'otu obodo, a na-ekewa taxable income n'ọkwa, ma ọkwa ọ bụla nwere ọnụ ọgụgụ ụtụ isi dị iche. A na-etinye ${r1}$% n'akụkụ ${b1}$ man won (otu man bụ 10,000 won) ma ọ bụ ihe pere mpe, ${r2}$% n'akụkụ karịrị ${b1}$ man won ruo ${b2}$ man won, na ${r3}$% n'akụkụ karịrị ${b2}$ man won. Ọ bụrụ na taxable income bụ ${x1}$ man won, ole man won ka a ga-akwụ dị ka ụtụ isi? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: A na-etinye ọnụ ọgụgụ ụtụ isi naanị n'ego dị n'ọkwa ahụ. Buru ụzọ chọta ego dị n'ọkwa ọ bụla.
Gbakọta (ego nke ọkwa ọ bụla)×(ọnụ ọgụgụ ụtụ isi) niile.
econ_taxBracket.explanation: Ego nke ọkwa ọ bụla bụ ${s1}$, ${s2}$, ${s3}$ man won, ya mere ụtụ isi bụ ${s1}\times\frac{{r1}}{100}+{s2}\times\frac{{r2}}{100}+{s3}\times\frac{{r3}}{100}={ans}$ man won.

econ_taxEquilibrium.prompt: Demand curve nke otu ngwaahịa bụ $p={a}-{b}q$, ma supply curve bụ $p={c}+{d}q$. Ebe a, $p$ bụ ahịa (won) ma $q$ bụ ọnụọgụgụ (ihe). Ọ bụrụ na gọọmentị tinye ụtụ isi nke ${t}$ won maka ngwaahịa ọ bụla onye na-ere ahịa na-ere, onye na-ere ahịa na-anata ahịa onye na-azụ ahịa kwụrụ wepụ ụtụ isi. Mgbe e tinyechara ụtụ isi, gịnị bụ ahịa onye na-azụ ahịa na-akwụ n'equilibrium na won? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Ahịa onye na-ere ahịa na-anata n'ezie bụ $p-{t}$.
Tinye $p-{t}$ n'ọnọdụ $p$ nke supply curve, wee jiri demand curve $p={a}-{b}q$ chọta $q$.
econ_taxEquilibrium.explanation: Ahịa onye na-ere ahịa na-anata bụ $p-{t}$, ya mere $({a}-{b}q)-{t}={c}+{d}q$. Mgbe e dozichara ya, $q={qn}$, ma ahịa onye na-azụ ahịa na-akwụ bụ $p={a}-{b}\times{qn}={ans}$ won.

econ_utilityBundle.prompt: Ngwongwo x dị ${a}$ naira otu, ngwongwo y dị ${b}$ naira otu. Ị chọrọ iji ego niile ${I}$ naira zuru ezu zụta ngwongwo x $x$ na ngwongwo y $y$ ($x$, $y$ bụ ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu na-erughị 0). Ọ bụrụ na enyere uru $U={U}$, kedu uru kacha ukwuu nke $U$? (Dee naanị nọmba)
hints: Chọta ụzọ niile nke ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu na-erughị 0 $(x, y)$ na-eju ahịrị mmefu ego ${a}x+{b}y={I}$.
Gbakọọ uru $U$ maka $(x, y)$ nke ọ bụla ị chọtara ma tụnyere ha.
econ_utilityBundle.explanation: Ụzọ $(x, y)$ na-eju ahịrị mmefu ego bụ ${pairs}$. N'ime ha, ụzọ nwere uru $U$ kacha ukwuu bụ $(x, y)=({bx}, {by})$ (ọ bụrụ na ọtụtụ nwere uru kacha ukwuu, otu n'ime ha), ma mgbe ahụ $U={ans}$.

geo_conicGeneral.prompt: N'ime isi ọkụ nke akụkụ conic ${eq}$, ka isi ọkụ nwere $x$-koodinetị kacha ukwuu (ma ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ naanị otu isi ọkụ, ebe ahụ) bụrụ $(a,\ b)$. Kedu uru $a+b$? (Dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu. Ọ bụrụ na ọ dị njọ, tinye - )
hints: Gbanwee $x$ na $y$ nke ọ bụla ka ọ bụrụ square zuru ezu ka ịnweta ụdị ọkọlọtọ.
Gụọ etiti (ma ọ bụ isi) site na ụdị ọkọlọtọ, ma isi ọkụ bụ ebe a hapụrị site na ya n'ụzọ nwere isi ọkụ site na $c$ (maka parabola, $p$).
geo_conicGeneral.explanation: Mgbe agbanwere ya ka ọ bụrụ square zuru ezu, ọ bụ ${std}$. Isi ọkụ bụ ${foc}$, ya mere $a+b={ans}$.

geo_conicParam.prompt: Ọ bụrụ na ebe dị anya n'etiti isi ọkụ abụọ nke akụkụ ${eq}$ bụ ${fd}$ ma ${cond}$, kedu uru $k$? (Dee naanị nọmba)
hints: Ọ bụrụ na ebe dị anya n'etiti isi ọkụ abụọ bụ $2c$, buru ụzọ chọta $c$. Kpebie kwa ọnụọgụgụ ala nke bụ $a^2$.
Maka ellipse, $c^2=a^2-b^2$; maka hyperbola, $c^2=a^2+b^2$. Chọta $k$ site na nha anya a.
geo_conicParam.explanation: Ebe dị anya n'etiti isi ọkụ abụọ bụ $2c={fd}$, ya mere $c={c}$ na $c^2={c2}$. Ebe ${work}$, $k={ans}$.

geo_conicTangentLine.prompt: Maka ahịrị ${ln}$ metụrụ akụkụ ${eq}$, kedu uru nọmba dị mma $k$? (Dee naanị nọmba)
hints: Dochie ọkwa ahịrị n'ime ọkwa akụkụ ahụ ka ịnweta ọkwa ọkwa abụọ nke $x$; ọ bụrụ na ha metụ, onye na-ekpebi bụ $0$.
Site na onye na-ekpebi $D=0$, nweta ọkwa maka $k$.
geo_conicTangentLine.explanation: Mgbe edochiri ọkwa ahịrị n'ime ọkwa akụkụ ahụ, enwetara ọkwa ọkwa abụọ nke $x$: ${quad}$, ma ebe ha metụrụ, onye na-ekpebi $D=0$. Ebe ${work}$, nọmba dị mma $k$ bụ ${ans}$.

geo_divPoint.prompt: Maka ebe abụọ $A{pa}$ na $B{pb}$ n'oghere koodinetị, ebe P dị n'akụkụ AB ma $AP:PB={m}:{n}$. Kedu nchikota koodinetị atọ nke ebe P? (Dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu. Ọ bụrụ na ọ dị njọ, tinye - )
hints: Koodinetị ebe nke na-ekekọta akụkụ AB n'ime n'ọnụ ọgụgụ $m:n$ bụ $\left(\frac{mx_2+nx_1}{m+n},\ \frac{my_2+ny_1}{m+n},\ \frac{mz_2+nz_1}{m+n}\right)$.
Gbakọọ koodinetị nke ọ bụla n'otu n'otu.
geo_divPoint.explanation: $P=\left(\frac{{n}\,x_A+{m}\,x_B}{{mn}},\ \frac{{n}\,y_A+{m}\,y_B}{{mn}},\ \frac{{n}\,z_A+{m}\,z_B}{{mn}}\right)={pp}$, ya mere nchikota koodinetị atọ bụ ${ans}$.

geo_divRatioPlane.prompt: Maka ebe abụọ $A{pa}$ na $B{pb}$ n'oghere koodinetị, ka P bụrụ ebe akụkụ AB ezute ụgbọ elu ${pl}$. Ọ bụrụ na $AP:PB=m:n$ ($m$, $n$ bụ ọnụọgụgụ okike na-enweghị ihe nkesa ọnụ), kedu uru $m+n$? (Dee naanị nọmba)
hints: Ebe dị n'ụgbọ elu ${pl}$ nwere otu koodinetị bụ $0$.
Dee koodinetị ahụ nke ebe na-ekekọta akụkụ AB n'ime $s:t$ site na $s$ na $t$, wee kwuo na ọ hà $0$.
geo_divRatioPlane.explanation: Ka $AP:PB=s:t$, mgbe ahụ koodinetị kwekọrọ nke ebe P ga-abụ $\frac{t\cdot({za})+s\cdot({zb})}{s+t}=0$, ya mere $s:t=|{za}|:|{zb}|={ua}:{ub}$. Mgbe e wedara ya ka ọ bụrụ ndị na-enweghị ihe nkesa ọnụ, ọ bụ ${m}:{n}$, ya mere $m+n={ans}$.

geo_dotAngle.prompt: Ọ bụrụ na akụkụ dị n'etiti vectors abụọ $\vec a={va}$, $\vec b={vb}$ bụ $\theta$ ($0^\circ\le\theta\le180^\circ$), gịnị bụ uru $\theta$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ n'ọkwa degrees)
hints: Cosine nke akụkụ dị n'etiti vectors abụọ bụ $\cos\theta=\frac{\vec a\cdot\vec b}{|\vec a||\vec b|}$.
Chọta dot product na ogologo nke vector ọ bụla.
geo_dotAngle.explanation: $\vec a\cdot\vec b={dt}$, $|\vec a||\vec b|=\sqrt{{na2}}\sqrt{{nb2}}=\sqrt{{pr}}={rt}$, ya mere $\cos\theta=\frac{{dt}}{{rt}}={cs}$. N'ime $0^\circ\le\theta\le180^\circ$, $\theta={ans}^\circ$.

geo_dotNormExpand.prompt: Maka vectors abụọ $\vec a$, $\vec b$, ọ bụrụ na $|\vec a|={na}$, $|\vec b|={nb}$, $\vec a\cdot\vec b={dt}$, gịnị bụ uru $|{ex}|^2$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Ebe $|\vec x|^2=\vec x\cdot\vec x$, gbasaa ya site n'ime dot product nke ${ex}$ na onwe ya.
Gosipụta ya n'okwu $|\vec a|^2$, $|\vec b|^2$, $\vec a\cdot\vec b$ wee tinye uru ndị ahụ.

geo_ellipseExtSum.prompt: Ka otu ebe dị mkpa nke ellipse ${eq}$ bụrụ $F({fx},\ {fy})$, ma ka nhazi otu ebe dị n'ime ellipse bụrụ $A({xa},\ {ya})$. Mgbe ebe P dị n'ellipse na-aga, gịnị bụ ngwaahịa nke uru kachasị elu na uru kachasị ala nke $PA+PF$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Ọ bụrụ na ebe dị mkpa nke ọzọ bụ F', $PF=2a-PF'$. Mgbe ahụ ị nwere ike ide $PA+PF=2a+(PA-PF')$.
Site na enweghị nha triangle, $-AF'\le PA-PF'\le AF'$, ma ebe A dị n'ime ellipse, nhata abụọ nwere ike ime.
geo_ellipseExtSum.explanation: Ọ bụrụ na ebe dị mkpa nke ọzọ bụ F', $PA+PF=2a+(PA-PF')$ ma $a={a}$, $AF'={dd}$. Ebe $-AF'\le PA-PF'\le AF'$, uru kachasị elu bụ $2a+AF'={mx}$, uru kachasị ala bụ $2a-AF'={mn}$, ngwaahịa ha bụ ${ans}$.

geo_ellipseFocal.prompt: Ka ebe abụọ dị mkpa nke ellipse ${eq}$ bụrụ F, F'. Mgbe ebe P dị n'ellipse bụ ${cond}$, gịnị bụ uru ${ask}$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Ngụkọta anya sitere n'ebe dị n'ellipse ruo ebe abụọ dị mkpa bụ otu, ma uru ya bụ ogologo axis ukwu.
Ka ogologo axis ukwu bụrụ $2a$ ma anya dị n'etiti ebe abụọ dị mkpa bụrụ $2c$, mgbe ahụ $a={a}$, $c={c}$. Jiri $PF+PF'=2a$.
geo_ellipseFocal.explanation: Ogologo axis ukwu bụ $2a={tw}$, anya dị n'etiti ebe abụọ dị mkpa bụ $2c={tc}$, ya mere $PF+PF'={tw}$, $FF'={tc}$. Ebe ${work}$, uru a chọrọ bụ ${ans}$.

geo_ellipseFromEq.prompt: Gịnị bụ anya dị n'etiti ebe abụọ dị mkpa nke ellipse ${eq}$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Mgbe i dere akụkụ ellipse ahụ n'ụdị $\frac{x^2}{\square}+\frac{y^2}{\square}=1$ nke akụkụ aka nri bụ $1$, nke ka ukwuu n'ime denominators abụọ bụ $a^2$.
Denominators abụọ bụ ${a2}$ na ${b2}$, ma $c^2=a^2-b^2$.
geo_ellipseFromEq.explanation: Mgbe i dere ya n'ụdị ${std}$, $a^2={a2}$, $b^2={b2}$, ya mere $c^2=a^2-b^2={c2}$, $c={c}$. Anya dị n'etiti ebe abụọ dị mkpa bụ $2c={ans}$.

geo_ellipseRightTri.prompt: Ka ebe abụọ dị mkpa nke ellipse ${eq}$ bụrụ F, F'. Mgbe ebe P dị n'ellipse na-emezu $\angle FPF'=90^\circ$, gịnị bụ mpaghara triangle PFF'? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Site na nkọwa ellipse, $PF+PF'=2a$, ma ebe ọ bụ triangle nwere akụkụ ziri ezi, $PF^2+PF'^2=(FF')^2$.
Jiri $(PF+PF')^2=PF^2+PF'^2+2\,PF\cdot PF'$ chọta $PF\cdot PF'$.
geo_ellipseRightTri.explanation: $a^2={a2}$, $b^2={b2}$, $c^2={c2}$, ya mere $PF+PF'=2a={tw}$, $FF'=2c={tc}$. $PF^2+PF'^2={tc2}$, ya mere $2\,PF\cdot PF'=({tw})^2-{tc2}$, ya bụ $PF\cdot PF'={pr}$. Mpaghara bụ $\frac{1}{2}\times PF\times PF'={ans}$.

geo_hyperAsym.prompt: N'ime asymptote abụọ nke hyperbola ${eq}$, gịnị bụ mkpọda nke ahịrị nke mkpọda ya bụ positiv? (Dee ya dị ka ntakịrị nke enweghị ike ibelata ọzọ. Ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu, dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụ zuru ezu. Ọmụmaatụ: 3/4)
hints: Asymptote nke hyperbola $\frac{x^2}{a^2}-\frac{y^2}{b^2}=1$ bụ $y=\pm\frac{b}{a}x$, nke $\frac{y^2}{a^2}-\frac{x^2}{b^2}=1$ bụkwa $y=\pm\frac{a}{b}x$.
Ọ bụrụ na akụkụ aka nri nke nha anya abụghị $1$, buru ụzọ mee ka ọ bụrụ $1$, wee gụọ $a^2$, $b^2$ site na ọnụọgụ ala nke $x^2$, $y^2$.
geo_hyperAsym.explanation: Ebe ọ bụ ụdị ${std}$, asymptote bụ ${asy}$. Mkpọda nke asymptote nwere mkpọda positiv bụ ${ansf}$.

geo_hyperFocal.prompt: Ka F, F' bụrụ focus abụọ nke hyperbola ${eq}$. Mgbe isi P dị na hyperbola ${cond}$, gịnị bụ uru nke ${ask}$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: N'isi ọ bụla dị na hyperbola, uru zuru oke nke ọdịiche nke ebe dị anya ruo focus abụọ hara nhata ogologo $2a$ nke isi axis.
Ebe $a={a}$, $c={c}$, $|PF-PF'|=2a={tw}$, ma ebe dị anya site n'isi dị na hyperbola gaa focus ọ bụla dị opekata mpe $c-a={ca}$.
geo_hyperFocal.explanation: $a={a}$, $b={b}$, $c={c}$ ma $|PF-PF'|=2a={tw}$. Ebe ${work}$, P dị na alaka nke dị nso F ma $PF'>PF$. (Ọ bụrụ na $PF'=PF-2a$, ${alt}$ ga-abụ obere karịa $c-a$, nke a pụghị ime.) Ya mere ebe ${work2}$, uru achọrọ bụ ${ans}$.

geo_hyperFocalRel.prompt: Ka F, F' bụrụ focus abụọ nke hyperbola ${eq}$. Mgbe isi P dị na hyperbola ${cond}$, gịnị bụ uru nke ${ask}$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: N'isi ọ bụla dị na hyperbola, uru zuru oke nke ọdịiche nke ebe dị anya ruo focus abụọ hara nhata ogologo $2a$ nke isi axis.
Ebe $a={a}$, $c={c}$, $|PF-PF'|=2a={tw}$, ma ebe dị anya site n'isi dị na hyperbola gaa focus ọ bụla dị opekata mpe $c-a={ca}$.

geo_lineIntersectParam.prompt: N'oghere, mgbe ahịrị abụọ ${l1}$, ${l2}$ zutere n'otu isi, gịnị bụ uru nke ọnụọgụ kwụsiri ike $k$? (Dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụ zuru ezu. Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ negative, tinye -)
hints: Kpọọ uru nkịtị nke ahịrị ọ bụla $s$ na $t$, wee gosipụta nhazi nke isi dị n'ahịrị ahụ site na $s$ na $t$.
Site na nha anya nke nhazi $x$, $y$ chọta $s$, $t$, wee tụnyere nhazi $z$.
geo_lineIntersectParam.explanation: Ọ bụrụ na uru nkịtị nke ahịrị mbụ bụ $s$ ma nke ahịrị nke abụọ bụ $t$, nhazi $x$, $y$ aghaghị ịha nhata, ya mere ${xy}$, ma ịdozi ya na-enye $s={ss}$, $t={tt}$. Nhazi $z$ aghaghị ịha nhata, ya mere ${eq3}$ ma $k={ans}$.

geo_lineSpacePoint.prompt: N'ime isi ndị dị na ahịrị ${ln}$, e nwere isi nke ${cond}$. Gịnị bụ nchikota nke nhazi abụọ fọdụrụ nke isi a? (Dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụ zuru ezu. Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ negative, tinye -)
hints: Ọ bụrụ na uru nkịtị nke ntakịrị atọ ahụ bụ $s$, ị pụrụ ịgosipụta $x$, $y$, $z$ niile site na $s$.
Buru ụzọ chọta $s$ site n'ọnọdụ enyere ${cond}$.
geo_lineSpacePoint.explanation: Ọ bụrụ na uru nkịtị bụ $s$, $(x,\ y,\ z)=({par})$. Site na ${cond}$, $s={ss}$, ya mere isi a bụ ${pt}$, ma nchikota nke nhazi abụọ fọdụrụ bụ ${ans}$.

geo_parFocusDir.prompt: Maka isi $P(x,\ y)$ dị na parabola nke focus ya bụ $F({fx},\ {fy})$ ma directrix ya bụ ${dirEq}$, mgbe ${cond}$, gịnị bụ uru kachasị elu nke ${un}$? (Dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụ zuru ezu. Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ negative, tinye -)
hints: N'isi ọ bụla dị na parabola, ebe dị anya ruo focus hara nhata ebe dị anya ruo directrix.
Vertex bụ etiti n'etiti focus na directrix. Buru ụzọ dee nha anya nke parabola nke vertex ya bụ $({vx},\ {vy})$ ma $p={pp}$.
geo_parFocusDir.explanation: Ebe vertex bụ $({vx},\ {vy})$ ma $p={pp}$, nha anya nke parabola bụ ${eqn}$. Mgbe ${cond}$, ${un}={sol}$, ya mere uru kachasị elu nke ${un}$ bụ ${ans}$.

geo_parMinSum.prompt: Ka F bụrụ isi ntụpụ nke parabola ${eq}$, ka koordinetị nke ebe A bụrụ $({xa},\ {ya})$. Mgbe ebe P dị na parabola na-agagharị, kedu ụkpụrụ kacha pere mpe nke $PA+PF$? (Dee naanị nọmba)
hints: Ebe dị anya site na ebe P dị na parabola ruo isi ntụpụ $PF$ hà ebe dị anya site na P ruo directrix.
Ka H bụrụ ụkwụ nke ahịrị kwụ ọtọ sitere na P gaa directrix; $PA+PH$ kacha pere mpe mgbe A, P na H dị n'otu ahịrị.
geo_parMinSum.explanation: Directrix bụ ${dir}$. Ebe ọ bụ na ebe A dị n'ime parabola (${chk}$), ka H bụrụ ụkwụ nke ahịrị kwụ ọtọ sitere na P gaa directrix, ụkpụrụ kacha pere mpe nke $PA+PF=PA+PH$ bụ ebe dị anya site na A ruo directrix, ya bụ ${ans}$.

geo_planeNormal.prompt: Maka ebe $A{pa}$, ebe ihe nkesa nke gafere A ma kwụ ọtọ na vector $\vec n=({vn})$ zutere axis ${ax}$ n'ebe koordinetị ${ax}$ ya bụ kedu? (Ị nwere ike dee ya dị ka ntụpọ ma ọ bụ dị ka akụkụ ọnụọgụ dịka 3/4)
hints: Ọ bụrụ na $\vec p$ bụ vector ọnọdụ nke ebe P ọ bụla n'elu ihe nkesa ahụ, mgbe ahụ $\vec n\cdot(\vec p-\vec a)=0$.
Buru ụzọ chọta nhatanha nke ihe nkesa ahụ $ax+by+cz=d$, mgbe ahụ jiri eziokwu na ebe dị na axis ${ax}$ nwere koordinetị abụọ ndị ọzọ bụ $0$.
geo_planeNormal.explanation: Maka ebe P n'elu ihe nkesa ahụ, $\vec n\cdot(\vec p-\vec a)=0$, ya mere nhatanha nke ihe nkesa ahụ bụ ${plane}$. Ebe ọ bụ na ebe dị na axis ${ax}$ nwere koordinetị abụọ ndị ọzọ bụ $0$, site na ${solve}$ koordinetị ${ax}$ bụ ${ans}$.

geo_projEllipse.prompt: Enwere gburugburu nwere radius ${rr}$ n'elu ihe nkesa $\alpha$. Mgbe e tụgharịrị gburugburu a n'elu ihe nkesa $\beta$, ọ na-aghọ ellipse. Ọ bụrụ na akụkụ dị n'etiti ihe nkesa abụọ $\alpha$ na $\beta$ bụ $\theta$ ma $\cos\theta={cs}$, kedu ebe dị anya n'etiti isi ntụpụ abụọ nke ellipse a? (Dee naanị nọmba)
hints: Dayameta nke gburugburu ahụ nke yiri ahịrị ihe nkesa abụọ na-ezukọ adịghị agbanwe ogologo, ebe nke kwụ ọtọ na ya na-adaba ugboro $\cos\theta$.
Chọta ogologo $2a$ nke axis ukwu na ogologo $2b$ nke axis nta nke ellipse e tụgharịrị, mgbe ahụ gbakọọ $c=\sqrt{a^2-b^2}$.
geo_projEllipse.explanation: Ogologo axis ukwu nke ellipse e tụgharịrị bụ $2a=2\times {rr}$, ogologo axis nta bụ $2b=2\times {rr}\cos\theta=2\times {bb}$, ya mere $a={rr}$, $b={bb}$. Ebe ọ bụ na $c=\sqrt{{rr}^2-{bb}^2}={cc}$, ebe dị anya n'etiti isi ntụpụ abụọ bụ $2c={ans}$.

geo_projPlaneArea.prompt: Kedu mpaghara nke ọdịdị nwere mpaghara ${ar}$ n'elu ihe nkesa ${pl}$ mgbe e tụgharịrị ya n'elu ihe nkesa ${cp}$? (Dee naanị nọmba)
hints: Ọ bụrụ na akụkụ dị n'etiti ihe nkesa nke ọdịdị ahụ dị na ya na ihe nkesa ${cp}$ bụ $\theta$, mpaghara nke ihe e tụgharịrị bụ (mpaghara ọdịdị)$\times\cos\theta$.

Ebe a na-ewere akụkụ $\theta$ dị n'etiti ihe nkesa abụọ dị ka $0^\circ\le\theta\le90^\circ$, ya mere $\cos\theta=\frac{|\vec n_1\cdot\vec n_2|}{|\vec n_1||\vec n_2|}$ (uru zuru ezu nke dot product nke vector abụọ nke kwụ ọtọ kewara site na ngwaahịa nke ogologo ha).
geo_projPlaneArea.explanation: Vector kwụ ọtọ nke ihe nkesa ${pl}$ bụ $({nv})$ ma ogologo ya bụ ${nn}$. Vector kwụ ọtọ nke ihe nkesa ${cp}$ bụ $({cn})$, ya mere $\cos\theta=\frac{|{ns}|}{{nn}}=\frac{{ni}}{{nn}}$, ma mpaghara nke ihe e tụgharịrị bụ ${ar}\times\frac{{ni}}{{nn}}={ans}$.

geo_spaceDist.prompt: Kedu ebe dị anya n'etiti ebe abụọ $A{pa}$ na $B{pb}$ n'oghere koordinetị? (Dee naanị nọmba)
hints: Ebe dị anya n'etiti ebe abụọ $(x_1,\ y_1,\ z_1)$ na $(x_2,\ y_2,\ z_2)$ n'oghere koordinetị bụ $\sqrt{(x_2-x_1)^2+(y_2-y_1)^2+(z_2-z_1)^2}$.
Buru ụzọ chọta ọdịiche nke koordinetị atọ ahụ.

geo_sphereExpand.prompt: Ọ bụrụ na nha anya ${eq}$ na-egosi sphere nke radius ya bụ ${rad}$, gịnị bụ uru nke ọnụọgụ kwụsiri ike $s$? (Dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụ zuru ezu. Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ negative, tinye -)
hints: Gbanwee $x$, $y$, $z$ nke ọ bụla ka ọ bụrụ square zuru oke, ka ọ bụrụ n'ụdị $(x-a)^2+(y-b)^2+(z-c)^2=r^2$.
Akụkụ aka nri aghaghị ịbụ $r^2={rad2}$.
geo_sphereExpand.explanation: Mgbe e gbanwere ya ka ọ bụrụ square zuru oke, ọ bụ ${std}$. Square nke radius bụ ${s4}-s={rad2}$, ya mere $s={s4}-{rad2}={ans}$.

geo_sphereSection.prompt: Akụkụ nke sphere ${eq}$ nke ụgbọelu ${pl}$ na-egbutu bụ okirikiri. Ọ bụrụ na mpaghara okirikiri a bụ $m\pi$, gịnị bụ uru nke ọnụọgụ eke $m$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: Gụọ etiti sphere na square nke radius ya site na nha anya.
Chọta ebe dị anya $d$ site n'etiti gaa n'ụgbọelu, wee radius $r$ nke akụkụ bụ $r^2=R^2-d^2$.
geo_sphereSection.explanation: Etiti sphere bụ ${cc}$, square nke radius bụ $R^2={rr2}$. Ebe ọ bụ na ebe dị anya site n'etiti gaa n'ụgbọelu ${pl}$ bụ $d={dd}$, square nke radius nke okirikiri akụkụ bụ ${rr2}-{dd}^2={ans}$, mpaghara ya bụkwa ${ans}\pi$.

geo_sphereTangentPlane.prompt: Maka ụgbọelu ${pl}$ nke na-ekpuchi sphere nke etiti ya bụ $C{cc}$ ma radius ya bụ ${rad}$, gịnị bụ nke kacha ukwuu n'ime uru nke ọnụọgụ kwụsiri ike $k$? (Dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụ zuru ezu. Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ negative, tinye -)
hints: Ọ bụrụ na ọ na-ekpuchi, ebe dị anya site n'etiti sphere gaa n'ụgbọelu hara nhata radius.
Ebe dị anya n'etiti isi $(x_0,\ y_0,\ z_0)$ na ụgbọelu $ax+by+cz=k$ bụ $\frac{|ax_0+by_0+cz_0-k|}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2+c^2}}$.
geo_sphereTangentPlane.explanation: Nha nke vector nkịtị $({nv})$ bụ ${nn}$, ma ọ bụrụ na etinye etiti n'ime nha anya nke ụgbọelu, ọ bụ ${dc}$. Site na ebe dị anya $\frac{|{dc}-k|}{{nn}}={rad}$, $|{dc}-k|={rl}$, ya mere $k={dc}\pm{rl}$, ma uru kacha ukwuu bụ ${ans}$.

geo_tangentAt.prompt: Gịnị bụ mpaghara triangle nke tangent n'isi $P({x0},\ {y0})$ n'akụkụ ${eq}$ na axis $x$ na axis $y$ gbara gburugburu? (Dee ya dị ka ntakịrị nke enweghị ike ibelata ọzọ. Ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu, dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụ zuru ezu. Ọmụmaatụ: 3/4)
hints: Tangent n'isi $(x_1,\ y_1)$ n'akụkụ ahụ pụrụ ịbụ nke e nwetara site n'ịgbanwe $x^2\to x_1x$, $y^2\to y_1y$ (maka parabola, $y^2\to y_1y$, $x\to\frac{x+x_1}{2}$).
Chọta $x$-intercept na $y$-intercept site na nha anya tangent wee gbakọọ $\frac{1}{2}\times|x\text{-intercept}|\times|y\text{-intercept}|$.
geo_tangentAt.explanation: Nha anya tangent bụ ${tan}$, $x$-intercept bụ ${xi}$, $y$-intercept bụkwa ${yi}$. Ya mere mpaghara bụ $\frac{1}{2}\times|{xi}|\times|{yi}|={ansf}$.

geo_tangentsFromPoint.prompt: Gịnị bụ ngwaahịa nke mkpọda nke tangent abụọ a dọpụtara site n'isi $({x1},\ {y1})$ gaa n'akụkụ ${eq}$? (Dee ya dị ka ntakịrị nke enweghị ike ibelata ọzọ. Ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu, dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụ zuru ezu. Ọmụmaatụ: 3/4)
hints: Ka mkpọda nke tangent bụrụ $m$, wee tinye ahịrị ${lnp}$ nke na-agafe isi $({x1},\ {y1})$ n'ime nha anya akụkụ ahụ.
Site n'ọnọdụ ịkpuchi (discriminant $=0$), a na-enweta nha anya quadratic nke $m$, ma mkpọda nke tangent abụọ bụ mgbọrọgwụ abụọ nke nha anya ahụ.
geo_tangentsFromPoint.explanation: Ebe discriminant nke nha anya quadratic nke $x$ nke e nwetara site na itinye ahịrị ${lnp}$ n'ime nha anya akụkụ ahụ aghaghị ịbụ $0$, mkpọda $m$ nke tangent bụ mgbọrọgwụ abụọ nke nha anya quadratic ${quad}=0$. Site na mmekọrịta nke mgbọrọgwụ na ọnụọgụ, ngwaahịa nke mkpọda abụọ bụ ${prod}$.

geo_threePerp.prompt: Ka H bụrụ ụkwụ nke perpendicular nke a dọpụtara site n'isi P nọ n'èzí ụgbọelu $\alpha$ gaa $\alpha$, ka K bụrụ ụkwụ nke perpendicular nke a dọpụtara site n'isi H gaa n'ahịrị $\ell$ nọ na $\alpha$, ma họrọ isi A na $\ell$ nke dị iche na K. Ka ebe dị anya site n'isi P gaa n'ahịrị $\ell$ bụrụ $d$. Mgbe ${giv}$, gịnị bụ uru nke ${ask}$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: Ebe $PH\perp\alpha$ na $HK\perp\ell$, site na Three Perpendiculars Theorem, $PK\perp\ell$.
Jiri Pythagorean theorem n'usoro na triangle ndị nwere akụkụ ziri ezi nke e nwetara site na Three Perpendiculars Theorem.
geo_threePerp.explanation: Ebe $PH\perp\alpha$ na $HK\perp\ell$, site na Three Perpendiculars Theorem, $PK\perp\ell$. Ebe ${work}$, uru a chọrọ bụ ${ans}$.

geo_vecCircleEq.prompt: Ka $\vec a$ na $\vec b$ bụrụ vector ọnọdụ nke ebe $A{pa}$ na $B{pb}$, ma ka $\vec p$ bụrụ vector ọnọdụ nke ebe P. Kedu radius nke gburugburu nke ebe P niile na-eju $(\vec p-\vec a)\cdot(\vec p-\vec b)=0$ afọ na-etolite? (Ị nwere ike dee ya dị ka ntụpọ ma ọ bụ dị ka akụkụ ọnụọgụ dịka 3/4)
hints: $(\vec p-\vec a)\cdot(\vec p-\vec b)=0$ pụtara na vector abụọ $\vec p-\vec a$ na $\vec p-\vec b$ kwụ ọtọ n'ibe ibe ha.
Ole degrees ka akụkụ ebe a na-ele ahịrị AB site na ebe P bụ?
geo_vecCircleEq.explanation: $(\vec p-\vec a)\cdot(\vec p-\vec b)=0$ pụtara na P dị n'elu gburugburu nke AB bụ dayameta ya. Ebe ọ bụ na $AB={ab}$, radius bụ $\frac{1}{2}AB={ans}$.

geo_vecDecompose.prompt: Mgbe $\vec a={va}$, $\vec b={vb}$, $\vec c={vc}$, kedu uru nke ${ask}$ maka ọnụọgụ ezigbo $m$, $n$ nke na-eju $\vec c=m\vec a+n\vec b$ afọ? (Ị nwere ike dee ya dị ka ntụpọ ma ọ bụ dị ka akụkụ ọnụọgụ dịka 3/4)
hints: Gosipụta akụkụ nke $m\vec a+n\vec b$ site na $m$, $n$, ma tinye ha ka ha hara akụkụ nke $\vec c$.
Dozie usoro nhatanha maka $m$, $n$ nke akụkụ abụọ ahụ nyere.
geo_vecDecompose.explanation: Mgbe e tụnyere akụkụ ndị ahụ, ọ bụ ${eqs}$, ya mere $m={mt}$, $n={nt}$. Ya mere ${ask}={ans}$.

geo_vecDotParam.prompt: Maka vector abụọ $\vec a={va}$, $\vec b={vb}$, mgbe $\vec a\cdot\vec b={dd}$, kedu uru kacha ukwuu nke ọnụọgụ ezigbo $t$? (Dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụ zuru ezu. Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ nke na-adịghị mma, tinye -)
hints: Mụbaa akụkụ ndị dị n'otu ọnọdụ ma jikọta ha, ka ị gosipụta $\vec a\cdot\vec b$ dị ka okwu nke $t$.
Dozie nhatanha ahụ ka ị chọta uru niile nke $t$, mgbe ahụ họrọ nke kacha ukwuu.
geo_vecDotParam.explanation: Ebe ọ bụ na $\vec a\cdot\vec b={dexp}$, ngwọta nke nhatanha ${dexp}={dd}$ bụ ${sol}$. N'ime ha, uru kacha ukwuu bụ ${ans}$.

geo_vecLinComb.prompt: Mgbe $\vec a={va}$, $\vec b={vb}$, kedu uru nke $|{ex}|$? (Dee naanị nọmba)
hints: Gbakọọ nchikọta vector na ọtụtụ ọnụọgụ ezigbo site n'akụkụ ọ bụla.
Buru ụzọ chọta akụkụ nke ${ex}$, mgbe ahụ chọta mgbọrọgwụ square dị mma nke nchikọta square nke akụkụ ndị ahụ.

geo_vecOrthoParam.prompt: Mgbe vector abụọ $\vec a={va}$, $\vec b={vb}$ kwụ ọtọ n'ibe ibe ha, kedu uru nke ọnụọgụ ezigbo $t$? (Dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụ zuru ezu. Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ nke na-adịghị mma, tinye -)
hints: Dot product nke vector abụọ kwụ ọtọ n'ibe ibe ha bụ $0$.
Mụbaa akụkụ ndị dị n'otu ọnọdụ ma jikọta ha, ka ị gosipụta $\vec a\cdot\vec b$ dị ka okwu nke $t$.
geo_vecOrthoParam.explanation: Ebe ọ bụ na vector abụọ ahụ kwụ ọtọ n'ibe ibe ha, $\vec a\cdot\vec b=0$. Ebe ọ bụ na $\vec a\cdot\vec b={dexp}$, ịdozi nhatanha ${dexp}=0$ na-enye ${sol}$.

geo_vecSphereEq.prompt: Ka $\vec a$ na $\vec b$ bụrụ vector ọnọdụ nke ebe $A{pa}$ na $B{pb}$, ma ka $\vec p$ bụrụ vector ọnọdụ nke ebe P. Kedu radius nke ihe gbara gburugburu (sphere) nke ebe P niile na-eju $(\vec p-\vec a)\cdot(\vec p-\vec b)=0$ afọ na-etolite? (Ị nwere ike dee ya dị ka ntụpọ ma ọ bụ dị ka akụkụ ọnụọgụ dịka 3/4)
hints: $(\vec p-\vec a)\cdot(\vec p-\vec b)=0$ pụtara na vector abụọ $\vec p-\vec a$ na $\vec p-\vec b$ kwụ ọtọ n'ibe ibe ha.
Ole degrees ka akụkụ ebe a na-ele ahịrị AB site na ebe P bụ?
geo_vecSphereEq.explanation: $(\vec p-\vec a)\cdot(\vec p-\vec b)=0$ pụtara na P dị n'elu sphere nke AB bụ dayameta ya. Ebe ọ bụ na $AB={ab}$, radius bụ $\frac{1}{2}AB={ans}$.

job_boxTunnel.prompt: E nwere ngọngọ osisi nwere ụdị igbe, ogologo ya bụ ${a}$ cm, obosara ya bụ ${b}$ cm, ịdị elu ya bụ ${c}$ cm. Site n'etiti elu ya ruo n'ala ya, e gbara oghere nwere ụdị igbe, ogologo ya bụ ${p}$ cm, obosara ya bụ ${q}$ cm, nke ọma (oghere ahụ adịghị emetụ akụkụ ngọngọ ahụ). Ọ bụrụ na e tinye n'ime mpaghara elu ahụ nkuku oghere ahụ n'ime, kedu mpaghara elu nke ngọngọ nwere oghere ahụ n'ime cm²? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Mgbe e gbara oghere, elu na ala na-ebelata n'ịdị ka akụkụ oghere ahụ.
Kama nke ahụ, akụkụ anọ nke n'ime oghere ahụ na-apụta ọhụrụ.
job_boxTunnel.explanation: Mpaghara elu tupu e gbaa oghere bụ $2({a}\times{b}+{b}\times{c}+{c}\times{a})={s0}$ cm². Wepụ ${p}\times{q}$ ugboro abụọ site n'elu na ala, tinye akụkụ n'ime oghere $2({p}+{q})\times{c}$, mgbe ahụ ${s0}-{pq2}+{inn}={ans}$ cm².

job_boxesCeil.prompt: A na-etinye akụrụngwa ${n}$ n'igbe, ${k}$ n'igbe nke ọ bụla, ma na-ebu igbe ndị ahụ n'elu pallet, ${m}$ n'pallet nke ọ bụla. Ọbụlagodi na e nwere akụrụngwa fọdụrụ, a ga-etinye ha n'otu igbe, ma ọbụlagodi na e nwere igbe fọdụrụ, a ga-etinye ha n'otu pallet. Pallet ole ka ọ dị ọkụ opekempe? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Ọ bụrụ na ekekọtaghị nke ọma, ọ dị ọkụ igbe (pallet) ọzọ iji tinye ihe fọdụrụ.
Buru ụzọ chọpụta ọnụọgụ igbe dị ọkụ, wee chọpụta ọnụọgụ pallet n'otu ụzọ ahụ.
job_boxesCeil.explanation: A chọrọ igbe ${bx}$, nke bụ ọnụọgụ e nwetara mgbe e buliri ${n}\div{k}$ elu, ma chọọ pallet ${ans}$, nke bụ ọnụọgụ e nwetara mgbe e buliri ${bx}\div{m}$ elu.

job_chanceDraw.prompt: N'igbe e nwere akụrụngwa ${n}$, n'ime ha ${d}$ bụ ndị mebiri emebi. Mgbe a na-ewepụ akụrụngwa 2 n'otu mgbe n'enweghị nhọrọ, kedu nke puru omume na opekempe otu bụ nke mebiri emebi? (Dee ya dị ka òkè e nwere ike ichikọta.
