Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu, dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụ zuru ezu. Ọmụmaatụ: 3/4)
hints: Ọnụọgụ ụzọ niile e si ewepụta bụ ọnụọgụ ụzọ e si ahọrọ 2 n'ime ${n}$.
Ihe megidere 'opekempe otu bụ nke mebiri emebi' bụ 'abụọ ahụ niile dị mma'.
job_chanceDraw.explanation: Ụzọ niile bụ $_{{n}}\mathrm{C}_{2}={tot}$, ma ụzọ abụọ ahụ niile dị mma bụ $_{{g}}\mathrm{C}_{2}={good}$. Puru omume a chọrọ bụ $1-\frac{{good}}{{tot}}={fr}$.

job_floorPlan.prompt: Ogologo ụlọ nwere ụdị akụkụ anọ bụ ${a}$ m, obosara ya bụ ${b}$ m. N'etiti otu mgbidi ogologo ya, e nwere ohere nwere ụdị akụkụ anọ, obosara ya bụ ${d}$ m, omimi ya bụ ${c}$ m, nke etinyere n'èzí (${d}<{a}$ ma ọ naghị emetụ nkuku ụlọ ahụ). A na-etinye ọkpọ n'ala mgbidi n'ime ụlọ ahụ niile, mana a naghị etinye ya n'ebe ọnụ ụzọ nwere obosara ${w}$ m nọ. Kedu ogologo ọkpọ ahụ dị ọkụ n'ime m? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Dee ya iji chee otú gburugburu ọdịdị nwere ohere ahụ si dị iche na gburugburu akụkụ anọ ahụ.
Otu akụkụ nwere obosara ${d}$ m na-efu, mana akụkụ abụọ nwere omimi ${c}$ m na otu akụkụ nwere obosara ${d}$ m na-apụta.
job_floorPlan.explanation: Gburugburu ụlọ ahụ niile bụ $2({a}+{b})+2\times{c}={per}$ m (n'ihi na akụkụ nwere obosara ${d}$ m na-agbanwe ghọọ akụkụ abụọ nwere omimi ${c}$ m na akụkụ nwere obosara ${d}$ m, ya mere ọ na-abawanye naanị akụkụ abụọ nwere ${c}$ m). Wepụ ${w}$ m nke ebe ọnụ ụzọ, ${per}-{w}={ans}$ m.

job_flowUnits.prompt: Site n'ọnụ mmiri nke igwe nzacha mmiri, mmiri ${r}$ mL na-apụta n'otu nkeji n'ụzọ edoziri. Ọ bụrụ na e hapụ ọnụ mmiri a n'ọnụ ruo ${h}$ awa ${m}$ nkeji, kedu mmiri niile na-apụta n'ime L? (1 L = 1000 mL, ma dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Gbanwee oge niile ka ọ bụrụ nkeji iji chọpụta ogologo oge e hapụrụ ọnụ.
Jiri (ọnụọgụ n'otu nkeji)×(nkeji) chọpụta mL, wee kewaa ya 1000 ka ọ bụrụ L.
job_flowUnits.explanation: Oge e hapụrụ ọnụ bụ ${h}\times60+{m}={tot}$ nkeji, ma mmiri pụtara bụ ${r}\times{tot}={ml}$ mL. ${ml}\div1000={ans}$ L.

job_markupProfit.prompt: N'ụlọ ahịa, e tinyere uru ${u}$% nke ọnụ ahịa mbụ n'elu ihe nwere ọnụ ahịa mbụ ${c}$ won iji hazie ọnụ ahịa edeburu, ma e belatara ọnụ ahịa ahụ ${d}$% wee re ${n}$ niile. Kedu ngụkọta uru e nwetara n'ime won n'ihe banyere ọnụ ahịa mbụ? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Ọnụ ahịa edeburu bụ $(100+{u})$% nke ọnụ ahịa mbụ.
Ọnụ ahịa ire bụ $(100-{d})$% nke ọnụ ahịa edeburu, ma uru otu bụ (ọnụ ahịa ire)−(ọnụ ahịa mbụ).
job_markupProfit.explanation: Ọnụ ahịa edeburu bụ ${c}\times\frac{{100+u}}{100}={lp}$ won, ọnụ ahịa ire bụ ${lp}\times\frac{{100-d}}{100}={sp}$ won. Uru otu bụ ${sp}-{c}={g}$ won, ya mere uru nke ${n}$ bụ ${g}\times{n}={ans}$ won.

job_outfitCount.prompt: E nwere ụdị uwe elu ọrụ ${s}$ na ụdị uwe ala ${p}$, na ụdị okpu ${h}$. A na-ahọrọ otu uwe elu na otu uwe ala, ma enwere ike iyi otu n'ime ụdị okpu ${h}$ ma ọ bụ ọ bụghị iyi okpu. Ọ bụrụ na e nwere ụzọ ${f}$ nke (uwe elu, uwe ala) na-enweghị ike iyi ọnụ n'ihi iwu nchekwa, ole ụdị uwe dị iche ka a pụrụ iyi n'ozuzu? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: Buru ụzọ chọta ọnụọgụ nke ụzọ (uwe elu, uwe ala) enwere ike iyi.
Gụọ ọnụọgụ nhọrọ nke okpu, tinyere ọnọdụ a na-ahọrọ otu n'ime ụdị ${h}$ ma ọ bụ a naghị eyi okpu, wee mụbaa ya.
job_outfitCount.explanation: Ụzọ (uwe elu, uwe ala) bụ ${s}\times{p}-{f}={ok}$, na nhọrọ okpu, gụnyere ọnọdụ a naghị eyi okpu, bụ ${h}+1={hh}$. Site n'iwu ịmụba, ${ok}\times{hh}={ans}$.

job_planCompare.prompt: Atụmatụ A nwere ụgwọ ntọala kwa ọnwa ${f1}$ won ma ${p1}$ won maka ojiji ọ bụla, atụmatụ B nwere ụgwọ ntọala kwa ọnwa ${f2}$ won ma ${p2}$ won maka ojiji ọ bụla. Ka ọnụọgụ ojiji n'otu ọnwa bụrụ $x$ ($x$ bụ ọnụọgụ eke). Gịnị bụ $x$ kacha nta nke ụgwọ atụmatụ B n'otu ọnwa dị ala karịa nke atụmatụ A? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: Dee ụgwọ ọnwa nke atụmatụ abụọ ahụ dị ka okwu nke $x$.
Dozie enweghị nha anya (ụgwọ B)<(ụgwọ A) iji chọta oke nke $x$.
job_planCompare.explanation: Ụgwọ A bụ ${f1}+{p1}x$, nke B bụ ${f2}+{p2}x$. Site na ${f2}+{p2}x<{f1}+{p1}x$, ${dl}x>{df}$, ya bụ $x>\frac{{df}}{{dl}}$. Ọnụọgụ eke kacha nta na-emezu nke a bụ ${ans}$.

job_ratioChain.prompt: Ruru nke mmepụta kwa ụbọchị nke usoro atọ A, B, C bụ A : B $={a}:{b}$, B : C $={c}:{d}$. Ọ bụrụ na mmepụta niile kwa ụbọchị nke usoro atọ ahụ bụ ${T}$, ole ka usoro C na-emepụta kwa ụbọchị? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: Jikọta ruru abụọ ahụ n'ahịrị otu site na iji B dị ka ntọala, ka A : B : C pụta.
Kewaa mmepụta niile ${T}$ site n'nchikota nke ruru A : B : C iji chọta nha nke otu òkè.
job_ratioChain.explanation: Mgbe emeela ka uru nke B hara nhata, A : B : C $={pa}:{pb}:{pc}$. Nchikota nke ruru bụ ${S}$, ya mere otu òkè bụ ${T}\div{S}={u}$, na C bụ ${pc}\times{u}={ans}$.

job_scaleDrawing.prompt: N'eserese nwere ọnụọgụ ntụpọ $1:{k}$, a dere ụlọ nwere ụdị akụkụ anọ nwere ogologo ${w}$ cm na obosara ${h}$ cm. Gịnị bụ mpaghara ezigbo ụlọ ahụ n'm²? (1 m = 100 cm, dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: Ọ bụrụ na ọnụọgụ ntụpọ bụ $1:{k}$, ịmụba ogologo nke eserese ahụ na ${k}$ na-enye ogologo n'ezie.
Chọta ogologo na obosara n'ezie n'cm, gbanwee ha gaa m, wee mụbaa ha.
job_scaleDrawing.explanation: Ogologo n'ezie bụ ${w}\times{k}={rw}$ cm$={rwm}$ m, obosara n'ezie bụ ${h}\times{k}={rh}$ cm$={rhm}$ m, ya mere mpaghara bụ ${rwm}\times{rhm}={ans}$ m².

job_tableRule.prompt: Nke a bụ tebụl ụgwọ ịgbazinye akụrụngwa. Mgbe oge ịgbazinye na-abawanye otu awa, ụgwọ na-abawanye n'ego kwụsiri ike. Awa ${x1}$ bụ ${y1}$ won, awa ${x2}$ bụ ${y2}$ won, awa ${x3}$ bụ ${y3}$ won. Ole won ka ụgwọ ga-abụ ma ọ bụrụ na e gbazinye ya awa ${N}$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: Site na tebụl ahụ, chọta ego ụgwọ na-abawanye mgbe oge na-abawanye otu awa.
Gosi ụgwọ ahụ n'ụdị (ego na-abawanye kwa awa)×(oge)+(ego ntọala), wee chọta ego ntọala.
job_tableRule.explanation: Ebe ọ na-abawanye ${k}$ won kwa awa, ụgwọ ahụ nwere ụdị $y={k}x+{b}$ (a na-enweta ego ntọala ${b}$ won ka awa ${x1}$ bụrụ ${y1}$ won). Awa ${N}$ bụ ${k}\times{N}+{b}={ans}$ won.

job_workTogether.prompt: Onye ọrụ A na-emepụta ngwaahịa ${a}$ kwa awa, onye ọrụ B na-emepụta ${b}$ kwa awa, n'ọsọ kwụsiri ike. A na-amalite ọrụ ahụ buru ụzọ, ma B na-esonye ya mgbe awa ${h}$ gasịrị. Ruo mgbe ngwaahịa ndị ha abụọ mepụtara bụ ${N}$ kpọmkwem, ole awa ka A rụrụ ọrụ n'ozuzu? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: Ọ bụrụ na oge A rụrụ ọrụ bụ $t$ awa, oge B rụrụ ọrụ bụ $t-{h}$ awa.
Wuo nha anya linia (ọnụọgụ A mepụtara)+(ọnụọgụ B mepụtara)$={N}$.
job_workTogether.explanation: Ọ bụrụ na A rụọ ọrụ $t$ awa, B na-arụ $t-{h}$ awa, ya mere ${a}t+{b}(t-{h})={N}$. Ịhazi ya na-enye ${ab}t={tot}$, ya mere $t={ans}$ awa.

pst_atLeast.prompt: Site n'akpa nwere bọl ọcha ${w}$ na bọl isi ojii ${bk}$, a na-ewepụta bọl ${k}$ n'otu oge. Chọta ohere na bọl ọcha ga-abụ ${r}$ ma ọ bụ karịa. (Dee ya dị ka ntakịrị kacha nta. Ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu, dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu. Ọmụmaatụ: 3/4)
hints: Ihe ọzọ ndị na-abụghị 'ọ dị ${r}$ ma ọ bụ karịa' bụ ikpe ebe ọnụọgụgụ bọl ọcha bụ ${zs}$.
Ngụkọta ụzọ e nwere ịwepụta bọl bụ $\binom{{nn}}{{k}}={tot}$.
pst_atLeast.explanation: Ihe ọzọ na-abụghị ya bụ ikpe ebe ọnụọgụgụ bọl ọcha bụ ${zs}$, ma ọnụọgụgụ ụzọ nke ikpe ahụ bụ ${bx}={bad}$. Ngụkọta bụ $\binom{{nn}}{{k}}={tot}$, ya mere ohere a na-achọ bụ $1-\frac{{bad}}{{tot}}={fr}$.

pst_bayes.prompt: A na-atụ dice ziri ezi otu ugboro; ọ bụrụ na akara pụtara bụ ${t}$ ma ọ bụ ihe dị n'okpuru ya, a na-ewepụta otu bọl n'igbe A, ma ọ bụghị ya, n'igbe B. Igbe A nwere bọl ọcha ${w1}$ na bọl isi ojii ${b1}$, igbe B nwere bọl ọcha ${w2}$ na bọl isi ojii ${b2}$. Ọ bụrụ na bọl e wepụtara bụ ọcha, chọta ohere na ọ si n'igbe A pụta. (Dee ya dị ka ntakịrị kacha nta. Ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu, dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu. Ọmụmaatụ: 3/4)
hints: $P(A\mid \text{ọcha})=\frac{P(A\cap \text{ọcha})}{P(\text{ọcha})}$.
Ọnụọgụgụ ala bụ nchikota ohere nke bọl ọcha si n'A na ohere nke bọl ọcha si n'B.
pst_bayes.explanation: Ohere nke bọl ọcha si n'A bụ ${tA}$, ohere nke bọl ọcha si n'B bụ ${tB}$, ya mere ohere a na-achọ bụ $\frac{{tA}}{{tA}+{tB}}={fr}$.

pst_bestOf.prompt: Otu abụọ A, B na-eme asọmpi, otu na-abụ nke mbụ nwetara mmeri ${w}$ na-emeri. Ohere nke otu A imeri n'egwuregwu ọ bụla bụ ${fp}$, egwuregwu ọ bụla adabereghị n'ibe ya, ọ dịghịkwa nha anya. Chọta ohere na otu A ga-emeri. (Dee ya dị ka ntakịrị kacha nta. Ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu, dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu. Ọmụmaatụ: 3/4)
hints: Chee ya site n'ikewa ya dị ka egwuregwu nke ole ka otu A na-enweta mmeri nke ${w}$.
Ka ọ bụrụ onye mmeri n'egwuregwu nke ${w}+j$, n'ime egwuregwu ${wm1}+j$ gara aga, ọ ga-abụ mmeri ${wm1}$ na mfu $j$.
pst_bestOf.explanation: Ohere nke otu A imeri n'egwuregwu nke ${w}+j$ ($j={jr}$) bụ $\binom{{wm1}+j}{j}\left({fp}\right)^{{w}}\left(1-{fp}\right)^{j}$. Uru ndị a n'usoro bụ ${tm}$, ya mere nchikota ha niile bụ ${fr}$.

pst_binomCoef2.prompt: Chọta coefficient nke $x^{{k}}$ n'ịgbasawanye $({ax}{bs})^{{n}}$. (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Okwu izugbe nke binomial theorem bụ ụdị $\binom{N}{j}A^{N-j}B^{j}$.
Chọta okwu ebe a na-amụba $x$ ugboro ${k}$.
pst_binomCoef2.explanation: Ọ bụ okwu nke a na-ahọrọ $x$ ugboro ${k}$ na okwu na-agbanwe agbanwe ugboro ${nk}$, ya mere coefficient bụ $\binom{{n}}{{k}}\cdot{a}^{{k}}\cdot({b})^{{nk}}={ans}$.

pst_binomFindN.prompt: Ọ bụrụ na variable ọ bụla na-enweghị usoro $X$ na-eso binomial distribution $B(n,\ p)$ ma $E(X)={mu}$, $V(X)={vr}$, chọta uru $n$. (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Kewaa $V(X)$ site na $E(X)$ iji nweta $1-p$.
pst_binomFindN.explanation: N'ihi na $\frac{V(X)}{E(X)}=1-p$, $1-p={q}$, ya bụ $p={pp}$. Site na $np={mu}$, $n={ans}$.

pst_binomNormal.prompt: Variable na-enweghị usoro $X$ na-eso binomial distribution $B({n},\ {pf})$. Were normal distribution mee atụmatụ $X$ (enweghị ndozi nke ịga n'ihu), chọta uru $P({ev})$. Maka variable $Z$ nke na-eso standard normal distribution, $P(0\le Z\le 0.5)=0.1915$, $P(0\le Z\le 1)=0.3413$, $P(0\le Z\le 1.5)=0.4332$, $P(0\le Z\le 2)=0.4772$, $P(0\le Z\le 2.5)=0.4938$, $P(0\le Z\le 3)=0.4987$. (Dee ya ruo ọnọdụ ntụpọ nke anọ)
hints: Mgbe $n$ buru ibu, enwere ike iji $N(np,\ np(1-p))$ mee atụmatụ binomial distribution $B(n,\ p)$.
Mee standardize site na (nkezi, standard deviation)=$({mu},\ {sg})$.
pst_binomNormal.explanation: $E(X)={mu}$, $\sigma(X)=\sqrt{{vr}}={sg}$, ya mere $X$ na-eso $N({mu},\ {sg}^{2})$ n'ọtụtụ. Mgbe e mere standardize site na $Z=\frac{X-{mu}}{{sg}}$, ọ bụ ${zs}$, ya mere $P({ev})\approx P({zev})={expr}$.

pst_binomPmfEq.prompt: Ọ bụrụ na mgbanwe ohere $X$ na-agbaso nkesa binomial $B({n},\ p)$ ma $P(X={r})=P(X={r1})$, chọta uru $p$. (Ebe $0<p<1$) (Dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụgụ nkeji nke na-enweghị ike ibelata. Ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu, dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu. Ọmụmaatụ: 3/4)
hints: Dee puru omume abụọ ahụ n'ụdị $\binom{N}{j}p^{j}(1-p)^{N-j}$ wee kewaa akụkụ abụọ ahụ site na ihe jikọrọ ha.
Mgbe i hazichara ya, ị ga-enweta uru $\frac{p}{1-p}$.
pst_binomPmfEq.explanation: Site na $\binom{{n}}{{r}}p^{{r}}(1-p)^{{nr}}=\binom{{n}}{{r1}}p^{{r1}}(1-p)^{{nr1}}$, $\binom{{n}}{{r}}(1-p)=\binom{{n}}{{r1}}p$, ya bụ $\frac{p}{1-p}=\frac{{r1}}{{nr}}$. Ya mere $p={fe}$.

hints: Site na usoro binomial $(1+x)^{N}=\sum_{k=0}^{N}\binom{N}{k}x^{k}$, tinye ọnụọgụgụ kwesịrị ekwesị n'ọnọdụ $x$.
Chọta uru $x$ nke na-eme ka $(1+x)^{N}$ hà nhata ngụkọta ahụ.

pst_binomTail.prompt: Ọ bụrụ na mgbanwe ohere $X$ na-agbaso nkesa binomial $B({n},\ {pf})$, chọta uru $P(X{rel}{t})$. (Dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụgụ nkeji nke na-enweghị ike ibelata. Ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu, dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu. Ọmụmaatụ: 3/4)
hints: $P(X=j)=\binom{N}{j}p^{j}(1-p)^{N-j}$ ($N$ bụ ọnụọgụgụ nnwale). Ọ bụrụ na e nwere ọtụtụ okwu ga-agbakwunye, chee echiche banyere ihe omume nke ọzọ.
Gbakwunye okwu ndị $j=$ ${js}$.
pst_binomTail.explanation: $P(X=j)=\binom{{n}}{j}\left({pf}\right)^{j}\left(1-{pf}\right)^{{n}-j}$, ma puru omume a chọrọ bụ ngụkọta nke uru niile mgbe $j={js}$, ya bụ $\frac{{tm}}{{D}}=\frac{{num}}{{D}}={fe}$.

pst_binomUnknown.prompt: N'ime mgbasa nke $(x+a)^{{n}}$, ọ bụrụ na coefficient nke $x^{{k}}$ bụ ${V}$, chọta uru dị mma nke $a$. (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Gosipụta coefficient nke $x^{{k}}$ site n'iji $a$.
Ebe $\binom{{n}}{{k}}={C}$, buru ụzọ chọta uru $a^{{nk}}$.
pst_binomUnknown.explanation: Coefficient nke $x^{{k}}$ bụ $\binom{{n}}{{k}}a^{{nk}}={C}a^{{nk}}$, ya mere ${C}a^{{nk}}={V}$, ya bụ $a^{{nk}}={q}$. Ebe $a>0$, $a={ans}$.

pst_ciBounds.prompt: A họrọ nlele nha ${n}$ n'enweghị usoro site n'ọnụọgụgụ mmadụ niile na-agbaso nkesa nkịtị nke ndakpọ ọkọlọtọ ya bụ ${s}$, ma nkezi nlele bụ ${xb}$. Ka oge ntụkwasị obi maka nkezi ọnụọgụgụ mmadụ niile $m$ n'ọkwa ntụkwasị obi ${cl}\%$ bụrụ $a\le m\le b$, chọta uru $b$. (Uru kwekọrọ n'ọkwa ntụkwasị obi ${cl}\%$ bụ $z={z}$.) (Dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụgụ ntụpọ)
hints: Oge ntụkwasị obi bụ $\overline{x}-z\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{{n}}}\le m\le \overline{x}+z\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{{n}}}$.
Ebe $\sqrt{{n}}={rt}$, buru ụzọ chọta $\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{{n}}}$.

pst_ciSampleSize.prompt: Mgbe a na-eme atụmatụ nkezi nke ọnụọgụ mmadụ niile n'ntụkwasị obi ${cl}\%$ site na ịhọrọ nlele n'enweghị ụkpụrụ site na ọnụọgụ mmadụ niile nke na-eso nkesa nkịtị nke standard deviation ya bụ ${s}$, chọta uru kacha nta nke nha nlele $n$ nke na-eme ka ogologo oge ntụkwasị obi bụrụ ${L}$ ma ọ bụ pere mpe. (Mara: uru dabara n'ntụkwasị obi ${cl}\%$ bụ $z={z}$, ma $n$ bụ ọnụọgụ eke.) (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: Ogologo oge ntụkwasị obi bụ $2z\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}$.
Dozie enweghị nha anya a maka $\sqrt{n}$ wee tụọ akụkụ abụọ square. $2z\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}\le {L}$
pst_ciSampleSize.explanation: Ogologo oge ntụkwasị obi bụ $2\times{z}\times\frac{{s}}{\sqrt{n}}\le {L}$, ya mere $\sqrt{n}\ge\frac{2\times{z}\times{s}}{{L}}$, ya bụ $n\ge\left(\frac{2\times{z}\times{s}}{{L}}\right)^{2}{eq}{nq}$. Ọnụọgụ eke kacha nta na-emezu nke a bụ ${ans}$.

pst_condDice.prompt: Tụba dice abụọ nwere ọtụtụ ụzọ na-adị iche, nke ziri ezi, n'otu oge, ka ọnụọgụ ndị pụtara bụrụ $a,\ b$ n'otu n'otu. Ka ihe omume $A$ bụrụ '$a+b{rel}{t}$', ihe omume $B$ bụrụkwa '$a{relb}b$'. Chọta conditional probability $P(B\mid A)$. (Dee ya dị ka ntakịrị nke enweghị ike ibelata ọzọ. Ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu, dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụ zuru ezu. Ọmụmaatụ: 3/4)
hints: Buru ụzọ chọta ọnọdụ niile dị n'ihe omume $A$.
$P(B\mid A)=\frac{n(A\cap B)}{n(A)}$.
pst_condDice.explanation: Ọnụọgụ ọnọdụ nke ihe omume $A$ bụ ${nA}$, nke $A\cap B$ bụkwa ${nAB}$. Ya mere $P(B\mid A)={fe}$.

pst_condTable.prompt: N'ime ụmụ akwụkwọ ${N}$ nke otu klọb, ụmụ nwoke bụ ${m}$, ndị yi anya enyo bụ ${g}$, ma ụmụ nwoke yi anya enyo bụ ${x}$. Mgbe a họọrọ otu onye n'enweghị ụkpụrụ site na klọb a ma ọ naghị eyi anya enyo, chọta ohere na ọ bụ nwaagbọghọ. (Dee ya dị ka ntakịrị nke enweghị ike ibelata ọzọ. Ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu, dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụ zuru ezu. Ọmụmaatụ: 3/4)
hints: Mee tebụl wee mejupụta ọnụọgụ nke obere igbe anọ: nwoke/nwaagbọghọ, yi anya enyo/ayịghị anya enyo.
Na conditional probability $P(B\mid A)=\frac{n(A\cap B)}{n(A)}$, $A$ bụ 'ayịghị anya enyo'.
pst_condTable.explanation: Ụmụ nwaagbọghọ bụ ${f}$ ma ndị yi anya enyo n'ime ha bụ ${g}-{x}={gy}$, ya mere ndị na-ayịghị anya enyo bụ ${f}-{gy}={fn}$. Ndị na-ayịghị anya enyo n'ozuzu bụ ${N}-{g}={ng}$, ya mere ohere bụ ${fe}$.

pst_deMorgan.prompt: Maka ihe omume abụọ $A,\ B$, mgbe ${gv}$, chọta uru nke $P({ev})$. (Dee ya dị ka decimal)
hints: Seere eserese Venn wee kewaa ya n'mpaghara anọ: $A\cap B$, $A\cap B^{c}$, $A^{c}\cap B$, $A^{c}\cap B^{c}$.
$P(A\cap B^{c})=P(A)-P(A\cap B)$, $P(A^{c}\cap B)=P(B)-P(A\cap B)$. Ị pụrụ iji iwu De Morgan $(A\cup B)^{c}=A^{c}\cap B^{c}$, $(A\cap B)^{c}=A^{c}\cup B^{c}$ na $P(E^{c})=1-P(E)$.
pst_deMorgan.explanation: $P(A\cap B)$ bụ ${der}$. Ohere nke mpaghara anọ bụ $P(A\cap B)={pab}$, $P(A\cap B^{c})={ao}$, $P(A^{c}\cap B)={bo}$, $P(A^{c}\cap B^{c})={ne}$, ma nchikota ha bụ $1$. Ebe $P({ev})$ bụ nchikota nke mpaghara ndị dabara, ọ bụ ${sumx}$.

pst_diceQuad.prompt: Tụba dice ziri ezi nwere ọnụọgụ site na $1$ ruo ${s}$ otu otu ugboro abụọ, ka ọnụọgụ ndị pụtara bụrụ $a,\ b$ n'usoro. Chọta ohere na nha anya quadratic $x^{2}-{pa}x+{qb}=0$ nwere mgbọrọgwụ n'ezie abụọ dị iche. (Dee ya dị ka ntakịrị nke enweghị ike ibelata ọzọ. Ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu, dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụ zuru ezu. Ọmụmaatụ: 3/4)
hints: Ọnọdụ maka mgbọrọgwụ n'ezie abụọ dị iche bụ discriminant $D>0$.
$D={d1}-4\times{qb}$, wee kpebie $a$ otu otu ma gụọ $b$ ndị na-emezu ọnọdụ ahụ.
pst_diceQuad.explanation: Ụzọ ${cnt}$ nke $(a,\ b)$ na-emezu discriminant $D={d1}-4\times{qb}>0$, ma ngụkọta bụ ụzọ ${tot}$, ya mere ohere bụ ${fe}$.

pst_diceSum.prompt: Mgbe a na-atụba dice abụọ ziri ezi n'otu oge, nke ọ bụla nwere akara site na $1$ ruo ${s}$, ma ọnụọgụ akara pụtara bụ $a,\ b$ n'otu n'otu, chọta puru omume na $a+b{rel}{t}$. (Dee ya dị ka òkè e belatara. Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu, dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụ zuru ezu. Ọmụmaatụ: 3/4)
hints: Ọ bụrụ na ị kewaa dice abụọ ahụ, ọnụọgụ ọnọdụ niile bụ ${s}\times{s}$.
Gbanwee $a$ site na $1$ ruo ${s}$ wee gụọ ọnụọgụ $b$ na-emezu ọnọdụ ahụ wee tinye ha.
pst_diceSum.explanation: Ọnọdụ niile bụ ${tot}$, ma $(a,\ b)$ na-emezu ọnọdụ bụ ${cnt}$. Ya mere puru omume bụ ${fe}$.

pst_expectTable.prompt: Uru ndị mgbanwe ohere $X$ nwere ike inwe bụ $1,\ 2,\ \ldots,\ {n}$ ma $P(X=x)=k(x+{c})$ ($x=1,\ 2,\ \ldots,\ {n}$), chọta uru nkezi $E(X)$ nke $X$. (Ebe $k$ bụ ihe na-adịghị agbanwe.) (Dee ya dị ka òkè e belatara. Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu, dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụ zuru ezu. Ọmụmaatụ: 3/4)
hints: Buru ụzọ chọta $k$ site na ọnọdụ na ngụkọta puru omume niile bụ $1$.
$E(X)=\sum x\,P(X=x)$.
pst_expectTable.explanation: Ebe ngụkọta puru omume niile bụ $1$, $k({t1})={S1}k=1$, ya bụ $k=\frac{1}{{S1}}$. $E(X)=\frac{1}{{S1}}({t2})=\frac{1}{{S1}}\times{S2}={fe}$.

pst_indepFindN.prompt: Site n'kaadị $n$ nke e dere ọnụọgụ eke site na $1$ ruo $n$ n'otu n'otu, mgbe e weputara otu kaadị n'enweghị nhọrọ, ka ihe omume $A$ bụrụ 'ọnụọgụ kaadị bụ ọtụtụ nke ${p}$' na ihe omume $B$ bụrụ 'ọnụọgụ kaadị bụ ọtụtụ nke ${q}$'. N'ime ọnụọgụ eke $n$ nke $2\le n\le {M}$, chọta uru kachasị ukwuu nke $n$ nke na-eme ka ihe omume abụọ $A,\ B$ bụrụ nke nọ n'onwe ha. (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Ọ bụrụ na ha nọ n'onwe ha, $P(A\cap B)=P(A)P(B)$, ma $A\cap B$ bụ ọtụtụ nke ${l}$. Ọ bụrụ na e nwere ọtụtụ nke ${p}$ $a$, ọtụtụ nke ${q}$ $b$, ọtụtụ nke ${l}$ $c$, ọnọdụ nọ n'onwe bụ $ab=cn$.
Lelee ihe na-eme mgbe $n$ bụ ọtụtụ nke ${l}$.
pst_indepFindN.explanation: Ọ bụrụ na $n={l}t$ ($t$ bụ ọnụọgụ eke), $P(A)=\frac{1}{{p}}$, $P(B)=\frac{1}{{q}}$, $P(A\cap B)=\frac{1}{{l}}$, ya mere ha nọ n'onwe ha. Ọtụtụ nke ${l}$ kachasị ukwuu n'ime ${M}$ ma ọ bụ n'okpuru ya bụ ${ans}$. Maka $n$ dị ukwuu karịa nke a, lelee ma ọnọdụ nọ n'onwe $\frac{c}{n}=\frac{a}{n}\cdot\frac{b}{n}$, ya bụ $ab=cn$, dị mgbe e nwere ọtụtụ nke ${p}$ $a$, ọtụtụ nke ${q}$ $b$, ọtụtụ nke ${l}$ $c$. Ebe ${chk}$, ha anọghị n'onwe ha. Ya mere ọ bụ ${ans}$.

pst_indepUnknown.prompt: Mgbe ihe omume abụọ $A,\ B$ nọ n'onwe ha ma $P(A)={fa}$, $P(A\cup B)={fu}$, chọta uru nke $P(B)$. (Dee ya dị ka òkè e belatara. Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu, dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụ zuru ezu. Ọmụmaatụ: 3/4)
hints: Ọ bụrụ na ha nọ n'onwe ha, $P(A\cap B)=P(A)P(B)$.
Dozie usoro mgbakwunye $P(A\cup B)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A)P(B)$ ka ọ bụrụ nhata banyere $P(B)$.
pst_indepUnknown.explanation: Ebe ha nọ n'onwe ha, $P(A\cup B)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A)P(B)$, ya bụ $P(B)\{1-P(A)\}=P(A\cup B)-P(A)$. Ebe $1-{fa}={d1}$, ${fu}-{fa}={d2}$, $P(B)={d2}\div{d1}={fr}$.

pst_latticePath.prompt: N'ime ụzọ kacha mkpụmkpụ site n'isi $(0,\ 0)$ ruo isi $({m},\ {n})$ n'ụgbọ elu nhazi, ebe ị na-aga n'aka nri ma ọ bụ n'elu otu ọnọdụ n'otu oge, ụzọ ole ka na-agafeghị n'isi $\mathrm{P}({p},\ {q})$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Jiri permutation nwere ihe yiri ibe ya gụọ ngụkọta ụzọ niile. Ụzọ na-agafeghị = niile - ndị na-agafe.
Gụọ ụzọ na-agafe n'isi $\mathrm{P}$ dị ka (site n'isi mmalite ruo $\mathrm{P}$)×(site na $\mathrm{P}$ ruo njedebe).
pst_latticePath.explanation: Ụzọ niile bụ ${tot}$. Site n'isi mmalite ruo $\mathrm{P}$ bụ ${via1}$, site na $\mathrm{P}$ ruo njedebe bụ ${via2}$, ya mere ụzọ na-agafe n'isi $\mathrm{P}$ bụ ${via1}\times{via2}={via}$. Ya mere ${tot}-{via}={ans}$.

pst_linTransform.prompt: Ọ bụrụ na nkezi nke ihe a na-agbanwe agbanwe $X$ bụ ${m}$ ma ndọrọ ndọrọ ọkọlọtọ bụ ${s}$, maka $Y={ya}$, chọta uru $E(Y^{2})$. (Dee naanị nọmba)
hints: Jiri $E(Y)=aE(X)+b$, $V(Y)=a^{2}V(X)$.

pst_lineUp.prompt: Mgbe ụmụ nwoke ${m}$ na ụmụ nwanyị ${w}$ guzo n'ahịrị, chọta ohere na ụmụ nwanyị abụọ ọ bụla anaghị anọ n'akụkụ ibe ha. (Dee ya dị ka ntakịrị kachasị nta. Ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu, dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu. Ọmụmaatụ: 3/4)
hints: Ohere ahụ bụ otu ma ọ bụrụ na ị naghị ekewa ndị nwere otu mkpụrụ ndụ, ma tụlee naanị ndokwa. Buru ụzọ guzoo ụmụ nwoke, wee tụlee ebe ụmụ nwanyị nwere ike iguzo n'etiti ha na n'ọnụ abụọ.
Ebe ụmụ nwanyị nwere ike iguzo bụ ${m1}$.
pst_lineUp.explanation: Ngụkọta ndokwa nke mkpụrụ ndụ bụ $\binom{{nn}}{{w}}={tot}$. Họrọ ebe ${w}$ n'ime ebe ${m1}$ n'etiti ụmụ nwoke na n'ọnụ abụọ ka ụmụ nwanyị ghara ịnọ n'akụkụ ibe ha, ya bụ $\binom{{m1}}{{w}}={good}$ ụzọ. Ohere ahụ bụ ${fe}$.

pst_monotoneSeq.prompt: Maka ihe $a,\ b,\ c,\ d$ nke ntọala $\{1,\ 2,\ \ldots,\ {m}\}$, chọta ọnụọgụgụ ụzọ nhazi $(a,\ b,\ c,\ d)$ na-eju $a{r1}b{r2}c{r3}d$. (Dee naanị nọmba)
hints: Ebe akara bụ $<$, ọnụọgụgụ abụọ ga-adị iche. Belata oke ọnụọgụgụ ị nwere ike ịhọrọ site n'ịta ahụhụ ahụ.
Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ $\le$ naanị, ịhọrọ ọnụọgụgụ anọ dị ka ngwakọta nwere ntinye ugboro ugboro.
pst_monotoneSeq.explanation: $a<b$ hà $a+1\le b$, ya mere ọ bụrụ na ewepụ $1$ n'ọnụọgụgụ azụ maka $<$ nke ọ bụla, akara ahụ ghọrọ $\le$. N'ajụjụ a, e nwere $<$ ${s}$, ya mere akara niile ghọrọ $\le$ ma oke ọnụọgụgụ si na $1$ ruo ${ms}$. Ọnụọgụgụ ụzọ isi họrọ $4$ na-ekwe ka ugboro ugboro dị n'oke a bụ ${}_{{ms}}\mathrm{H}_{4}=\binom{{top}}{4}={ans}$.

pst_multiplesUnion.prompt: Site n'kaadị ${N}$ nke e dere ọnụọgụgụ okike $1$ ruo ${N}$ n'otu n'otu, a na-eweta otu kaadị n'enweghị atụmatụ. Chọta ohere na nọmba dị n'elu kaadị ahụ bụ ọtụtụ nke ${p}$ ma ọ bụ ọtụtụ nke ${q}$. (Dee ya dị ka ntakịrị kachasị nta. Ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu, dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu. Ọmụmaatụ: 3/4)
hints: Buru ụzọ chọta ọnụọgụgụ ọtụtụ nke ${p}$ na ọtụtụ nke ${q}$. Ihe abụọ niile bụ ọtụtụ nke ọtụtụ kacha nta nke ọnụọgụgụ abụọ ahụ.
Ọnụọgụgụ ihe nke njikọ = (nchikota) - (nkwekọrịta).
pst_multiplesUnion.explanation: E nwere ọtụtụ nke ${p}$ ${np}$, ọtụtụ nke ${q}$ ${nq}$, ọtụtụ nke ọtụtụ kacha nta ${l}$ ${nl}$. Ya mere ${np}+{nq}-{nl}={cnt}$ ma ohere bụ ${fe}$.

pst_normalBetween.prompt: Mgbe ihe a na-agbanwe agbanwe $X$ na-eso nkesa nkịtị $N({m},\ {s}^{2})$, chọta uru $P({a}\le X\le {b})$. Maka ihe a na-agbanwe agbanwe $Z$ nke na-eso nkesa nkịtị ọkọlọtọ, $P(0\le Z\le 0.5)=0.1915$, $P(0\le Z\le 1)=0.3413$, $P(0\le Z\le 1.5)=0.4332$, $P(0\le Z\le 2)=0.4772$, $P(0\le Z\le 2.5)=0.4938$, $P(0\le Z\le 3)=0.4987$. (Dee ya ruo ebe ntakịrị nke anọ)
hints: Mee ka ọ bụrụ ọkọlọtọ site na $Z=\frac{X-m}{\sigma}$ ma gbanwee ya ka ọ bụrụ ụdị $P(z_1\le Z\le z_2)$.
Eserese nkesa nkịtị ọkọlọtọ dị otu n'akụkụ abụọ nke $Z=0$.
pst_normalBetween.explanation: Mgbe emere ya ọkọlọtọ site na $Z=\frac{X-{m}}{{s}}$, $\frac{{a}-{m}}{{s}}={z1}$, $\frac{{b}-{m}}{{s}}={z2}$, ya mere $P({z1}\le Z\le {z2})={expr}$.

pst_normalFindParam.prompt: Ọ bụrụ na mgbanwe ohere $X$ na-agbaso nkesa nkịtị $N(m,\ {s}^{2})$ ma $P(X\ge {c})={pv}$, chọta uru nkịtị $m$. Maka mgbanwe ohere $Z$ na-agbaso nkesa nkịtị ọkọlọtọ, $P(0\le Z\le 0.5)=0.1915$, $P(0\le Z\le 1)=0.3413$, $P(0\le Z\le 1.5)=0.4332$, $P(0\le Z\le 2)=0.4772$, $P(0\le Z\le 2.5)=0.4938$, $P(0\le Z\le 3)=0.4987$. (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: Gbanwee $P(X\ge {c})$ ka ọ bụrụ ohere nke $Z$ ma tụnyere ya na $0.5$.
Chọta $z_0$ kwekọrọ na uru $P(0\le Z\le z_0)$ n'ime tebụl.
pst_normalFindParam.explanation: $P(X\ge {c})=P\left(Z\ge \frac{{c}-m}{{s}}\right)={pv}$. Site na tebụl, $P(0\le Z\le |z_0|)=|{pv}-0.5|={tv}$, ya mere $|z_0|={az}$. Ebe ${cmp}$, ọ bụ ${zsg}$, ma $\frac{{c}-m}{{s}}={zz}$. Ya mere $m={ans}$.

pst_normalSymmetric.prompt: Ọ bụrụ na mgbanwe ohere $X$ na-agbaso nkesa nkịtị $N({m},\ {s}^{2})$ ma $P(X\le {L})=P(X\ge {R})$, chọta uru nkịtị $k$. (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: Akụkụ nkesa nkịtị dakọrọ n'etiti ọkwa $m$.
Uru abụọ ahụ dị n'akụkụ ọzọ nke ọkwa n'otu ebe. Ya bụ, nchikota uru abụọ ahụ bụ $2m$.
pst_normalSymmetric.explanation: Ebe akụkụ nkesa nkịtị dakọrọ n'ahịrị $x={m}$, $({L})+({R})=2\times{m}$. Mgbe e dozichara ya, ${A}k+({BD})={m2}$, ya mere $k={ans}$.

pst_repCombEq.prompt: Maka ọnụọgụ zuru ezu na-adịghị adị n'ọnụọgụ ọjọọ $x,\ y,\ z,\ w$, chọta ọnụọgụ nke ụzọ edozi $(x,\ y,\ z,\ w)$ ebe $x+y+z+w={n}$ ma ${cond}$. (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: Maka mgbanwe nwere oke ala karịrị $0$, wepụ oke ala ahụ ka ọ bụrụ $0$ ma ọ bụ karịa.
Akụkụ nhata a gbanwere bụ ụdị $x'+y'+z'+w'={m2}$.
pst_repCombEq.explanation: Kọwaa mgbanwe ọhụrụ dị ka ndị a. ${subs}$. (Ọ bụrụ na e nwere mgbanwe nwere oke ala $0$, were ya dị ka $x'=x$.) Mgbe ahụ $x'+y'+z'+w'={m2}$ ma mgbanwe ọ bụla bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu $0$ ma ọ bụ karịa. Nhazi nke iji ugboro ugboro ${}_{4}\mathrm{H}_{{m2}}=\binom{{m3}}{{m2}}={ans}$.

pst_repPermCond.prompt: N'ime ọnụọgụ eke nwere ọnụọgụ ${k}$ e mere site na ọnụọgụ $0,\ 1,\ 2,\ \ldots,\ {m}$ ebe a na-enye ohere ịmegharị (ọnụọgụ mbụ abụghị $0$), ole ka nke jiri ọnụọgụ ${t}$ otu ugboro ma ọ bụ karịa? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: Maka 'jiri otu ugboro ma ọ bụ karịa', jiri ihe na-emegide ya ('ejighị ọ bụla') dị mfe. 0 enweghị ike ịbụ ọnụọgụ mbụ.
Ngụkọta ọnụọgụ eke nwere ọnụọgụ ${k}$ bụ ${tot}$.
pst_repPermCond.explanation: Ngụkọta ọnụọgụ eke nwere ọnụọgụ ${k}$ bụ ${tot}$, ma ọnụọgụ ndị na-ejighị ọnụọgụ ${t}$ ọ bụla bụ ${noExpr}={no}$. Ya mere ${tot}-{no}={ans}$.

pst_sampleMeanDist.prompt: E nwere bọọlụ 3 n'ime akpa, ọnụọgụ edere na bọọlụ ọ bụla bụ ${lst}$. Wepụta bọọlụ otu site n'akpa ahụ, lelee ọnụọgụ ya, tinyeghachi ya, megharịa ugboro ${nt}$. Ọ bụrụ na ọkwa nke ọnụọgụ ${nt}$ ndị a lelere bụ $\overline{X}$, chọta $P(\overline{X}\ge {t})$. (Dee ya dị ka ntakịrị kacha nta. Ọ bụrụ onu ogugu zuru ezu, dee onu ogugu zuru ezu. Ọmụmaatụ: 3/4)
hints: Ebe a na-ejiri ntụgharị, ụzọ edozi niile nwere ike ime nwere otu ohere.
Gụọ ụzọ edozi niile nke ọkwa ha bụ ${t}$ ma ọ bụ karịa.
pst_sampleMeanDist.explanation: Ngụkọta ọnụọgụ ụzọ mgbe a na-eburu usoro n'uche bụ ${tot}$, ma ọnụọgụ ụzọ nke ọkwa ha bụ ${t}$ ma ọ bụ karịa bụ ${cnt}$. Ya mere ohere bụ ${fe}$.

pst_sampleMeanNormal.prompt: Site na population nke na-eso normal distribution nke population mean bụ ${m}$ na population standard deviation bụ ${s}$, a họpụtara sample nke nha ya bụ ${n}$ n'enweghị usoro, ma ka sample mean bụrụ $\overline{X}$. Chọta uru $P({ev})$. Maka random variable $Z$ nke na-eso standard normal distribution, $P(0\le Z\le 0.5)=0.1915$, $P(0\le Z\le 1)=0.3413$, $P(0\le Z\le 1.5)=0.4332$, $P(0\le Z\le 2)=0.4772$, $P(0\le Z\le 2.5)=0.4938$, $P(0\le Z\le 3)=0.4987$. (Dee ya ruo ebe decimal anọ)
hints: Sample mean $\overline{X}$ na-eso normal distribution $N\left(m,\ \left(\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{{n}}}\right)^{2}\right)$.
Chọta standard deviation e ji eme standardization dị ka nke a. $\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{{n}}}={h}$
pst_sampleMeanNormal.explanation: $\overline{X}$ na-eso normal distribution $N({m},\ {h}^{2})$ ($\frac{{s}}{\sqrt{{n}}}={h}$). Mgbe e mere standardization site na $Z=\frac{\overline{X}-{m}}{{h}}$, ọ bụ ${zs}$, ya mere $P({ev})=P({zev})={expr}$.

pst_sampleSd.prompt: Site na population nke population mean bụ ${m}$ na population variance bụ ${v}$, a họpụtara sample nke nha ya bụ ${n}$ n'enweghị usoro, ma ka sample mean bụrụ $\overline{X}$. Chọta uru $E(\overline{X}^{2})$. (Dee ya dị ka decimal)
hints: Mean nke sample mean bụ $E(\overline{X})=m$, ma variance ya bụ $V(\overline{X})=\frac{\sigma^{2}}{{n}}$.
$E(\overline{X}^{2})=V(\overline{X})+\{E(\overline{X})\}^{2}$.

pst_stratified.prompt: Ndị bi n'otu mpaghara kewara n'otu atọ A, B, C, nke nwere mmadụ ${na}$, ${nb}$, ${nc}$ n'usoro. A họpụtara sample site na proportional stratified sampling, nke na-ekpebi nha sample n'ọnụọgụgụ ndị dị n'otu ọ bụla, ma e nwetara mmadụ ${sa}$ site na otu A. Ole mmadụ ka a họpụtara site na otu C? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ proportional allocation, pasent a họpụtara n'otu ọ bụla (ọnụọgụgụ sample ÷ ọnụọgụgụ otu) bụ otu.
Buru ụzọ chọta pasent nke otu A.
pst_stratified.explanation: Pasent a họpụtara n'otu A bụ $\frac{{sa}}{{na}}$. Ebe pasent a bụ otu n'otu niile, n'otu C ọ bụ ${nc}\times\frac{{sa}}{{na}}={ans}$ mmadụ.

pst_totalProb.prompt: A na-atụba dice ziri ezi otu ugboro; ọ bụrụ na anya pụtara bụ ${t}$ ma ọ bụ ihe pere mpe, a na-ewepụta otu bọl site n'igbe A, ma ọ bụghị ya, site n'igbe B. Igbe A nwere bọl ọcha ${w1}$ na bọl ojii ${b1}$, ma igbe B nwere bọl ọcha ${w2}$ na bọl ojii ${b2}$. Chọta ohere ka bọl e wepụtara bụrụ bọl ọcha. (Dee ya dị ka ntakịrị kacha mfe. Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu, dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu. Ọmụmaatụ: 3/4)
hints: Ọnọdụ ndị bọl e wepụtara bụ bọl ọcha kewara n'abụọ: 'bọl ọcha site na A' ma ọ bụ 'bọl ọcha site na B'.
Chọta nke ọ bụla dị ka (ohere ịhọrọ igbe)×(ohere bọl ọcha site n'igbe ahụ).
pst_totalProb.explanation: Bọl ọcha site na A: $\frac{{t}}{6}\times{pw1}={tA}$, bọl ọcha site na B: $\frac{{t6c}}{6}\times{pw2}={tB}$ (ebe a $\frac{{t6c}}{6}$ bụ ohere ịhọrọ B). Mgbe e gbakọtara uru abụọ ahụ, $\frac{{t}}{6}\times{pw1}+\frac{{t6c}}{6}\times{pw2}={fr}$.

pst_urnChain.prompt: N'ime akpa nwere bọl ọcha ${w}$ na bọl ojii ${bk}$, a na-ewepụta bọl otu otu n'usoro, ma anaghị eweghachi nke e wepụtara. Chọta ohere ka bọl ọcha pụta ugboro ${r}$ nke mbụ n'usoro, wee bọl ojii pụta n'ugboro nke ${r1}$. (Dee ya dị ka ntakịrị kacha mfe. Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu, dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụgụ zuru ezu. Ọmụmaatụ: 3/4)
hints: Iwu ịkpọ ohere: n'ogo ọ bụla, ọnụọgụgụ bọl fọdụrụ na-agbanwe.
Ohere ka bọl mbụ bụrụ bọl ọcha bụ $\frac{{w}}{{nn}}$.
pst_urnChain.explanation: Mgbe e kpọrọ (conditional) ohere nke ogo ọ bụla, ${prod}={fe}$.

pst_varTable.prompt: Ọ bụrụ na nkesa ihe gbasara ohere nke ọnụọgụ ohere $X$ bụ $P(X={x1})=\frac{{a1}}{{d}}$, $P(X={x2})=\frac{{a2}}{{d}}$, $P(X={x3})=\frac{{a3}}{{d}}$, chọta uru nke variance $V(X)$. (Dee ya dị ka ntakịrị nke enweghị ike ibelata ọzọ. Ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu, dee ya dị ka ọnụọgụ zuru ezu. Ọmụmaatụ: 3/4)
hints: Buru ụzọ chọta $E(X)$ na $E(X^{2})$.

stat_ciMean.prompt: A họọrọ {cnt} n'enweghị ụkpụrụ site na ọnụọgụ mmadụ niile nke na-eso nkesa nkịtị. Nkezi nke nlele bụ $\bar{x}={xbar}$ ma standard deviation nke ọnụọgụ mmadụ niile bụ $\sigma={sig}$. Oge ntụkwasị obi nke ${cl}\%$ maka nkezi nke ọnụọgụ mmadụ niile bụ $\bar{x}-z\dfrac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}\le m\le\bar{x}+z\dfrac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}$, ma uru nke $z$ bụ ${z}$. Gịnị bụ ọnụ elu (oke elu) nke oge ntụkwasị obi a? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: Buru ụzọ chọta njehie ọkọlọtọ $\dfrac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}$. Ebe $n$ bụ square zuru ezu, ọ na-ekewa nke ọma.
Oke njehie bụ $z\times$(njehie ọkọlọtọ), ma oke elu bụ $\bar{x}$ gbakwunyere ya.
stat_ciMean.explanation: Njehie ọkọlọtọ bụ $\frac{{sig}}{\sqrt{{cnt}}}={se}$, oke njehie bụ ${z}\times{se}={moe}$, ya mere oke elu bụ ${xbar}+{moe}={ans}$.

stat_ciProp.prompt: Banyere otu iwu, a họọrọ ndị mmadụ {cnt} n'enweghị ụkpụrụ ma jụọ ha, ndị {ag} kwadoro ya. Ka $\hat{p}$ bụrụ ruru nke nlele, oge ntụkwasị obi nke ${cl}\%$ maka ruru nke ọnụọgụ mmadụ niile bụ $\hat{p}-z\sqrt{\dfrac{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}{n}}\le p\le\hat{p}+z\sqrt{\dfrac{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}{n}}$, ma uru nke $z$ bụ ${z}$. Gịnị bụ oke elu nke oge ntụkwasị obi a n'ọnụọgụ pasent (%)? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: Buru ụzọ chọta ruru nke nlele $\hat{p}=\dfrac{{ag}}{{cnt}}$.
$\sqrt{\dfrac{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}{n}}$ bụ ọnụọgụ rational zuru ezu. Ọ dị mfe ịgbakọ ya mgbe ị gbanwere ya gaa pasent.
stat_ciProp.explanation: Ebe $\hat{p}={ph}\%$, $\sqrt{\frac{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}{{cnt}}}={sdp}\%$, oke njehie bụ ${z}\times{sdp}={moe}$(%), ma oke elu bụ ${ph}+{moe}={ans}$(%).

stat_linReverse.prompt: Site na variable $x$, e mepụtara variable ọhụrụ $y$ ($y={eq}$). Nkezi nke $y$ bụ ${my}$, standard deviation bụ ${sy}$. Gịnị bụ standard deviation nke variable $x$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: Ọ bụrụ na $y=ax+b$, standard deviation na-aghọ okpukpu $|a|$.
Ọnụọgụ kwụsiri ike $b$ a gbakwunyere na nkezi enweghị mmekọrịta na standard deviation. Kewaa standard deviation nke $y$ site na $|a|$.
stat_linReverse.explanation: Uru zuru oke nke ọnụọgụ nke $x$ bụ ${aa}$, ya mere standard deviation nke $y$ bụ okpukpu ${aa}$ nke standard deviation nke $x$. Ya mere standard deviation nke $x$ bụ ${sy}\div{aa}={ans}$.

stat_linTransform.prompt: Nkezi nke variable $x$ bụ ${m}$, variance bụ ${vx}$. Ọ bụrụ na variable ọhụrụ $y$ bụ $y={eq}$, gịnị bụ variance nke $y$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: Ọ bụrụ na $y=ax+b$, variance na-aghọ okpukpu $a^2$.
Ọnụọgụ kwụsiri ike $b$ a gbakwunyere anaghị agbanwe otú e si gbasaa, ya mere ọ naghị emetụta variance.
stat_linTransform.explanation: Na $y={eq}$, ọnụọgụ nke $x$ bụ ${ap}$, ya mere variance bụ ${vx}\times{ap}^{2}={vx}\times{a2}={ans}$ (okwu kwụsiri ike na nkezi anaghị emetụta variance).

stat_quartileIqr.prompt: Mgbe e hazigharịrị data {data} n'usoro nha, a na-akpọ etiti uru nke ọkara dị n'okpuru etiti uru ahụ first quartile $Q_1$, ma etiti uru nke ọkara dị n'elu ya bụ third quartile $Q_3$. (Ọ bụrụ na ọnụọgụ data bụ ọnụọgụ na-abụghị ọbụna, etiti uru n'onwe ya anaghị abanye n'ọkara ọ bụla.) Gịnị bụ uru nke interquartile range $Q_3-Q_1$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụ)
hints: Buru ụzọ dee data ahụ ọzọ n'usoro nha site na obere uru.
Kewaa data ahụ n'ọkara dị n'okpuru na ọkara dị n'elu site na etiti uru nke niile, wee chọta etiti uru nke ọkara ọ bụla.

stat_rejectN.prompt: A na-nwale echiche a: $H_0: m={mu0}$, $H_1: m>{mu0}$. Were ya na ndakpọ ọkọlọtọ nke ọnụọgụgụ mmadụ niile bụ $\sigma={sig}$ ma nkezi nlele bụ $\bar{x}={xbar}$. Ọ bụrụ na ọnụọgụgụ nnwale $Z=\dfrac{\bar{x}-{mu0}}{\sigma/\sqrt{n}}$ karịrị ${crit}$, a ga-ajụ echiche efu. Ọ bụrụ na a ga-enweta otu nkezi nlele ahụ, gịnị bụ nha nlele kacha nta $n$ nke ga-eme ka a jụ echiche efu? (Ọnụọgụgụ okike, dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Gbanwee enweghị nha a ka ọ bụrụ okwu banyere $\sqrt{n}$. $Z>{crit}$
Gbasaa akụkụ abụọ ahụ ka ị chọta oke $n$, wee chọta ọnụọgụgụ okike kacha nta na-emezu ọnọdụ ahụ. Nhata abụghị ịjụ.
stat_rejectN.explanation: Site na $Z=\dfrac{{xbar}-{mu0}}{{sig}}\sqrt{n}>{crit}$, $\sqrt{n}>{rt}$, ya bụ $n>{lim}$ (uru e gosiri ruo ebe ntụpọ nke abụọ). Ọnụọgụgụ okike kacha nta na-emezu nke a bụ ${ans}$.

stat_sdFreq.prompt: E nwere tebụl nkesa ugboro nke uru ndị $x$ bụ {xs} ma ugboro nke uru ọ bụla bụ {fs} n'usoro. Ọ bụrụ na ewere data a dị ka ọnụọgụgụ mmadụ niile (denominator nke variance bụ ngụkọta ugboro), gịnị bụ ndakpọ ọkọlọtọ? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Buru ụzọ chọta ngụkọta ugboro $N$ na nkezi $m=\dfrac{\sum f x}{N}$.
Variance $=\dfrac{\sum f x^2}{N}-m^2$, ma ndakpọ ọkọlọtọ bụ mgbọrọgwụ square dị mma ya.
stat_sdFreq.explanation: $N={tot}$, nkezi $m={mean}$, $\dfrac{\sum f x^2}{N}={msq}$, ya mere variance bụ ${var}$, ma ndakpọ ọkọlọtọ bụ ${ans}$.

stat_stratified.prompt: A chọrọ ịhọrọ nwa akwụkwọ {ns} n'ihe niile site na ọkwa atọ nke ọnụọgụgụ ha bụ {n1}, {n2}, {n3} n'usoro, site na nhọrọ n'ọkwa. Ọ bụrụ na e kenyere ya n'ụdị kwekọrọ na ruru nke ọkwa ọ bụla n'ọnụọgụgụ nwa akwụkwọ niile, ole nwa akwụkwọ ka a ga-ahọrọ site n'ọkwa nke {i}? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Buru ụzọ chọta ngụkọta ọnụọgụgụ nwa akwụkwọ $N$.
Ọnụọgụgụ a ga-ahọrọ site n'ọkwa nke {i} bụ (ngụkọta nwa akwụkwọ a ga-ahọrọ)$\times\dfrac{{ni}}{N}$.
stat_stratified.explanation: Ngụkọta nwa akwụkwọ bụ ${pop}$, ya mere ${ns}\times\dfrac{{ni}}{{pop}}={ans}$.

stat_tCiLower.prompt: A họrọ {cnt} n'enweghị usoro site n'ọnụọgụgụ mmadụ niile na-agbaso nkesa nkịtị. Nkezi nlele bụ $\bar{x}={xbar}$, ndakpọ ọkọlọtọ nlele bụ $s={sd}$. Ebe a maghị ndakpọ ọkọlọtọ nke ọnụọgụgụ mmadụ niile, a na-eji nkesa $t$; n'ime tebụl nkesa $t$ nwere ogo nnwere onwe ${df}$, $P(T\le {t0})=0.975$. Gịnị bụ uru njedebe dị ala (oke dị ala) nke oge ntụkwasị obi $95\%$ maka nkezi ọnụọgụgụ mmadụ niile $m$, $\bar{x}-t_0\dfrac{s}{\sqrt{n}}\le m\le\bar{x}+t_0\dfrac{s}{\sqrt{n}}$ ($t_0={t0}$)? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Ogo nnwere onwe bụ $n-1$, ma njehie ọkọlọtọ bụ $\dfrac{s}{\sqrt{n}}$.
Oke dị ala bụ $\bar{x}-t_0\times$(njehie ọkọlọtọ).
stat_tCiLower.explanation: Njehie ọkọlọtọ bụ $\frac{{sd}}{\sqrt{{cnt}}}={se}$, oke njehie bụ ${t0}\times{se}={moe}$, ya mere oke dị ala bụ ${xbar}-{moe}={ans}$.

stat_zStat.prompt: A maara na ndụ nkezi nke otu ngwaahịa bụ awa ${mu0}$. A họrọ ngwaahịa {cnt} n'enweghị usoro nke e mere site n'usoro ọhụrụ ma nyochaa ya, ndụ nkezi bụ awa $\bar{x}={xbar}$. Ọ bụrụ na ndụ na-agbaso nkesa nkịtị ma ndakpọ ọkọlọtọ nke ọnụọgụgụ mmadụ niile $\sigma={sig}$ awa agbanwebeghị, gịnị bụ uru ọnụọgụgụ nnwale $Z=\dfrac{\bar{x}-{mu0}}{\sigma/\sqrt{n}}$ maka echiche efu $H_0: m={mu0}$? (Dee naanị ọnụọgụgụ)
hints: Buru ụzọ gbakọọ $\dfrac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}$.
Kewaa ọdịiche dị n'etiti nkezi nlele na ${mu0}$ site na uru ahụ. Ọ nwere ike ịbụ ihe na-adịghị mma.
